jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: **About Us** ------------ FlowGen Labs is a frontier enterprise AI company building the zero\-touch enterprise: context\-aware agents that operate inside deeply customized SAP environments at machine speed, grounded in each company’s ontology, current operational data, and operating procedures so complex workflows can run autonomously instead of relying on manual support teams. FlowGen is focused on turning legacy ERP from a system of record into an execution layer for finance and operations. Deployed at Fortune 500 companies across CPG, distribution, high\-tech, and oil and gas, FlowGen Labs brings together a frontier AI and SAP team from DeepMind, SAP, Meta AI, and Amazon AGI Labs. **Role Summary** ---------------- Build the systems that help FlowGen find the right customers and turn interest into revenue. You will work directly with the founders and go\-to\-market team to connect data, software, and AI across prospecting, marketing, and sales, giving a small team the reach and execution speed of a much larger one. This is a hands\-on engineering role with broad ownership. You will identify the real constraint, build a practical solution, and remain accountable through deployment, adoption, and measurable results. You will: * Build automated workflows that turn customer signals into qualified pipeline: account discovery, enrichment, prioritization, lead routing, and outbound activation. * Own enrichment end to end. Turn inbound interest, target account lists, and event contacts into accurate, deduplicated CRM records with useful account context and clear next steps. * Develop account scoring around our ideal customer profile. Combine company data, buying signals, and AI research to help the team focus on enterprises where FlowGen can deliver the most value. * Build AI agents and internal tools for account research, meeting preparation, call summaries, proposals, and RFP or security questionnaire drafts. Put useful account intelligence into the team's daily workflow. * Connect our CRM, enrichment providers, outbound tools, and internal data systems through APIs and reliable data pipelines. Own the data models, sync logic, and quality of the information the team relies on. * Ship code that holds up in production: clear reviews, logging, monitoring, retries, and error handling. Debug broken integrations, failed data jobs, and unreliable model outputs, and fix the underlying cause. * Work with the founders and sales team to find repetitive work, test new approaches, and measure what improves pipeline quality, conversion, and time spent selling. Keep improving the systems as the company scales. **What We Are Looking For** --------------------------- * 1\+ years building software or technical systems in GTM engineering, growth engineering, revenue operations, sales engineering, or a closely related role. A track record of shipping useful systems matters more than a specific title. * Strong Python and TypeScript skills. You can work with APIs and asynchronous workflows, design a database schema, and debug a production issue from logs. * Hands\-on experience with a modern GTM stack: CRMs, enrichment tools, and outbound platforms. You understand how accounts and leads move through a sales process and how to keep the underlying data trustworthy. * Practical experience building with LLMs, including prompt design, evaluations, structured outputs, and handling failures. You know how to make an AI workflow dependable enough for people to use every day. * Strong SQL skills and sound judgment about data models, integrations, and pipeline design. You think through duplicate records, API limits, concurrent updates, and what changes when volume grows. * Strong business judgment and crisp communication. You can turn an ambiguous sales or marketing problem into a scoped project, explain the tradeoffs, and connect technical work to business outcomes. * Ownership mentality and follow\-through on the details. No job is too small: you'll build a new agent and fix the broken CRM sync, and you do both well. * Real curiosity about enterprise AI, agentic workflows, and how large companies actually operate. Experience building CRM integrations or production AI applications is especially useful. **Why Join** ------------ * Work directly with the founders and shape how an early\-stage frontier enterprise AI company scales. * Help define how autonomous agents operate inside the systems that run the world’s largest companies. * Direct product and company impact with minimal bureaucracy. * A high bar for craft, velocity, accountability, and pragmatic shipping. **Logistics** ------------- * Location: In person, San Francisco Bay Area * Employment: Full time * Total Compensation: $150,000–$250,000 per year, including base salary and equity. The final package will depend on experience and scope. * Visa support and sponsorship available Compensation Range: $150K \- $250K

jobs.description: **Summary** This position will oversee landscape architecture while supporting a wide range of design related efforts across high end hospitality, residential, and commercial developments as well as urban design. The role is intentionally versatile and requires a design professional with a strong, holistic understanding of the built environment including landscape architecture, architecture, and interior design. This individual will support the design team by coordinating multidisciplinary consultants, evaluating overall design quality on site, and contributing hands on design work when needed. Approximately 75 percent of the role is focused on project and consultant management, with 25 percent dedicated to active design and graphic production. Direct Supervisor: Vice President of Design Location: Miami, FL **Duties and Responsibilities** * Manage landscape architecture inclusive of the total exterior built environment, hardscape, pools, recreation, and resort activities, as well as horticultural environment and related design scopes across all project phases, from predevelopment through construction and closeout. * Coordinate and manage external consultants including landscape architects, civil engineers, architects, interior designers, lighting designers, and specialty vendors. * Review consultant drawings and design packages for accuracy, constructability, and consistency with overall project design intent. * Maintain quality control across all design related deliverables, ensuring alignment with project goals, schedules, and budgets. * Prepare and coordinate landscape related requests for proposals, including defining scope, evaluating consultant responses, and supporting consultant selection. * Assist in establishing, tracking, and maintaining landscape and design related budgets throughout all project phases, including coordination with internal teams and external consultants. * Provide integrated design oversight with a broad lens, evaluating architecture, urban design, and landscape execution holistically rather than in isolation. * Conduct site visits to assess overall design implementation, including landscape installation, architectural detailing, interior finishes, and site and landscape lighting, and identify issues while coordinating resolution. * Support permitting, entitlement, and jurisdictional review processes related to site and design scopes. * Contribute to design development through sketches, diagrams, layouts, and graphic presentations as needed. * Produce and review visual materials including concept sketches, presentation boards, site diagrams, and design narratives. * Assist in specifying materials, finishes, planting palettes, site furnishings, and site and landscape lighting that support cohesive design intent across disciplines. * Respond to RFIs, submittals, and field conditions, providing timely and design conscious solutions. * Present design concepts, progress updates, and technical strategies to internal leadership and external stakeholders. * Mentor junior designers and support design standards related to documentation, graphics, and coordination workflows. * Provide ongoing design progress updates and cost related input including quantity takeoffs, value engineering ideas, and risk mitigation strategies tied to design decisions. **Education and Experience** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Landscape Architecture required. * 8 to 12 years of professional experience within the built environment, preferably spanning resort, hospitality, residential, and mixed use development. * Demonstrated experience managing consultants and coordinating multidisciplinary design teams. * Strong understanding of how landscape, construction methodologies. * Ability to read, interpret, and evaluate architectural, interior, and landscape construction documents. * Comfort operating as a design generalist with the ability to contractors. * Comfortable working in a fast paced environment with shifting priorities. * Willingness to travel to project sites as required. **Applicants must submit a resume, cover letter, Portfolio work should clearly identify the applicant’s personal contributions.**

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description: Develop Health is on a mission to use AI to radically accelerate access to life\-saving medications. By automating complex, manual healthcare processes—like benefit verification and prior authorization— **we've been growing rapidly and over the past couple of years have helped over 2\.5 million patients!** We’re partnering with some of the largest pharmacy benefit managers and payers in the nation, revolutionizing how healthcare interactions occur by eliminating human delays and inefficiencies. Our small, elite team of founders and engineers have previously launched and exited successful healthcare startups including Rupa Health and Canvas Medical. We are now scaling rapidly following a major funding round. **About The Role** ------------------ We're hiring a **Senior Software Engineer** to build the software that removes the obstacles between a prescription and treatment. This is a hands\-on, full\-stack role spanning problem definition, implementation, launch, and production validation. You'll build Python services and APIs, TypeScript and React interfaces, integrations, and AI\-powered workflows, working directly with our Product, AI, and Operations teams and the people who use what you build. AI is part of how we work. You'll use coding agents to investigate systems and accelerate implementation while retaining ownership of the product behavior, technical decisions, testing, and production outcome. **What You'll Do – Impact In Your First 3–6 Months** ---------------------------------------------------- * Work with users and internal stakeholders to define a meaningful problem, the smallest useful solution, and observable success signals. * Ship full\-stack product features across backend services, user interfaces, data models, integrations, and workflow infrastructure. * Integrate AI capabilities where they improve the workflow, with the reliability and fallbacks required for production healthcare software. * Make pragmatic product and technical trade\-offs, leaving enough context for teammates and agents to execute confidently. * Build testing, observability, rollout safety, and user feedback into the work, then iterate until the feature produces the intended outcome. **What You'll Own – Driving Growth Beyond 12 Months** ----------------------------------------------------- * Own major product surfaces and the customer or operational outcomes they support. * Shape product direction using customer evidence, operational data, and technical constraints. * Scale the architecture and API layer as our products, integrations, and transaction volume grow. * Raise the team's bar for product shaping and engineering quality, and mentor other engineers. **What You'll Bring On Day 1** ------------------------------ * **Production full\-stack experience.** You have at least 3 years of experience building and shipping software that real users depend on. * **Strong engineering fundamentals.** You're effective in Python and a modern typed frontend stack, and can ramp quickly on TypeScript and React. * **End\-to\-end product ownership.** You're excited to start with an ambiguous problem, work with users to shape the right solution, and carry it through implementation and a measured result. * **User\-facing craft.** You care whether a complex workflow feels clear and trustworthy, as well as whether the system is technically sound. * **AI\-native execution.** Coding agents materially change how you investigate and build, and you verify their output rather than delegating judgment. * **Clear communication.** You work precisely with engineers, product partners, operators, and customers. **What You'll Need To Learn Quickly** ------------------------------------- * How benefit verification and prior authorization work across providers, pharmacies, payers, and pharmacy benefit managers. * Where medication\-access workflows break and how those failures affect patients, clinical teams, and operations. * How our product, workflow, and AI systems interact within healthcare data and reliability constraints. * How customers and internal teams evaluate success across turnaround time, accuracy, approval outcomes, and operational effort. **Bonus Points** ---------------- * Experience building AI\-powered or automation\-heavy products in production. * Experience with healthcare, clinical workflows, EHRs, payers, pharmacies, or another regulated domain. * Early\-stage startup experience or evidence that you thrive with high ownership and limited structure. * Experience building workflow products, data\-heavy interfaces, or third\-party integrations. **What We Offer** ----------------- * Competitive base salary plus meaningful early\-stage equity. * Health, dental, and vision coverage; flexible PTO. * A high\-end workstation and tooling budget, including the AI tools that help you do your best work. * Direct ownership of products that improve access to medication for hundreds of thousands of patients every month. If you're excited to combine strong engineering, product judgment, and AI\-native execution to improve access to care, we'd love to hear from you! Compensation Range: $200K \- $250K

jobs.description: We are hiring a Software Engineer at Level 1, 2, or 3 based on skills, experience, and demonstrated scope of impact. In this role, you will design, build, test, and support software solutions across the application development lifecycle, partnering with cross\-functional teammates to deliver reliable, maintainable, and cost\-effective systems. Position level will be determined based on individuals’ skill, knowledge, and experience. **Core Responsibilities** ------------------------- **Level 1** Early\-career engineer who creates and modifies basic programs with guidance. Supports coding, testing, debugging, code reviews, performance monitoring, and documentation, and assists with basic to moderate designs and prototypes. **Level 2** Mid\-level engineer who creates and modifies moderately complex programs. Contributes to more complex code reviews and moderate to complex designs, mentors engineers, and may lead design execution or assist with requirements analysis, technical debt reduction, and application architecture. **Level 3** Senior engineer who develops complex software solutions, provides technical leadership, leads code reviews, contributes to architectural decisions, and mentors engineers. Collaborates across teams to reduce technical debt and uses cloud\-native platforms, automation, and AI technologies to deliver secure, scalable, maintainable solutions, including technical guidance on responsible AI\-enabled development. * Develop cost\-effective solutions and enhancements for existing and new software applications, programs, and processes by analyzing information, investigating problem areas, and implementing solutions. * Support the product lifecycle by monitoring and reviewing system performance, coding, testing, debugging, documenting, participating in code reviews, and implementing software changes according to department standards. * Contribute to DevOps practices by supporting designs and prototypes; helping create and execute test plans and program specifications. * Use test environments and test cases to design, prototype, validate, and correct systems. * Document programs, processes, and procedures to communicate changes and maintain operational efficiency. * At Levels 2 and 3, contribute to improvements in coding standards, tools, and development processes; at Level 3, help evaluate and implement automation, emerging technologies, and AI\-enabled development practices. **Qualifications** ------------------ * Knowledge of software engineering principles, practices, and the full development lifecycle (design, coding, testing, debugging, and support). * Knowledge of software systems, design techniques, development tools, and data processing concepts, with general knowledge at Level 1, working knowledge at Level 2, and advanced knowledge at Level 3\. Relevant technologies include C\#/.NET/.NET Core, LINQ, SQL, and related tools. * Analytical and problem\-solving skills, including the ability to identify root causes and recommend solutions. * Ability to communicate effectively and collaborate within a cross\-functional team. * Demonstrated alignment with organizational core competencies (e.g., change agility, communication, customer focus, innovation, teamwork, critical thinking, and decision making). * Level 3 requires advanced knowledge of C\#, .NET/.NET Core, SQL, LINQ, Blazor, system design, software architecture, application integration patterns, and cloud technologies, along with the ability to lead technical initiatives, manage projects, and influence technical direction. Python, JavaScript, and Angular experience is optional. **Education** ------------- Levels 1 and 2: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, information systems, engineering, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education, professional certifications, training, and relevant work experience. Level 3: Bachelor’s degree in computer science, management information systems, or a related field; a combination of education and/or relevant work experience may be accepted in lieu of a degree. * **Level 1:** 0–2 years of academic, internship, project\-based, or professional experience in software development or a related technical field. Practical experience through coursework, projects, portfolios, or labs may be considered. Foundational proficiency in at least one relevant programming language and familiarity with source control, debugging, testing, and relational data concepts. * **Level 2:** 2\+ years of progressively responsible experience in software development or a related technical role, including developing, testing, deploying, and supporting production software. Proficiency in one or more relevant programming languages and practical experience with source control, automated testing, relational data, APIs, and CI/CD practices. * **Level 3:** 5\+ years of related progressive experience in development and systems analysis, experience with 1–3 coding languages ( osoft DevOps, Git, and GitHub Copilot and/or Microsoft 365 Copilot or equivalent. * **AI architecture knowledge — strongly preferred for Level 3:** Working knowledge of large language models, vector databases, semantic search, prompt engineering, and agent\-to\-agent communication patterns; ability to evaluate AI technologies and recommend architectures, frameworks, implementation patterns, and governance considerations based on business and technical requirements. * **AI implementation experience — strongly preferred for Level 3:** Designing and implementing Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, including knowledge retrieval, vector search, grounding, and prompt orchestration; architecting, developing, and supporting Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers and integrations for secure enterprise access; designing and optimizing agentic workflows using Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Copilot Studio, or similar tools; and using AI\-assisted development for code generation, testing, documentation, debugging, and solution design. **Benefits** ------------ * Hybrid availability * 401(k) with company match * Health insurance * Paid time off, holidays * Volunteer time off * Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA) * Paternity leave **Growth opportunities** ------------------------ We believe each of us has potential to grow and adapt with our business. We take your career as seriously as you do. Helping you develop your skills and talents leads to opportunities — not only for you, but also for our company. That’s why we provide: * LinkedIn Learning Premium access * CliftonStrengths® assessment and coaching * On\-site and virtual workshops and cohorts featuring world\-class content from FranklinCovey, Crucial Learning, Gallup, and more * Free world\-class insurance acumen courses through AHIP and LOMA * Reimbursement and bonus opportunities for professional designations and certifications, including a tuition reimbursement program * Opportunities to take part in Wellabe's mentorship programs **About Wellabe** ----------------- Since 1929, Wellabe has been finding solutions to help our customers protect their health and financial well\-being. And we’re committed to fostering an internal culture of inclusivity, well\-being, and development so each of our team members can succeed. Learn more about Wellabe’s culture of betterment by visiting wellabe.com/culture (https://www.wellabe.com/culture). Wellabe is full of smart, caring, hard\-working people with a broad range of talents who understand collaboration is key. We bring our best selves every day, to connect with others to solve problems, spark innovation, and bring ideas to life. Meet the team and learn what makes Wellabe a great place to work by visiting wellabe.com/news/employee\-spotlights (https://www.wellabe.com/news/employee\-spotlights). **Our core values:** * Be dedicated: Show unwavering commitment by proactively taking initiative, setting clear goals, and managing time effectively. * Be trustworthy: Take accountability for actions, navigate difficult conversations with integrity, and build strong relationships through consistent, honest behavior. * Be determined: Demonstrate enthusiasm and a relentless drive to overcome obstacles and achieve goals. * Be collaborative: Foster teamwork by being self\-aware, actively listening, and effectively communicating across all levels. * Be open: Embrace diversity and new ideas to create an inclusive environment. * Be generous: Embody generosity and compassion by serving a greater purpose and helping others. * Be better: Commit to continuous improvement and adapt effectively to change. * Be well: Prioritize physical and mental health, manage stress, and demonstrate emotional intelligence. jobs.title: Software Engineer, Agents
jobs.description: **The Role** Output has built a biological reasoning model that understands biology at the scale and complexity life actually operates. Our model independently learned the principles of molecular interactions, opening up drug treatments that were previously impossible. We're already generating therapies that traditional approaches cannot reach. The hardest problems in both AI and biology are being solved here, and there is room for you to own one. Output is currently in stealth, operated by a team of repeat founders and biotech veterans with multiple exits in AI x Bio, and backed by top\-tier VCs including Y Combinator. You will build the agent infrastructure that turns model capabilities into usable tools and workflows. This role owns the orchestration layer, the inference serving, the internal tooling, and the interfaces that researchers and external systems interact with. * You will design and build the agent orchestration system that composes model capabilities into multi\-step workflows, handling sequencing, state management, and error recovery * You will implement agent skills and tools that expose model capabilities to automated and interactive workflows * You will build inference infrastructure for serving models efficiently, optimizing for latency, throughput, and reliability * You will design and build APIs and integrations, including MCP\-compatible interfaces, that allow external systems and users to interact with Output's models * You will build internal tools that accelerate the research team's work, from experiment management to evaluation pipelines * You will establish and maintain software engineering practices across the team: testing, CI/CD, code review, and documentation **About You** * You have a BS in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience * You have 4\+ years of experience building production software systems * You have experience integrating ML models into products or workflows, including LLM\-based systems * You have strong Python engineering skills with a track record of building maintainable, well\-tested production code * You have experience designing APIs and building systems that other engineers and researchers depend on * You are comfortable with cloud infrastructure, containerization, and deployment pipelines * You think in systems: you design for reliability, observability, and graceful failure, not just the happy path **Bonus Points** * You have experience with LLM orchestration frameworks, agent architectures, or tool\-use patterns * You have experience with MCP (Model Context Protocol) or similar model\-integration protocols * You have a background in biology, chemistry, computational biology, or a related natural science * You have experience building internal tools that accelerate research or data science teams * You have experience with inference optimization for large models **Our Values** -------------- **Heart:** We foster a culture of ownership. We are assembling a team of individuals who are passionate and take pride in their contributions. **Excellence:** We have an unwavering commitment to excellence and continuously challenge ourselves to reach the highest standards. **Practicality:** We value practicality and results\-oriented thinking. We are committed to making a tangible impact on the lives of patients and the broader community. **Honesty:** We place a high value on honesty and directness. We firmly believe in addressing issues as they arise, in an open and transparent manner. **Fun:** We believe that life is too short to not have fun. Our goal is to create a workplace that is fun, engaging, rewarding and fulfilling. **What We Offer** ----------------- * We encourage new and different ideas, creativity and contrarian thinking * Healthy feedback focused environment to help you strive \- leadership will have high expectations, regularly share constructive feedback, support you and help you grow, and welcome receiving feedback and ideas from you * You own your day\-to\-day management. What we care about is that we all hit our milestones * Competitive salary and equity in a growing, well\-funded startup * Excellent medical, dental, and vision coverage Compensation Range: $150K \- $300K

jobs.title: Staff Quantitative Researcher, Pricing
jobs.description: Alt is unlocking the value of alternative assets, starting with the $5 B trading\-card market. We let collectors buy, sell, vault, and finance their cards in one place and we are backed by leaders at Stripe, Coinbase, Seven Seven Six, and pro athletes like Tom Brady and Giannis Antetokounmpo. Our next frontier is real\-time pricing at scale—the Alt Value that powers every trade, loan, and product on the platform. **The North Star** ------------------ **$ Automatically Priced** **The Role** ------------ Alt Value, our pricing engine, shapes what collectors see in the app and what they can borrow against their cards. This role makes Alt Value more accurate. **This is a hands\-on seat.** You'll find new signals, build them into our pricing, and decide how our models are used. **What this role is not:** a reporting role or a management track. **What it is:** testing whether new data predicts price moves, investigating unusual sales, explaining price gaps between marketplaces, and deciding which model to trust when two disagree. You'll report to the Head of Pricing Automation and work closely with Expert Pricers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers. The people who do well here are obsessed with making every decision with numbers, even the uncertainty is quantified. **What You'll Own** ------------------- * **New data signals.** Identify new signals, from market sentiment to sports outcomes, and validate their predictive power through rigorous backtesting. * **Market manipulation detection.** Identify potential market manipulation and unusual activity, and keep it from distorting our valuations. * **Cross\-market pricing.** Design models for an inefficient market, where the same card can be mispriced from one marketplace to the next. * **Model selection and blending.** Evaluate our pricing models and decide which to use, or how to blend them, weighing the trade\-offs. * **Release and routing decisions.** Decide when a new model version goes live and when to switch routing. * **The bets and the trade\-offs.** Set your own research priorities, work with Expert Pricers, data scientists, and machine learning engineers, and communicate the reasoning behind price movements. **What Great Looks Like (6 Months)** ------------------------------------ * Pricing accuracy has measurably improved. * New data sources have been tested, and the useful ones are in production. * Potential manipulation is weighted in our valuations. * Model selection and blending are backed by evidence. * At least one new tool or method has been adopted into our pricing. * Expert Pricers rely on your work. **How You'll Use AI Here** -------------------------- We're AI\-native by default. You'll stay on top of new models, tools, and techniques, and bring in what improves our pricing. **What You Bring** ------------------ * **A track record of building pricing or forecasting models** in production, and familiarity with tree\-based models and newer approaches such as large language models, time\-series foundation models, and graph neural networks. * **Depth in non\-traditional or illiquid assets**, such as collectibles, art, real estate, or alternative credit. We're reading the work, not the years. * **Experience combining multiple models or signals**, through portfolio construction, forecast combination, or ensemble methods. * **Market prediction with alternative data**, including unstructured sources such as text and sentiment. * **Statistical rigor**: experimental design, backtesting, and noisy or sparse data. * **Expert SQL and Python.** * **Hands\-on work building with AI**, such as agents or internal tools that others rely on. * **Clear communication**, with a record of explaining complex work to non\-technical audiences. **Backgrounds that fit:** quantitative research or portfolio construction at an investment firm; statistical or cross\-market arbitrage; sports betting or prediction market pricing; credit or insurance underwriting; marketplace pricing or trust and safety. **How We'll Interview You** --------------------------- Before your first conversation, download the Alt app, place a bid, and list a card. Every round assumes you have. * **Recruiter screen, 25 minutes.** Your background, motivation, and compensation. * **Hiring manager, 45 minutes.** Your past work and approach to pricing problems. * **Take\-home case study, not timed.** A pricing exercise you complete on your own schedule. * **Case study presentation, 60 minutes.** If your case study moves forward, you present it to the team, followed by a group interview. * **Culture interview, 30 minutes.** How you work, and why Alt. * **Executive review, 30 minutes.** A closing conversation. * **Reference check, 15 minutes**, with a former manager. **Compensation** ---------------- **Base salary: $185,000 to $220,000** plus equity. Offers may vary based on experience, location, and other factors. **What we offer:** ================== ***For full\-time Employees*** * We cover 85% of your medical, dental, and vision, and up to 50% for dependents. HSA/FSA available * Generous PTO that people actually take * Parental leave at full salary * $200/month wellness \+ $100/month home office stipend * Free DoorDash Pass membership, because dinner shouldn't be a decision * Remote\-first (for most positions), with WeWork access when you want a room with other humans * 401(k) * Alt Equity to all full\-time employees Compensation Range: $185K \- $220K

jobs.title: Principal Engineer

You will design and deliver critical software, guide complex engineering decisions and establish practices that help the team build with speed, quality and accountability. Write and review production code, lead design reviews and create clear technical documentation that other engineers and coding agents can use. * **Build controls into the platform.** Design for calculation accuracy, auditability, data integrity, security and reliable operations. Develop interfaces that allow AI agents to interact with financial services through appropriate permissions, validation and safeguards. * **Advance development with AI coding agents.** Decompose work, coordinate multiple agents and establish testing and review gates for their output. Mentor engineers through design discussions, code reviews and pairing, helping the team make effective decisions independently. **What You Need to Bring:** * 6\+ years of designing, building and operating production software systems or relevant professional experience, preferred. * Demonstrated success guiding complex technical designs and delivering software in collaboration with other experienced engineers. * Demonstrated expertise using multiple AI coding agents to deliver production software, including task decomposition, orchestration, automated validation and review. jobs.description: Acuren’s strength begins with its people. Acuren delivers comprehensive inspection, testing, certification, and asset integrity solutions that help organizations ensure critical assets are safe, compliant, and optimized for reliable performance. Our specialized expertise and advanced capabilities support clients across energy, industrial, and public infrastructure sectors. Our services include inspection; traditional and advanced NDE/NDT; failure analysis; rope access; materials, field, and reliability engineering; drones; robotics; V\-Deck; and condition\-based monitoring. Through these capabilities, we help clients evaluate asset condition, manage operational risk, and make informed decisions throughout the asset lifecycle. Our work supports the integrity and safety of assets across petroleum refining, pipelines, power generation, pulp and paper, mining, pharmaceutical, aerospace, and automotive industries. Acuren employs more than 5,000 professionals who support mechanical integrity and inspection programs across industrial sectors. Our approach is practical and focused: provide capable local teams with certified, well\-equipped personnel supported by trained and experienced leaders. Building on a strong heritage of safety, quality, and professionalism, we continue to advance technical capabilities and support reliability programs that create value for clients and employees. Accessibility accommodations are available to applicants upon request. The company uses AI\-enabled tools to organize candidate responses; these tools may be used during the screening or assessment process. \#LI\-BE1 * Lead mission planning for complex inspection operations: large transmission corridors, multi\-state projects, energized lines, remote/off\-grid substations, or difficult terrain. Include risk assessments, airspace coordination, emergency procedures, launch/recovery zone planning, payload configuration (e.g., thermal, LiDAR, NDT sensors). * Pilot advanced UAS platforms and payloads, possibly beyond visual line\-of\-sight (BVLOS) or using special waivers, under company/regulatory policy; optimize sensor suite for electrical infrastructure inspection (visual, thermal, LiDAR, corrosion sensors). * Oversee pre\-flight inspections and operational readiness: verify UAS systems, sensor calibration, redundancy/backup plans, communications links, site access procedures, safety checklists. * Conduct high\-quality data capture for inspection of towers, lines, substations, including anomaly detection (e.g., conductor vibration, hot spots, tower corrosion, insulator flashover risk, tower hardware stress). * Lead post\-flight data processing workflow: ensure imagery/sensor data is properly ingested, triaged, annotated and delivered. Provide technical interpretation of findings, prepare detailed inspection reports for engineering/asset management teams. * Drive decision\-making: collaborate with engineers to prioritize maintenance, support defect classification, estimate repair urgency, contribute to asset life\-cycle management strategies. * Manage and maintain UAS fleet: define maintenance schedules, upgrade paths, sensor integration, budget planning for UAS operations. * Train, mentor, and certify junior pilots (Levels I \& II), develop training curriculum, ensure compliance with SOPs, best practices, operational safety culture. * Develop and refine operational SOPs, safety protocols, regulatory compliance frameworks (including FAA waivers, airspace, site\-specific authorizations), and continuous improvement initiatives. * Represent the UAS inspection program to stakeholders: utility clients, regulatory bodies, internal leadership; communicate findings, metrics, safety performance, cost savings, risk mitigation.\\ * Operate small unmanned aerial systems (sUAS) to inspect electrical infrastructure in accordance with FAA Part 107, company safety procedures, and project work plans. * Plan, execute, and document aerial missions across varied terrain, including rural, mountainous, and urban environments. * Capture high\-resolution imagery for inspection and analysis of electrical transmission and distribution components. * Ensure data quality and consistency following standard flight parameters and detailed capture requirements. * Maintain detailed flight logs, mission reports, and equipment maintenance records. * Manage data upload, storage, and transfer processes for timely integration with inspection workflows * Coordinate with field inspectors, management, and safety personnel to optimize field efficiency and ensure compliant operations. * Collaborate with inspection team (engineers, technicians, site managers) to schedule missions, coordinate ground support, access site permissions, and ensure safe launch/recovery zones. * Follow continuous improvement: stay current with UAS technologies, sensor payloads (e.g., LiDAR, thermal imaging), inspection best practices and regulatory changes. * Comply with airspace authorizations, waiver requirements, and local jurisdiction flight restrictions. Other work duties as assigned. **KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS \& ABILITIES:*** Recognized as subject\-matter expert in UAS inspections within the electrical infrastructure domain; leads complex missions and fleets rather than only executing flights. * Has decision\-making authority for mission go\-/no\-go, equipment procurement, training of staff, and client/sponsor reporting. * Responsible for integrating UAS inspection data into strategic asset\-management workflows, not just collecting data. * Demonstrable experience flying UAS in challenging field conditions (remote terrain, near energized lines/towers, variable weather). * Proficiency with UAS flight planning software (waypoints, automated missions), and data capture workflows. * Basic knowledge of electrical infrastructure (transmission towers, poles, substations) and associated hazards (electrical safety, fall zones, climbing operations) is strongly preferred. * Strong situational awareness, spatial/hand\-eye coordination, attention to detail in flight operations and data capture. * Good interpersonal and communication skills: able to work with field teams, site managers, and engineers; present findings clearly. **EDUCATION:*** 5\+ years of work experience operating UAS commercially, preferably in infrastructure inspection, utilities or similar environment. * Valid FAA Remote Pilot Certificate (Part 107\) or equivalent regulatory certification for commercial UAS operations.

jobs.title: Software Dev Engineer II, SageMaker Compute Governance
jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Training and running large AI models takes enormous amounts of expensive accelerated compute, and most of it sits idle. Across the industry, a large share of GPU capacity is paid for but never does useful work because jobs cannot find it, cannot share it, or cannot see it and use it efficiently. We build the services that closes that gap. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to help build the systems that put idle or inefficiently used GPUs to work. You will design and build distributed backend services that let organizations pool capacity across many clusters and accounts, route it to the workloads that need it most, and see exactly how it is being used. This is deep systems work at the intersection of large\-scale distributed systems, container orchestration, and cloud infrastructure, and it directly changes how much value customers get from every GPU they pay for. You will own services end to end, from design through launch and operation in production, and your work will ship to some of the largest AI compute customers in the world. Key job responsibilities Design, build, and operate distributed backend services that manage and share accelerated compute across multiple clusters and accounts. Build scheduling and capacity\-sharing capabilities that move compute to the highest\-priority workloads and reclaim it when priorities change. Build zero\-touch usage and guidance systems that collect, aggregate, and report how compute is consumed, at scale and in near real time. Own your services in production: define operational metrics, respond to issues, and continuously improve reliability, latency, and cost. Write clear design documents, participate in design and code reviews, and raise the engineering bar for the team. Collaborate with product, design, and partner engineering teams to turn customer problems into shipped features. Mentor other engineers and contribute to a culture of ownership, quality, and customer focus. A day in the life Most days start with a short team stand\-up, then it is mostly building. You might design a service that lets one cluster borrow idle capacity from another, then write it up for a design review where the team pokes holes in it before any code is written. Hard problems get their own deep\-dive whiteboard session. Other days lean toward operations, chasing down why a workload did not get the capacity it should have. You will not be handed fully specified tasks; you will have the independence to help decide what to build, then build it. About the team We help customers get the most out of the accelerated compute they pay for. Our mission is simple to say and hard to do: make sure every accelerator a customer pays for is doing useful work, and make that easy to see and control. jobs.description: **DESCRIPTION** --------------- Every day, millions of packages move through Amazon's transportation network — and this team is responsible for making sure they take the smartest, fastest, most cost\-effective path to the customer's door. Network Design Planning \& Engineering sits at the center of Amazon's North American transportation strategy. We plan how packages flow from fulfillment centers to final delivery destinations, balancing speed, cost, on\-time accuracy, and environmental impact. Our work directly shapes the delivery experience for hundreds of millions of customers. We're looking for a Supply Chain Manager I who is excited about turning complex data into clear, actionable insights. In this role, you'll build the network design plans along with the key metrics to drive improvements and detect opportunities that help our team and partners see what's happening across the network — aiding better decision making. You'll work alongside experienced engineers, scientists, and product managers who will support your growth while giving you real ownership of meaningful work from day one. Key job responsibilities * Partner with teammates across product, science, and engineering to understand what questions the business needs answered — then design and deliver the data solutions to answer them. * Build detailed network design recommendations along with maintaining interactive AI dashboards/visualizations that track how the transportation network is performing. * Conduct deep\-dive analyses into operational performance, uncover root causes of issues, and recommend improvements backed by data. * Proactively look for ways to make existing reports and dashboards faster, more accurate, and easier to use. * Analyze historical trends and key lessons learned from previous experiences to surface insights that support planning and forecasting decisions. jobs.title: Network Security Architect Lead - Principal
jobs.description: **Purpose and Impact:** Are you ready to apply your leadership to shape the Cyber, Security, \& Intel landscape? Amentum is seeking a Network Security Architect Lead, Principal to join our team of mission\-driven professionals at Fort Meade, MD. In this role, you will lead challenging, high\-visibility projects that directly impact the Nation’s defense and intelligence missions. Supporting DISA, Amentum’s Intel and Cyber Division is expanding a proven team of highly skilled engineers and architects to design, deploy, and sustain an innovative IT enterprise solution. As the Principal Network Security Architect, you will serve as the technical visionary and authority for this team, defining secure network boundaries, driving the implementation of zero\-trust architectures, and ensuring seamless security integration across complex enterprise environments. *Our team delivers secure, mission\-critical capabilities where system integrity and rapid deployment are paramount. We are seeking a Network Security Architect Lead, Principal who combines meticulous security engineering discipline with strategic technical foresight. In this role, you will lead efforts to establish and maintain highly secure, resilient network architectures in a rapidly evolving operational threat environment. Success requires the ability to navigate complex, cross\-functional technical dependencies independently while fostering collaborative engineering solutions across integrated teams. To excel, you must possess a proactive leadership mindset and the agility to rapidly master and govern the secure integration of next\-generation systems and services.* **Work Schedule:** 8 Hours per day, Monday thru Friday **Essential Responsibilities:** The duties and responsibilities of the Network Security Architect Lead, Principal include but are not limited to the following: * Serve as the principal technical authority and visionary for the secure design, engineering, and evolution of the enterprise IT network infrastructure. * Architect and engineer high\-performance, resilient network transport solutions leveraging enterprise Cisco routing and switching platforms across multi\-site environments. * Design, deploy, and govern robust perimeter and boundary defense systems utilizing Palo Alto Next\-Generation Firewalls (NGFW), including advanced threat prevention, SSL decryption, and security policy management. * Lead the security engineering efforts necessary to navigate the Risk Management Framework (RMF) Assessment \& Authorization (A\&A) process, ensuring all designs comply with DISA Security Technical Implementation Guides (STIGs) and secure an active Authority to Operate (ATO). * Define the architectural standards, blueprints, and TTPs for secure network integration, data flow segregation, and cross\-domain solutions. * Set the technical and daily priorities for the network security engineering team, providing advanced mentorship, design standards, and escalation support for complex network anomalies. * Translate complex, high\-level operational requirements and DISA security mandates into detailed technical specifications, low\-level network designs (LLD), and security architecture diagrams. * Organize and lead technical architecture reviews, change control assessments, and security posture briefings with senior program leadership and DISA technical authorities. * Collaborate with Systems Engineers, Cloud Architects, and Project Managers to design secure interfaces and schedule authorized service interruptions (ASIs) for critical network upgrades. * Conduct comprehensive vulnerability assessments and threat modeling on the network architecture, identifying potential exploit vectors and engineering robust mitigation solutions. * Establish baseline configurations and configuration control templates for all network and security hardware, ensuring strict alignment with configuration management policies. * Lead technical site surveys, evaluate infrastructure readiness, produce detailed Network Bills of Materials (BOMs), and assist in generating migration schedules for enterprise site deployments. **Work Environment, Physical Demands, and Mental Demands:** * Employee will work in a SCIF on a daily basis. * Employee may also be required to work in a datacenter environment for specified periods of time. **Minimum Requirements (Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities):** * Fifteen (15\) years of experience in network engineering, security architecture, or systems integration, with a primary focus on designing large\-scale enterprise secure networks. * Seven (7\) years of dedicated experience as a senior network security engineer, with at least three (3\) years serving as a principal architect or technical lead overseeing security engineering teams. * Bachelor’s degree in Network Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology (IT), Cybersecurity, or a related technical field (equivalent experience may be considered in lieu of a degree). * Extensive backgro safe and compliant work environment, Amentum is a drug\-free workplace and requires all personnel to comply with company drug and alcohol policies as a condition of employment. Employment is contingent upon successful completion of the drug screening process. Please note that this may include pre\-hire screening for marijuana, as well as other federally controlled substances due to Amentum’s role as a federal contractor and trusted partner to the US Government.*** **Other Responsibilities:** **Safety** \- Amentum enforces a safety culture whereby all employees have the responsibility for continuously developing and maintaining a safe work environment. As appropriate, each employee is responsible for completing all training requirements and fulfilling all self\-aid/buddy aid responsibilities, participating in emergency response tasks and serving on safety committees and teams. **Quality** \- Quality is the foundation for the management of our business and the keystone to our goal of customer satisfaction. It is our policy to consistently provide services that meet customer expectations. Accordingly, each employee must conform to the Amentum Quality Policy and carry out job activities in compliance with applicable Amentum Quality System documents and customer contracts. Each employee must read and understand his/her Quality Management and Customer Satisfaction responsibilities. **Procedure Compliance** \- Each employee must read, understand and implement the general and specific operational, safety, quality and environmental requirements of all plans, procedures and policies pertaining to his/her job. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. **Compensation Details:** $240,000 \- $310,000 The compensation range or hourly rate listed for this position is provided as a good\-faith estimate of what the company intends to offer for this role at the time this posting was issued. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as job responsibilities, education, experience, skills, internal equity, market data, applicable collective bargaining agreements, and relevant laws. **Benefits Overview:** Our health and welfare benefits are designed to support you and your priorities. Offerings include: * Health, dental, and vision insurance * Paid time off and holidays * Retirement benefits (including 401(k) matching) * Educational reimbursement * Parental leave * Employee stock purchase plan * Tax\-saving options * Disability and life insurance * Pet insurance *Note: Benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and applicable agreements. Positions governed by a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), the McNamara\-O'Hara Service Contract Act (SCA), or other employment contracts may include different provisions/benefits.* **Original Posting:** 10/26/2026 \- Until Filled Amentum anticipates this job requisition will remain open for at least three days, with a closing date no earlier than three days after the original posting. This timeline may change based on business needs. Amentum is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. jobs.title: Senior iOS Engineer
jobs.description: **About Andium** **Do you want to have global impact?** At Andium we help Oil \& Gas companies reshape the future, while working toward Net\-Zero emission goals. We are building technology that helps the world’s leading energy companies reach their environmental, social, and governance (ESG) goals through transformative innovation. Along that pathway, we have helped achieve 46% operations cost savings and 65% reduction in emissions. **How do we do it?** Unique in the marketplace, we are an Industrial Internet of Things, (IIoT), company that designs, builds, and implements integrated technologies to perform end\-to\-end methane gas monitoring and tracking, allowing our customers to maximize field resources to resolve situations real\-time. Our technologies combine on\-site multi\-dimensional video with a machine learning/AI\-based platform. Our designs are based on past and current performance and where the market is heading. We are financially strong with a clear path for growth. **If this sounds interesting, read on to learn what we are seeking in a Senior iOS Engineer.** **About the Role:** Andium is seeking a talented and experienced senior iOS Engineer to join our growing mobile team. As an engineer on our iOS team, you will play a critical role in designing, implementing, and maintaining high\-quality, scalable, and extensible features for the Andium iOS platform. You will work closely with our engineering and product teams to deliver innovative solutions that redefine how our clients interact with cutting\-edge emissions detection and monitoring technologies. This is a senior\-level role offering the opportunity to shape the future of our iOS application and directly contribute to the company’s mission of delivering impactful technology solutions. **Responsibilities** * Design, implement, stabilize, release, and maintain reliable, scalable, and extensible features for the iOS platform. * Ensure the performance, quality, and responsiveness of applications through rigorous testing and optimization. * Produce high\-quality, readable, and well\-documented code that adheres to industry best practices. * Collaborate with engineering and product stakeholders to define and prioritize new features. * Provide detailed work estimates and deliver features on time. * Utilize tools such as Git, JIRA, and design documents for effective communication and documentation. * Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines for iOS applications, ensuring smooth deployment processes. **Qualifications:** * 5\+ years of experience in iOS development at a senior level. * Proficiency in Swift, with a strong understanding of SwiftUI, UIKit, and concurrency within Swift. * Comfortable working with RESTful APIs to connect iOS applications to back\-end services. * In\-depth knowledge of Apple’s design principles, interface guidelines, and best practices. * Experience in writing Unit, Functional, and Integration/End\-to\-End tests. * Familiarity with continuous integration and deployment processes. * Strong understanding of Git and version control systems. * Demonstrated experience submitting multiple apps to the App Store and familiarity with the submission process. * Experience with CoreML, Objective\-C, Combine Framework, and Core Data is a plus. * Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS and cloud messaging APIs for push notifications is a plus. * Basic understanding of the Oil \& Gas industry, including knowledge of operators and production equipment (flare stacks, compressors, transfer pumps, etc.), is a plus. * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field preferred. **Why Join Us?** * Work with innovative technology in a fast\-growing sector and be part of a team shaping the future of emissions detection and monitoring solutions. * Engage in meaningful work with real\-world impact, from large multinationals to entrepreneurial operators. * Career growth opportunities in a collaborative and forward\-thinking environment. * Competitive compensation package, including quality benefits such as health, vision, dental coverage, and more. Generous vacation and sick leave, including paid parental leave. **Compensation Range:** $140,000\-$180,000 plus competitive equity package Consistent with Andium's values and applicable law, we provide the following information to promote pay transparency and equity. Actual offers will be based on the individual candidate. **The pay range for this role is:** 140,000 \- 180,000 USD per year(Remote (United States))

jobs.title: Research Scientist, Life Sciences (Computational Chemistry)
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the role** ------------------ Anthropic's Life Sciences team is building a research group focused on biological discoveries by combining AI with hands\-on biological research. We're seeking a research scientist who combines deep chemistry knowledge with machine learning expertise to join the team. Our goal is to speed up progress in the life sciences by an order of magnitude, and this role puts that mission into practice. You'll be a computational chemist who knows reactions, synthesis, and medicinal chemistry in depth and has hands\-on experience training and evaluating machine learning models. Above all, you'll build the reinforcement learning environments, datasets, and evaluations that teach Claude chemistry. Working alongside our bench chemists and AI researchers, you'll turn real chemistry problems and experimental data into training tasks and measure whether the models get better at them. This role is fully on\-site in the San Francisco Bay Area. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Design and build reinforcement learning environments for chemistry end to end, including We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead PCC inference routing. These systems send every inference request to the right compute across a global, multi\-region fleet, while keeping latency low, availability high and PCC's privacy guarantees intact. This is a technically grounded leadership role for someone who thrives at scale, can bring clarity to complex and fast\-changing environments, and is energized by building both systems and teams. You'll guide architectural direction, scale operational practices and develop the engineers and leaders who will shape how Apple delivers cloud inference. **Description** Routing LLM inference at Apple's scale takes systems that adapt to changing demand, available capacity and failures while keeping latency low and accelerator utilization high. As the fleet grows across regions and cells, routing must account for capacity and health across the whole fleet, not just a single site. PCC adds a basic architectural requirement: request content stays encrypted outside trusted compute nodes. You'll lead the design of routing and scheduling strategies within this privacy model. Together with inference and security teams, you'll evaluate techniques such as cache\-aware request placement and prefill/decode disaggregation. Your scope includes the inference AI gateway layer, where requests are authenticated, metered, prioritized and streamed back to clients, all without exposing request content. This work has broad reach. Every improvement to routing makes Siri AI and Apple Intelligence faster and more reliable, and makes better use of Apple's inference capacity. In your first year, you'll be expected to grow a high\-performing organization, set a clear technical roadmap, and measurably improve routing latency, availability and fleet jobs.title: Senior Manager, Evaluation, Services Special Projects
jobs.description: We are looking for a hands\-on Evaluation leader to build and lead a team of applied scientists and machine learning engineers who measure the quality of a new, multi\-year Apple initiative. You will join at the start as a key contributor to the evaluation function, working with other eval leaders to establish how the team knows the system is correct, relevant, and trustworthy before and after it ships. You will own specific components of the evaluation plan, including methods, datasets, and automated grading systems that turn product behavior into clear quality signals for engineering and executive leadership. **Description** You will lead a team that designs and runs evaluation for a conversational experience that understands what people ask for, finds and ranks the right results, and allows them to complete tasks. Quality in this product spans several layers: interpreting a request correctly, retrieving and ranking the right results, composing a grounded and accurate response, and executing actions correctly through integrations with external partners. You and your team will be key contributors to the overall evaluation plan for this service and will own the evaluation methods for the layers in your area. Within your components, you will set the technical direction for large language model (LLM) based autograders and rubrics, including rubric design, evaluation set development, validation, and calibration. You will pair these with logging and instrumentation and online experimentation, working alongside the other eval leaders who own different parts of the plan. You will build the roadmap for your components, translate the broader evaluation strategy into concrete methods and deliverables, and make sure your results turn into measurable quality gains and clear inputs to release decisions. This is a hands\-on role. You will review designs and experiments, stay close to the data, and mentor a team of scientists and engineers while you recruit and grow it. You will partner with engineering, applied machine learning, quality assurance, and program management teams, and you will present quality status, risks, and trade\-offs for your areas to senior leadership. The product, its architecture, and its quality bar are still taking shape, so you will operate with significant latitude and help shape what "good" and "shippable" mean as the work evolves. We're looking for someone with a proven track record in: Building automated grading systems that scale to large, frequently changing datasets and using them to drive improvements in models and product features. Defining metrics and evaluation sets that reflect real user behavior and predict real\-world quality. Turning evaluation findings into action by partnering with engineering and applied machine learning teams to diagnose failures and ship fixes. Contributing evaluation results to release processes as explicit quality gates. Growing senior individual contributors and technical leads from within a team, and recruiting strong talent in competitive hiring markets **Preferred Qualifications** MS or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent experience. Experience evaluating agentic or tool\-use systems that take real\-world actions, including multi\-turn behavior, planning, and task completion. Experience with relevance and ranking evaluation, including graded relevance judgments and ranking metrics. Experience with groundedness and factuality evaluation of generated responses. Experience with logging infrastructure and instrumentation for AI product quality measurement. Experience generating and validating synthetic evaluation data. Experience evaluating systems that integrate with third\-party partner APIs. Experience with privacy\-preserving evaluation practices. **Minimum Qualifications** 6\+ years of experience in machine learning, data science, or machine learning evaluation, including 3\+ years of direct people management of scientists or engineers. Track record of hiring, developing, and leading teams of applied scientists, data scientists, or machine learning engineers. Hands\-on experience building and deploying LLM\-based autograders and rubrics, including rubric design, evaluation set development, validation, and calibration. Experience evaluating conversational AI, search, recommendation, or ranking systems, using both offline metrics and online experimentation. Strong command of statistics and experimental design, including A/B testing and interpreting noisy metrics. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a track record of influencing engineers and senior leaders **Pay \& Benefits** This posting is not for a specific job opening and by submitting your resume you are expressing interest in being contacted about this type of role at Apple in the future.

jobs.title: Software Engineer - Generative UI, Input Experience
jobs.description: A generated interface is only as good as the pieces it's made from. Give a model the wrong pieces and it fails, producing something generic or broken. Give it the right ones and it can make something a designer would be proud of. Which layout decisions should a view make by itself? Which should be stated as intent? Which should never be exposed at all? An API that answers those questions well lets a model write a few lines and get something that feels native. The hard cases are the ones designers usually solve by hand: tight space, many sizes, content whose length and shape aren't known until it arrives. You'll build components that handle them without anyone drawing each one. With designers, you'll prototype quickly until something feels right, then turn it into a principled, well\-named API with a small surface. jobs.title: Technical Support Specialist
jobs.description: **About Assembly Software** Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose\-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it. When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned\-up industry. **Vision Statement** Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime. **Mission Statement** Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers. **Core Values*** We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency \+ feedback. * We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth \+ learning. * We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions \+ work respectfully with one another. * We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative \+ open\-minded. * We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer \+ our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service \+ add value. * We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching. * We Embrace Diversity \+ Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity. **The Opportunity** Being a Technical Support Specialist at Assembly Software is not a script\-reading job. Our AI agent already answers the routine how\-to questions, which means the conversations that reach you are the ones that need a person: a login that fails after a Windows update, an integration returning an error code, a configuration that worked last week and does not today. As a Technical Support Specialist on our Tier 1 team, you own those issues from first contact through resolution, and you decide when to bring in a subject matter expert. You will work across Neos, our cloud practice management platform, and our on\-premise products, Needles and TrialWorks, and you will build real depth in at least one specialty area along the way. **Why Now** We are rebuilding how support works. AI handles the repetitive questions, so the humans on the team spend their time on troubleshooting, judgment calls, and making sure a fix gets written down once and reused by the whole team and by the AI agent itself. If you have a year or more in technical support and want the harder tickets, this is the version of the role where that is the job. **What You'll Do** You will support customers by phone, email, and chat, including conversations handed off from our AI agent. You will troubleshoot software, Windows, network, login, and remote desktop issues with a methodical approach: reproduce it, isolate the variables, document what you tried. You will use AI tools such as Intercom Copilot to find answers before escalating, and when you do escalate, you will send a clean, documented handoff that Tier 2 and our Customer Support Engineers can act on without sending it back. After training, you will handle first\-line API requests, including access, key resets, and basic integration checks. You will document new solutions, flag gaps in our knowledge base and AI content, and join the on\-call rotation once trained. Over time, you will become the team's go\-to person in a specialty area, whether that is on\-premise installs, hosting, API, or a Neos feature area. **What You'll Bring** At least a year in technical support, help desk, or IT support, ideally helping business software customers. A troubleshooting habit that favors evidence over guessing, the ability to teach yourself new software from documentation, and the ability to explain technical things clearly to people who are not technical. Comfort using AI assistants in daily work, and the judgment to notice when they are wrong. Solid Windows and Microsoft Office skills, including the ability to work through common permissions and connectivity problems. Experience with Windows Server, Office 365, SQL Server, APIs, Intercom, RingCentral, or legal software is a plus, as is time spent in a law firm, especially a plaintiff or personal injury practice. If you’re the person who wants the tougher tickets and takes pride in solving them, we want to hear from you. **When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:** **1\. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?** Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe. **2\. What makes Assembly Software different?** Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000\+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact. **3\. What's the benefits package like?** Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to: * Medical, dental, and vision plans * Short and long term disability coverage * Supplemental insurance options * 401(k) * Flexible time off * Paid parental leave * An Employee Assistance Program We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it. *Assembly Software provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.description: **About BareBones WorkWear** BareBones WorkWear® has been family\-owned and operated since 1998, when founder Stu Nelson built the business from the ground up in Sacramento. What started as a trunk full of coveralls has grown into a 10\-location retail chain serving California’s hardest\-working people, and a growing e\-commerce operation that ships nationwide. We’re not a startup, and we’re not a big\-box chain. We know exactly who we are and where we’re going. Over the past several years we’ve partnered with outside consultants and development firms to build out our digital infrastructure: our website, inventory systems, POS integrations, and internal tooling. Those projects have moved us a long way forward. Now we’re at a point where we want one exceptional engineer in\-house: someone who can own the technical roadmap, work across the full stack, and bring the kind of initiative that outside contractors never quite can. **Job Summary** We’re open to either arrangement, and we mean that genuinely. The work ahead of us is substantial, but it’s also modular. Some of it is project\-based: rebuild the storefront, integrate the AI recommendation engine, wire up the data pipeline. Other parts are ongoing: maintain integrations, support the team, iterate on tooling. A full\-time engineer digs into all of it from day one. A part\-time engineer who’s the right fit, say, a senior developer with consulting commitments or someone intentionally working reduced hours, will take longer to get through the roadmap, and we’re at peace with that tradeoff if the quality and ownership are there. What we won’t do is hire a full\-time body just to fill a seat. If the best candidate available wants 10 hours a week, we’d rather have them than a mediocre full\-timer. Compensation and scope will be structured accordingly. **What You’ll Work On** * **AI and LLM integration**; building practical AI features into our customer experience and internal workflows: product recommendations, conversational search, automated inventory insights, and customer service tooling powered by modern LLM APIs * **Modern e\-commerce front end**; rebuilding and evolving our customer\-facing site on a React/Next.js stack; fast, clean, and built to scale * **Cloud infrastructure and DevOps**; owning our cloud environment (AWS or Azure), CI/CD pipelines, and deployment reliability across systems * **Data pipelines and analytics;** pulling together sales, inventory, and customer data into dashboards and reporting that actually drive decisions; building the pipelines that make that possible * **Systems integration**; connecting our POS, accounting (QuickBooks/Sage), supplier feeds, and online marketplace listings so data flows without people manually bridging the gaps * **Internal tooling;** whatever the ops, sales, and store teams need to do their jobs faster and with less friction **What We’re Looking For** * 5\+ years of professional software development experience * Genuine full\-stack range, comfortable moving between backend logic, frontend UI, data work, and infrastructure without needing a handoff at every boundary * Strong fundamentals in at least one modern language (Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or similar) * Hands\-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, etc.) and building AI\-powered features into production applications * Modern frontend experience: React, Next.js, or equivalent * Cloud platform experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP) including deployments, storage, and managed services * Solid SQL and relational database skills; experience with data pipelines or analytics tooling a plus * Comfort with Git, automated testing, and CI/CD workflows * The kind of communication skills that let you work directly with non\-technical owners and store staff, explaining tradeoffs clearly and setting expectations honestly Pay: $145,500\.00 \- $210,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid holidays * Paid time off * Vision insurance * Work from home Work Location: Remote
