scalability, security, reliability, and maintainability. * Establish operational processes, monitoring, observability, and support models for production of AI systems. * Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives for AI platforms and services. * Establish controls and processes for model evaluation, validation, monitoring, explainability, governance, and risk management. * Manage relationships with AI technology vendors, cloud providers, strategic partners, and key stakeholders. * Evaluate emerging AI technologies and recommend investments and innovation opportunities that align with organizational priorities and strategic objectives. * Ensure AI solutions are effectively integrated with enterprise applications, data platforms, and clinical workflows. * Provide leadership, coaching, performance management, and career development for managers, engineers, and technical staff. * Oversee the operation, performance, and reliability of Epic EHR backend systems and integration engines. * Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure AI adoption, effectiveness, reliability, operational efficiency, and return on investment (ROI). **Minimum Qualifications:** 1\. A bachelor's degree is required. 2\. 15\+ years related work experience required and 8 to 10 years supervisory/management experience required. 3\. jobs.description: **Company Description** **IMPORTANT:** **Applicants must complete this required** **Supplemental Questionnaire** **in addition to submitting an application.** **The questionnaire must be completed by the application deadline of** **Wednesday, October 28, 2026 (11:59 PM)****.** Please note:If you are coming across this announcement outside of the SF Careers website, you must apply directly on the SF Careers site. * **Application Opening:**Monday, October 26, 2026 * **Application Deadline: Wednesday, October 28, 2026 (11:59 PM)** *Apply immediately!* * **Salary Range**: $143,572 to $180,596 annually (click here to learn more) * **Appointment Type**: Permanent Exempt, *Full Time. This position is excluded by the Charter from the competitive civil service examination process and shall serve at the discretion of the appointment officer. The anticipated duration of this project position is up to thirty\-six (36\) months.* * **Work Location:** Incumbent will conduct the majority of work at the Department of Technology *(1 S Van Ness, Ave San Francisco, CA 94103\)*. However, there may be situations where the incumbent will be required to work at other sites throughout the City and County of San Francisco as necessary. * **Work Arrangement:** *This is a full\-time position.* The department supports a hybrid work schedule in compliance with City \& County of San Francisco policies on remote work. * ✅ **Required** **Supplemental Questionnaire** **due at the time of application to be considered for this position:** https://forms.cloud.microsoft/g/eeKX71Vt2r*(See "How to Apply" below for additional information.)* Are you ready to make an impact in one of the most innovative cities? The San Francisco Department of Technology (DT) is looking for passionate IT professionals to help shape the future of technology in San Francisco! As the centralized technology services provider for the City and County of San Francisco (CCSF), DT delivers critical infrastructure and services to over 33,000 employees—supporting public safety, municipal broadband, cybersecurity, cloud solutions, and more! With a $170M\+ annual budget and a team of 300\+ experts, DT is leading the charge in digital transformation. DT provides services through our core areas of IT Excellence: * IT Project Management Office * Enterprise Application Services * Cloud Center of Excellence * IT Operations and Support including the Service Desk and NOC * City Infrastructure including the Network, Telcom and Data Centers * Office of Cybersecurity including Cyber Defense, Identity Management and Disaster Recovery * Public Safety Systems and Municipal Broadband Fiber * SFGovTV Broadcasting Services * IT Finance and Administration Services * Emerging Technologies **Why Join Us?** Innovative \& impactful work at DT, you won’t just work on IT—you’ll power a city. Your expertise will directly impact the residents of San Francisco, from closing the digital divide to ensuring secure, efficient city operations. **Benefits of Working for CCSF**: In addition to challenging and rewarding work, the City provides a generous suite of benefits to its employees. * Competitive pay, benefits, and retirement options * Career growth opportunities through training, internal mobility, and subsidized education * Diverse work environment in a diverse city Join the team that’s shaping the future of technology in San Francisco. Apply today and be part of a dynamic, innovative, and mission\-driven ITteam! **Job Description** The Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) initiative for the City and County of San Francisco works to responsibly and equitably enhance public services and operational efficiency through strategic adoption and governance. The AI Support Engineer role, based in DT's Support Services Division, builds and validates the operational readiness model that will allow AI platforms to scale safely across departments, establishing the access, monitoring, and compliance standards required before these platforms can responsibly expand citywide, and producing a transition framework to be absorbed into permanent operations at project close. The position designs repeatable processes, tests them against real department pilots, and documents a framework that DT's permanent staff can operate going forward. This includes evaluating emerging local AI agents and desktop applications, such as Claude Cowork and comparable agentic tools, assessing their security implications in partnership with DT's cybersecurity team, and developing deployment methods before these tools are extended to departments. This also includes building cost models for these platforms, many of which are priced on consumption (per\-token or per\-usage) rather than traditional per\-seat licensing, for departments and DT leadership to have reliable budgetary expectations as usage scales. **Essential duties include, but are not limited to, the following:** * Readiness Model Design: Design access provisioning, license managem tion for this and future job opportunities with the City and County of San Francisco. **Additional Information** **Selection Procedures** The selection process will include evaluation of applications in relation to minimum requirements and assessment of candidates’ job\-related knowledge, skills and abilities. Depending on the number of applicants, the Department may establish and implement additional screening mechanisms to evaluate candidate qualifications. This typically includes an oral interview and/or a written or performance exercise. If this becomes necessary, only those applicants whose qualifications most closely meet the Department needs will be invited to continue in the selection process. Applicants meeting the minimum requirements are not guaranteed advancement in the selection process. **How to Apply** Applicants are encouraged to apply immediately as this recruitment will close on **October 28, 2026****(11:59 PM)****.** * Your application MUST include a resume. To upload, please attach using the "additional attachments" function. * **You MUST complete the Supplemental Questionnaire (see this link):**https://forms.cloud.microsoft/g/eeKX71Vt2r * You may contact Sean Sexton via email at sean.sexton@sfgov.org with questions regarding this opportunity. * Late or incomplete submissions will not be considered. Mailed, hand delivered or faxed documents/applications will not be accepted. For best practices on the application process, please visit Apply for Jobs in the City and County of San Francisco Best Practices Guide. Applicants may be contacted by email about this announcement and, therefore, it is their responsibility to ensure that their registered email address is accurate and kept up\-to\-date. Also, applicants must ensure that email from CCSF is not blocked on their computer by a spam filter. To prevent blocking, applicants should set up their email to accept CCSF mail from the following addresses @sfgov.org, @sfdpw.org, @sfport.com, @flysfo.com, @sfwater.org, @sfdph.org, @asianart.org, @sfmta.com, @sfpl.org, @dcyf.org, @first5sf.org, @famsf.org, @ccsf.edu, @smartalerts.info, and @smartrecruiters.com). Applicants will receive a confirmation email that their online application has been received in response to every announcement for which they file. Applicants should retain this confirmation email for their records. **Failure to receive this email means that the online application was not submitted or received.** **Additional Information Regarding Employment with the City and County of San Francisco:** * Information About the Hiring Process * Conviction History * Employee Benefits Overview * Equal Employment Opportunity * Disaster Service Worker * ADA Accommodation * Right to Work * Copies of Application Documents The Office of the City Administrator is committed to ensuring that the City's services are inclusive, efficient, equitable, and culturally competent for San Franciscans of all races, ethnic backgrounds, religions, and sexual orientations. This commitment requires comprehensive review and thorough analysis of existing practices and policies to remove barriers to real inclusion. We are also committed to ensuring that we have a safe, equitable, and inclusive workplace for individuals of all races. This includes creating opportunities for hiring, promotion, training, and development, for all employees, including but not limited to Black, Indigenous, and people of color (BIPOC). The City and County of San Francisco encourages women, minorities and persons with disabilities to apply. Applicants will be considered regardless of their sex, race, age, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition (associated with cancer, a history of cancer, or genetic characteristics), HIV/AIDS status, genetic information, marital status, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, military and veteran status, or other protected category under the law.

Manages the Bureau’s capital improvement plan, directing the planning, and record management of municipal sewer projects, and performs related duties as required. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES:*** Functions as the Department of Water Management’s lead planner for sewer system, coordinating the work of engineers and other professional staff performing planning, and record management functions. * Directs staff of engineers engaged in the design, planning and preparation of specifications and other construction documents for sewer main new construction or restoration work projects. * Directs record management, maintaining existing records, filing and maintains new records pertaining to sewer infrastructure and related projects. * Provides design review of projects and approves project documents including project scope and design criteria, engineering specifications, cost estimates, and construction time\-lines. * Confers with management in selecting, scheduling and prioritizing capital improvement projects based on funding resources, critical infrastructure needs, existing conditions of mains and related factors. * Provides technical expertise and makes recommendations to incorporate and implement green infrastructure improvements to better manage stormwater. * Evaluates requests for street vacations and proposed subdivision developments to determine and assess impact on the sewer system including expansion of system. * Directs planning activities with hydrologic and hydraulic engineering staff and identifies sewer projects that can resolve or ease flooding issues in various areas of the City. * Represents the Department of Water Management with state and local agencies on developing best practices for green initiatives and storm water management. * Directs the work of engineering staff conducting field studies to determine overall hydraulic performance of the water distribution system and ensure proper system operations. * Maintains and uses the department’s sewer distribution system hydraulic model to provide analysis of system operation needs, recommend proper sizing of sewer mains. * Uses GIS software to manage utility coordination, ensuring efficient coordination between agencies working in the public way to avoid scheduling conflicts and minimize digging and restoration of the public way. * Performs other related duties as required. *Additional duties may be required for this position.* **Location:** JWPP, 1000 E Ohio St**Days:**M\-F**Hours:**8am\-4pm **THIS POSITION IS EXEMPT FROM THE CAREER SERVICE** Candidates may request accommodation for a Civil Service examination by contacting the Office of Human Resources (OHR) at 215\-686\-2350 or by email at janine.labletta@phila.gov. Decisions will be made on a case\-by\-case basis using the required documentation that is submitted. Requests are to be made in a timely manner prior to the scheduled date of the Civil Service examination. Only an on\-line application will be accepted for this exam. Paper applications will not be accepted. Computers are available in the 3\-1\-1 Walk\-In Center located in Room 167 of City Hall (Weekdays from 9 AM to 5 PM) and at your local Philadelphia Free Library branch. For inquiries regarding City employment, contact the **Office of Human Resources** Monday through Friday between 8 AM and 4 PM by telephone at 215\-686\-0880 or by email at hrhelpdesk@phila.gov **Information concerning employment with the City of Philadelphia may be found at:** * work.phila.gov * https://www.phila.gov/departments/office\-of\-human\-resources/jobs/civil\-service\-faqs/ * www.facebook.com/PhilaOHR * www.twitter.com/PhilaOHR * www.youtube.com/@PhilaOHR * www.linkedin.com/showcase/philahr **General Definition** ---------------------- This is specialized civil engineering work supervising subordinate engineering or technical support staff in analyzing and maintaining traffic patterns and operations for an assigned district. Employees in this class are responsible for supervising the collection, analysis and validation of a wide range of traffic engineering data, remedying existing and potential traffic flow problems and providing direction to design engineers on traffic engineering projects. Work includes reviewing construction plans and specifications, performing engineering calculations and assessing field conditions to determine the need for modifications. Reviewing the work of lower\-level technical employees and private contractors for adherence to standards used in maintaining and repairing streets, traffic signals and signs is a significant aspect of the work. Work is performed under the direction of a higher\-level Traffic Engineer. **The analyst responsible for reviewing applications and additional documentation for this job opportunity is:** Hamid Bertal Senior Human Resources Analyst City of Philadelphia \- Office of Human Resources 1401 JFK Blvd., Room 1530 Philadelphia, PA 19102 Phone: 215\-686\-2382 Fax: 215\-686\-0861 Email: Hamid.Bertal@Phila.gov For all other inquiries please contact Customer Service at **215\-686\-0880** or email **hrhelpdesk@phila.gov** **Notes to Applicants and Projected Exam Information** ------------------------------------------------------ **ELIGIBLE LIST: OPEN\-COMPETITIVE** Only an Open\-Competitive eligible list will be established as a result of this examination. Permanent City employees will receive no promotional preference in this examination. Candidates who pass the exam and are placed on the civil service list will be retained on the list for a minimum of one year and a maximum of two years after the establishment of the Eligible List. **RESIDENCY REQUIREMENT** Philadelphia residency is not required to submit an application, however Applicants must have established bona fide residency in the Cit nts will be evaluated and scored based upon their training and experience credentials. Applicants will not be asked to appear to take a scheduled examination. Scores in the Training and Experience Evaluation will be based on documentation of education and experience provided by the candidate. To receive full credit for your education and experience, you should submit all relevant documentation including college transcripts, licenses, certifications, paid out of class documentation, etc. and provide a detailed description of your education, experience, and credentials. **IF An Oral exam IS HELD:** This examination will be scheduled for **December 3****, 2026**. jobs.title: Staff AI Engineer
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- Cobalt runs AI agents in production that test real customer applications. We're looking for a Staff AI Engineer who has built and operated production agent systems and can help us make them more reliable, secure and cost\-efficient. You'll set the technical direction for how we design, evaluate, ship and operate agents, and stay hands\-on building the foundations our teams use. You'll work across engineering, product, research and security, mentoring engineers and helping teams turn promising prototypes into dependable production systems. Your primary focus will be our agent platform and production practices. You'll also help engineering teams improve how they build software with AI coding agents. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Set technical direction for agent systems across teams, including orchestration, tool use, context and memory management, human oversight and failure recovery. * Design, build and operate shared foundations: evaluation frameworks, agent observability and tracing, execution controls, and model access with routing and failover where needed. * Establish evaluation practices that measure task completion, accuracy, false positives, security and cost per successful task. Work with domain experts to build representative test cases and turn production failures into regression tests. * Make agent workflows resilient to tool failures, timeouts, rate limits and partial execution, with clear limits on retries, runtime and spend. * Work with security and platform teams to build in scoped permissions, customer data isolation, audit trails and safe execution of tools and code. * Establish practical engineering standards: evals in CI, prompt and model versioning, regression testing for non\-deterministic systems, cost and latency budgets, and staged rollouts with rollback paths. * Lead model selection and cost optimization. Benchmark models against real workloads and make informed trade\-offs between quality, latency and cost. * Partner with teams on production readiness, incident investigation and improvements to agent reliability. * Help teams use AI coding agents effectively across planning, implementation, review and testing. Measure the impact on delivery speed and software quality. * Mentor engineers and technical leads through design reviews, pairing, internal talks and written guidance. Help teams adopt shared capabilities and improve them based on feedback. * Work with product, research and security leaders to turn business priorities into a technical roadmap with clear outcomes. **You Must Have** ----------------- * Significant software engineering experience, typically 8–10\+ years, with a track record of technical leadership across teams. * Hands\-on experience building and operating LLM\-based agents in production, with a clear understanding of their scale, constraints and business outcomes. * A track record of improving agent reliability: building evaluations, investigating non\-deterministic failures and improving success rates against measurable goals. * Strong knowledge of agent architectures, including tool use, orchestration, planning, context and memory management, and the judgment to know when simpler workflows are sufficient. * Experience running LLM workloads through managed cloud model platforms or direct provider APIs, including rate limits, failure handling and cost tracking. * Strong backend and distributed systems fundamentals, including APIs, asynchronous workflows, concurrency and fault tolerance. * Experience with production observability, incident investigation and safe rollout of system changes. * An understanding of security risks in agent systems, including prompt injection, unsafe tool execution and exposure of sensitive data. * Evidence of impact beyond your own code: shared platforms other teams adopted, standards that improved outcomes or engineers you helped grow. **Tools and Practices You've Likely Used** ------------------------------------------ We care more about your depth of experience and engineering judgment than experience with any specific tool. * **Agent orchestration:** Framework\-based or custom orchestration, tool calling and structured outputs. * **Tool integration:** Model Context Protocol (MCP), APIs and permission\-controlled tool execution. * **Evaluations:** Automated evaluation harnesses, domain\-specific test datasets and regression testing in CI. * **Observability:** Distributed tracing, structured logs and metrics for multi\-step agent workflows. * **Model access:** Managed cloud model platforms, direct provider APIs and multi\-provider gateways. **Nice To Have** ---------------- * Experience with GCP, Go or Kubernetes. * Experience building sandboxed environments for agents that execute untrusted code or interact with external systems. * Offensive security, application security or security tooling experience. * Experience introducing AI coding tools across engineering teams and measuring their impact. * Public writing, talks or open\-source contributions related to agent engineering. ### **Why You Should Join Us** * Grow in a passionate, rapidly expanding industry operating at the forefront of the Pentesting industry * Work directly with experienced senior leaders with ongoing mentorship opportunities * Earn competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan * Save for the future with a 401(k) program (US) or pension (EU) * Benefit from medical, dental, vision and life insurance (US) or statutory healthcare (EU) * Leverage stipends for: * Wellness * Work\-from\-home equipment \& wifi * Learning \& development * Make the most of our flexible, generous paid time off and paid parental leave ### **Pay Range jobs.description: As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI\-native platform. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you. **About the Role:** The Platform API team builds the cross\-platform APIs and abstractions that give the CrowdStrike Falcon sensor a consistent programming interface across Windows, Linux, and macOS. The team owns the foundational layer that separates feature development from OS\-specific implementation, including threading, file I/O, hashing, work queues, and memory management. Every engineering team that builds sensor capabilities depends on this layer, so its quality and correctness directly shape how quickly and safely CrowdStrike can deliver protection to customers. The team's scope is growing. A central focus is building a shared platform for on\-sensor machine learning inference runtime: a stable C API, backed by an isolated out\-of\-process service, that runs models on hardware\-accelerated backends on each platform. This runtime will make inference\-based threat detection as accessible to engineering teams as rules\-based detection is today, and it will enable CrowdStrike to bring the next generation of AI\-powered protection to hundreds of millions of endpoints. We are looking for a Senior Engineering Manager with deep systems expertise and strong organizational leadership to guide this team. You will own the technical roadmap, lead the inference runtime from early design through production delivery, make key decisions on API design and long\-term compatibility, and build the partnerships needed for broad adoption across the sensor organization. You will collaborate closely with Windows, Linux, and macOS engineering teams, platform infrastructure teams, and partners in product and program management. **What You're Stepping Into** The Platform API team is at an inflection point. As the Falcon sensor continues to grow in capability and reach, a unified, well\-tested platform abstraction layer has become essential to how CrowdStrike builds. Consolidating platform behavior across Windows, Linux, and macOS into a single consistent foundation will improve quality, performance, and delivery speed for every team that builds on the sensor. This is a multi\-year effort, and you will own its roadmap, its strategy, and its execution. At the same time, the team is building one of the most significant new capabilities in the sensor platform: an on\-sensor ML inference runtime designed from the ground up. The API design, execution model, and first production integrations are in active development now. Your leadership will shape how quickly CrowdStrike can deliver AI\-powered detections to hundreds of millions of endpoints, and how easily teams across the company can bring new models to the sensor. If you are energized by building, this is your opportunity to shape a team's identity, expand its scope, and earn broad organizational trust through technical excellence. Your work will be visible across the entire sensor organization, and you will lead a team whose platform the rest of the company relies on every day. **Location:** This role is hybrid, requiring 2x days per week on\-site at one of the posted locations. **What You'll Do:** **Technical leadership** * Set architectural direction for cross\-platform API components, including threading, file I/O, hashing, work queues, and memory management * Lead the architecture and delivery of the centralized platform for on\-sensor ML inference runtime, including C API design for ABI stability and cross\-language use, the out\-of\-process execution and sandboxing model, and backend selection and versioning policy across platforms * Make critical design decisions on what is implemented once GPU, NPU, and Apple Neural Engine (ANE), including hardware capability detection, backend selection, and graceful fallback to CPU * Familiarity with model execution frameworks such as ONNX Runtime, OpenVINO, or Core ML, including runtime versioning and static versus dynamic linking tradeoffs * Experience designing out\-of\-process inference pipelines, including sandboxed execution for resource commissioning, and controls system standardization. * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Automation Engineering, or a related technical jobs.title: Embedded Systems Engineer, Robotics
jobs.description: **ABOUT DEXMATE** Dexmate is building the foundation for physical AI — combining a new generation of robots with a universal Physical AI OS, making robots as easy to build and deploy as software. Today, robotics is fragmented, slow, and closed: most builders are forced to reinvent the same stack again and again, and most ideas never make it past the prototype stage. We exist to change that. Our mission is to democratize robotics by lowering the barrier to entry, delivering a plug\-and\-play platform for developers, researchers, and enterprises, and cultivating an open ecosystem that accelerates the evolution of physical AI. If you want to help shape the next layer of human capability — and believe the future of robotics should be built together, not in isolation — we'd love to build it with you. **THE ROLE** We're looking for an Embedded Systems Engineer to own the boundary where our robot's electronics meet its software. You will bring up and debug new PCBs, write the firmware and drivers that make every sensor, camera, actuator, and compute module talk to each other, and make sure data moves reliably across CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, GMSL, I2C, SPI, and Ethernet. This is a hands\-on, cross\-layer role. One day you're probing a board with a scope to find why a bus is dropping frames; the next you're writing a Linux driver for a camera serializer or tuning an EtherCAT network for deterministic timing. You'll work closely with electrical, firmware, controls, and robotics software engineers, and you'll often be the person who figures out whether a problem lives in hardware, firmware, or software. **RESPONSIBILITIES** * Bringing up, validating, and debugging new PCBs: reading schematics and layouts, measuring signals, and isolating hardware vs. software faults * Developing firmware for MCUs (bare\-metal and RTOS) and drivers for embedded Linux platforms (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson / Orin) * Writing and maintaining device drivers and communication stacks for CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, I2C, SPI, UART, and Ethernet * Integrating camera and sensor pipelines over GMSL (serializer/deserializer configuration, device trees, V4L2 drivers, timing and synchronization) * Bringing up and tuning EtherCAT and CAN networks across actuators, sensors, and power systems for deterministic, real\-time performance * Debugging signal\-integrity, power, timing, and bus\-level issues with oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers * Contributing firmware and software input during schematic and PCB design reviews to make boards easier to bring up, test, and debug * Building diagnostics, test fixtures, and automated hardware\-in\-the\-loop tests for boards and subsystems * Supporting manufacturing, end\-of\-line testing, and field troubleshooting as robots move from prototype to deployment * Documenting interfaces, bring\-up procedures, and debugging playbooks for the wider team **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** * 3\+ years of professional experience in embedded systems in robotics, automotive, industrial automation, or complex consumer electronics * Strong C and C\+\+ skills for firmware and driver development; working knowledge of Python for tooling and test automation * Hands\-on board bring\-up experience, including reading schematics, PCB layouts, datasheets, and timing diagrams * Driver\-level experience with several of: CAN/CAN FD, EtherCAT, I2C, SPI, UART, Ethernet * Experience with MCU firmware (ARM Cortex\-M, STM32, TI C2000, or similar) on bare\-metal or RTOS platforms * Comfort with embedded debugging and lab tools: JTAG/SWD debuggers, oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and protocol analyzers * Systematic debugging skills across the hardware, firmware, and software boundary * Strong communication skills and comfort working directly with electrical, mechanical, controls, and software engineers **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** * Experience with GMSL or other high\-speed camera links (e.g., MAX9295/MAX9296, FPD\-Link), MIPI CSI\-2, and V4L2 * Embedded Linux kernel and device\-driver development, device trees, and BSP bring\-up (NVIDIA Jetson / Orin a plus) * Experience integrating EtherCAT master or slave stacks (SOEM, IgH, or equivalent) * Familiarity with PCB design tools (Altium, KiCad) and the ability to propose schematic\-level fixes * Knowledge of signal integrity, power integrity, and EMC fundamentals * Experience with motor\-control, BMS, or power\-electronics systems * Experience with ROS 2 or other robotics middleware * Prior experience working in a vertically integrated robotics or hardware startup * Hands\-on use of AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Codex to accelerate implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation Compensation Range: $100K \- $300K

jobs.title: Sr. Data Scientist I - Rockerbox
jobs.description: **Who We Are** -------------- DV is the leader in digital performance solutions, helping our advertiser and agency partners Verify the quality of their digital campaigns, Optimise to improve performance and Prove that they’re achieving their business outcomes, through unbiased 3rd party data and analytics. DV’s mission is to be the definitive source of transparency and data\-driven insights into the quality and effectiveness of digital advertising for the world’s largest brands, agencies, publishers, and digital ad platforms. Since 2008, DV has helped hundreds of Fortune 500 companies gain the most from their media spend by delivering best\-in\-class solutions across the digital advertising ecosystem, helping to build a better industry. Learn more at www.doubleverify.com. Rockerbox with DoubleVerify empowers marketing executives to confidently make data\-driven decisions, helping brands such as Tula, Figs, and Burton with the strategic decision\-making that drives growth. To do so, Rockerbox offers a unique suite of product lines that centralize data and offer diversified measurement methodologies. The foundation of Rockerbox's solution is data centralization. Atop this foundation, the platform enables marketers to choose from a range of measurement methodologies, giving customers the flexibility to choose the most appropriate approach for their specific needs and questions. To learn more, visit https://doubleverify.com/products/advertisers/prove **About the role** As a Senior Data Scientist, you will take full ownership of statistical modeling, ensuring that marketers have precise actionable insights into campaign effectiveness. This role includes opportunities for exploring new statistical methodologies and applying existing methodologies (with potential refinements) to new datasets. If you enjoy a combination of data wrangling, optimizing statistical models, and working at the intersection of data science and product, this is the role for you. **Responsibilities** * Conduct exploratory data analysis, engineer features in order to build statistically sound models that are interpretable and aligning with domain knowledge * Adapt, optimize, and iterate on the current modelling packages, modifying open source packages to adapt our need * Stay up to date with the latest causal inference and experimental design techniques. * Translate complex business asks into rigorous mathematical problems and, conversely, use data\-driven storytelling to communicate mathematical results as clear, actionable business insights to external stakeholders * Provide code reviews and feedback on system/model design for team members * Work closely with product and engineering to integrate data science projects into the Rockerbox platform. **Requirements** * 5\+ years of industry experience with a BA or BSc in sciences or engineering or 2\+ years of industry experience with a MSc or PhD degree in sciences or engineering. * Strong knowledge of regression modelling, statistical testing and experimental design * Proficiency in scientific Python stack (NumPy, Pandas, Statsmodels, Matplotlib etc.) **Nice to Haves** * SQL for data wrangling * Applying Bayesian techniques to predictive modelling problems * Working with AWS cloud technologies * Experience using Probabilistic programming libraries, e.g. STAN, PyMC, numpyro * Familiarity with marketing analytics concepts such as campaign allocation, measurement or budget optimization. The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on a number of non\-discriminating factors, including qualifications for the role, level, skills, experience, location, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at DV. The estimated salary range for this role based on the qualifications set forth in the job description is between \[$115K \- $196k]. This role will also be eligible for bonus/commission (as applicable), equity, and benefits. The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description; however, we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be more or less experienced than this job description as posted. Please note, there may be in\-person interviews at one of our offices. Why You’ll Love Rockerbox: At Rockerbox, you’ll find a fast\-paced, results\-driven environment where your work has a direct impact on our growth and the success of our clients. Our iterative development process means you’ll see your contributions come to life quickly. You’ll join a supportive, light\-hearted team that values collaboration and innovation. We are committed to professional growth and will actively support your development in both technical and business domains.

jobs.title: Operations Project Manager
jobs.description: *Full\-time, onsite \| Houston, Texas \| Reports to the Director of Operations \| Regular travel to Switzerland and to manufacturing and customer sites* **About EH Energy** ------------------- EH Energy is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform delivering onsite power to data centers, defense and industry, and mobile power to the aviation and maritime sectors. Our fuel\-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems run on natural gas, biogas or hydrogen, with options for integrated carbon capture and heat recovery. This role drives the schedule rather than reporting on it. It is a build\-it role for someone who has already brought order to a fast\-moving, under\-structured environment once, and wants to do it again with more ownership. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Own the integrated master schedule across all active projects in one place, with the cross\-project dependency map and the critical path through them * Drive the schedule: set and defend milestone dates, push owners to commit, and escalate early when a date is at risk rather than reporting the miss afterward * Force trade\-offs in advance when projects compete for the same resources, parts or weeks, and build the capacity plan that shows where we are over\-committed before we commit further * Keep small slips from compounding: when one date moves, know the same day what else moves with it and who needs to hear about it * Establish and run the operating cadence (planning, weekly execution reviews and monthly portfolio reviews) and support the reporting that goes to leadership and the Board * Run risk, issue and change management, track decisions to closure, and chase down blockers so things move between the meetings * Define the minimum standards every project follows (scope, schedule, milestones, risks, actions, issues, decisions and status), light enough that teams use them without being told twice * Lead the stand\-up of our project management platform: evaluate the options, make a recommendation, implement it, and own the migration from spreadsheets and status decks to a single source of truth, in\-line with best\-in\-class tools * Own the configuration, administration and data quality of the platform, and keep improving it as the portfolio grows from 20 projects to 60\+ * Build the reporting and dashboards so status is generated rather than assembled by hand, and anyone can see where a project stands without having to ask * Run one portfolio across Switzerland and the United States, with the same schedule, definitions and view of status on both sides, working across time zones without losing days to them * Manage the handoffs between Swiss engineering and US manufacturing and operations, where most of our dependencies and most of our risk live * Partner with project and functional owners across engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, customer deployment and finance so the process serves them rather than taxes them * Give the CEO, CTO and COO a clear portfolio view of what is on track, what is at risk and what needs a decision, and shape how the function scales, including the first hire on your team **Skills and Experience Required** ---------------------------------- * Roughly 4 to 7 years of experience in project, program or PMO roles, with meaningful time at an early\-stage or high\-growth company, ideally in energy, hardware, manufacturing or another capital\-intensive environment * A track record of driving schedules (e.g. comfortable telling a senior engineer that their date does not work with the credibility and the data to drive progress) * Direct experience bringing structure to an organization that did not have it: standing up a PMO, a portfolio process or a project management platform, including what you built, what you deliberately left out and how you got people to adopt it * Hands\-on depth in a modern project management platform (for example Jira, Smartsheet, Asana, Monday or Planview), including configuration and administration, not only use * Comfort managing dependencies across many concurrent projects, and the judgment to know which need escalation * Experience working across sites, countries and time zones, with the discipline that makes distributed work move rather than stall * An engineering or technical background * Strong influence without authority: the process only works if project owners choose to use it * A bias to action and a pragmatic view of process: enough structure to make the chaos legible, not so much that it slows the company down * Excellent written and verbal communication in English, and the ability to work independently in a lean, global team * Willing to be based onsite in Houston and to travel regularly, including to Switzerland * Must have existing authorization to work in the United States **Desirable** ------------- * Experience taking a manufacturing organization through the transition from prototype to volume production * Experience incorporating AI into project management to enable organization\-level speed * Exposure to advanced manufacturing, data centers, large\-scale customer deployments, construction jobs.title: Senior Solutions Engineer
jobs.description: *Full\-time, onsite \| Houston, Texas \| Travel to customer sites, partners and our Swiss HQ* **About EH Energy** ------------------- EH Energy is a rapidly growing fuel cell power platform that provides onsite power solutions to data centers, defense and industry, and mobile power solutions to the aviation and maritime sectors. We offer fuel\-agnostic proton exchange membrane (PEM) systems running on natural gas, biogas or hydrogen, with options for integrated carbon capture and heat recovery. Following a recently announced major investment round, EHG is expanding from its founding in Switzerland into the US, fueled by a GW\-scale, late\-stage pipeline of US data center customers. **About the role** ------------------ We are hiring a Senior Solutions Engineer to be our technical and site design expert in front of data center customers and partners. Three things sit in the job: site planning, technical design and technical proposal writing. Near enough every data center developer we meet wants what we have. What they want from us is a proposal, a technical design their engineers can put through diligence, and proof that the project is bankable. Nobody owns producing those today. That is the seat we are creating, and you will build the system that makes it repeatable. These deals are multi\-party and deeply technical: the customer, their EPC, the gas supplier, their financing partners and sometimes the utility. Our scope has to integrate into the customer's whole site plan. You will be the person who makes that fit, on paper and in the room. This is the first hire in a function we expect to grow. You will set the templates, the design standards and the proposal library that everyone after you uses, and you will help us work out how the function should scale. The role is based in Houston, Texas, alongside our US operations hub and manufacturing site, with travel to customer sites, to partners and to our Swiss HQ. **What you will own** --------------------- **Site planning** * Work with the customer and their EPC on where our systems go: layout, footprint, clearances, electrical and gas interconnection points, hydrogen and reformer siting, and constructability. * Integrate our scope into the customer's overall site plan alongside the other parties on the project. * Surface the site\-specific constraints that change the design or the price early, before they become a late surprise in diligence. * Build reference layouts for common data center configurations so every new opportunity starts from a template. **Technical design** * Supervise and own the CAD models and technical drawings for each opportunity: system arrangement, reformer integration, balance of plant and interfaces. * Map the customer's technical specifications onto our technology and our reformers, and produce the compliance view: what we meet, what we meet differently, and what needs a deviation. * Size and configure systems against the customer's load profile, redundancy requirements and availability targets. * Own the technical interfaces: electrical tie\-in, cooling and heat recovery, controls and monitoring, and the gas and hydrogen side alongside our VP of Fuel. * Bring customer requirements and recurring design constraints back into our product roadmap with our engineering team in Switzerland. **Technical proposal writing** * Write the technical proposals. This is a named part of the job: clear, well\-structured technical writing that a customer's engineering team, their EPC and their financing partners can all read. * Own responses to RFPs, RFIs and technical questionnaires, and the technical sections of term sheets and contracts. * Carry the customer's technical due diligence: assemble the package, answer the questions, manage the follow\-ups. * Build the proposal library and content system so the second proposal is faster than the first. * Supply the technical inputs behind customer financial models: performance assumptions, capex and opex build\-up, availability and degradation. These deals are unusually finance\-heavy, and the customer's CFO is often our primary stakeholder. **What success looks like in the first 12 months** -------------------------------------------------- *Illustrative milestones, to be confirmed together.* * Proposal and design production has a clear owner: you. * A working system in place: templates, reference layouts, a technical content library, and a compliance matrix approach that shortens every cycle. * Named contribution to deals moving from qualified pipeline to signed order, with a measurable drop in time from customer request to delivered proposal. * You are running technical due diligence sessions with customers on your own. * A clear view on how this function scales, including your first hires. **What we are looking for** --------------------------- **Must\-have** * An engineering degree (mechanical, electrical, chemical or civil) and 8\+ years of engineering practice. This is a role for an engineer, and we are firm on it. * Strong hands\-on CAD skills. You produce drawings yourself, in current tools, and you can walk us through recent work. * Data center or industrial power design and development experience. You understand what a data center needs from its power and how a large power project gets built. * A customer\-facing track record. You have been the technical person in the room with a paying customer, rather than an internal design engineer. * Strong technical writing. You have written technical proposals, RFP responses or design basis documents for an external audience. * Comfort coordinating across multiple external parties: customer, EPC, utility or gas supplier, and financing advisors. * Comfort being the first person in a function, working from a blank page, in a lean company. * Houston\-based, or willing to relocate to Houston. * Existing authorization to work in the United States. **Strongly preferred** * EPC background. It is the single most useful thing on a CV for this role: design, constructability and multi\-party coordination in one person. * Project development experience, so a customer's development view is familiar from the inside. * Distributed generation, gas engine, turbine, fuel cell or onsite power experience. * Direct data center exposure, hyperscale or colocation, and familiarity with how these buyers run technical diligence. * Applications engineering, solutions engineering or technical sales experience in a complex, long\-cycle capital sale. * Comfort with the financial layer: you have fed technical inputs into project financial models and you understand what makes a project bankable. **What we offer** ----------------- * Competitive compensation with meaningful equity. * Relocation support to Houston, Texas, if needed. * The first seat in a function that will grow. You will set the standards rather than inherit them, at the exact point where our pipeline turns into signed orders. **How to apply** ---------------- Apply with your CV and a short upload: a writing sample (a technical proposal, RFP response or design basis document you wrote for an external reader). Redact client names and commercial terms; we do not need anything confidential. Please have both ready before you start the application. Only candidates selected for interview will be contacted. *EH Energy is an equal opportunity employer. We value a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*

jobs.title: DevSecOps Lead
jobs.description: ##### ***Electrosoft Services, LLC is an award\-winning company that provides comprehensive technology\-based solutions and services to federal customers. While cybersecurity is our specialty, we also focus on ICAM, Zero Trust, digital engineering and transformation, and enterprise AI and intelligent automation. We always seek to delight our customers, so we retain highly qualified employees and offer them meaningful work, growth opportunities, and work\-life balance. What sets us apart from all other contractors is the sense of*** ***teamwork*** ***our employees feel – and the knowledge that outstanding effort is recognized and rewarded. The camaraderie we share emanates from Lunch \& Learn sessions where we explore new ideas together, fun group activities ranging from escape rooms to miniature golf, and much, much more. If we've described you and your dream workplace, please apply and share in the many benefits and opportunities we offer.*** **DevSecOps Lead** Position Summary Leads the PIEE DevSecOps and cloud\-delivery capability, including CI/CD, AWS GovCloud, infrastructure as code, containers, automated quality and security controls, observability, configuration, release automation, and deployment reliability. Key Responsibilities * Define and govern the DevSecOps, cloud, CI/CD, infrastructure\-as\-code, container, and automated delivery strategy. * Own pipeline architecture, deployment controls, artifact flow, environment promotion, release automation, rollback readiness, and operational monitoring. * Integrate automated testing, security scanning, compliance evidence, configuration management, and approval gates into the delivery toolchain. * Coordinate developers, testers, cybersecurity, cloud/SRE, configuration management, and release stakeholders. * Lead modernization of build and deployment practices and support transition from monolithic components to secure microservices where approved. * Measure pipeline performance, deployment frequency, lead time, change failure, availability, recovery, and automation effectiveness. * Maintain cloud and pipeline technical documentation, standards, runbooks, and continuous\-improvement backlog. Required Qualifications * At least five years of relevant DevOps experience. * Undergraduate degree. * Experience with large\-scale Scrum/Agile delivery, DevOps, test\-driven development, on\-premises and cloud deployments, IaaS, configuration\-management tools, and containers. * Current cloud service provider certification, such as AWS DevOps Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, or equivalent accepted by the task order. * Ability to obtain and maintain IT\-II / Tier 3 eligibility, as required. Preferred Qualifications * DLA, PIEE, or DoD enterprise DevSecOps leadership experience. * Hands\-on AWS GovCloud, CI/CD, Terraform or comparable infrastructure as code, Kubernetes or container orchestration, observability, artifact management, and security automation. * Advanced AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, or recognized DevSecOps certification. Experience operating a software factory under RMF/cATO and performance\-based service expectations. #### ***Electrosoft is an Equal Opportunity Employer/Veterans/Disabled***

jobs.title: Sr. Principal Engineer - Automation Engineering – Biologics - Lilly Medicine Foundry
jobs.description: At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life\-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us. At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees around the world work to discover and bring life\-changing medicines to those who need them, improve the understanding and management of disease, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We give our best effort to our work, and we put people first. We’re looking for people who are determined to make life better for people around the world. Organization and Position Overview Lilly recently announced a $4\.5 billion investment to create the Lilly Medicine Foundry, a new center for advanced manufacturing and drug development. The first\-ever facility of its kind, combining research and manufacturing in a single location, the Medicine Foundry will allow Lilly to further develop innovative solutions to optimize manufacturing processes and increase capacity for clinical trial medicines, while also reducing costs and environmental impact. The Sr. Principal Engineer \- Automation Engineering will work as a member of the Automation Engineering Department at Eli Lilly, Foundry. The Sr. Principal engineer will provide automation support for one or more biologics operating areas across site (such as cell culture, purification, and buffer/media preparation) and/or for capital projects. Process Automation is core to delivering a right first time facility start up and continued support of ongoing manufacturing operations into the future. The Sr. Principal Engineer is also responsible for the productivity and mentorship of the employees with the purpose of ensuring that reliable and compliant\-controlled applications and systems are used in the manufacturing at Foundry. Additionally, the Sr. Principal Engineer, as a key technical expert partners to influence and implement within the process control organization and across functional disciplines to support the process control technical agenda, business plan priorities, and compliance objectives. In the project delivery phase and startup phase of the project (startup expected 2025 to 2028\), automation engineering roles will be fluid and dynamic as we endeavor to support the project delivery, build a new organization, develop and implement the necessary systems and business processes required to support GMP operations, and build the site culture. This will require significant collaboration, creativity and resilience as the site grows to a full scale GMP manufacturing through start up. We're interested in what you've actually built, who's using it, and the impact it's delivered. You'll work directly with **Ryan Cohen and the GameStop team** to improve how the business operates. **What You'll Do** * Identify opportunities to increase revenue, reduce costs, improve inventory decisions, save time, and better serve customers. * Prioritize problems based on business impact and the effort required to solve them. * Build and deploy AI agents, applications, and automated workflows. * Connect AI to business systems, databases, documents, and operational processes. * Work directly with the people using your solutions and continuously improve them based on real\-world results. * Measure accuracy, reliability, operating costs, adoption, and financial impact. **What We're Looking For** **Strong Business Judgment** * Understand how companies make money, where resources are wasted, and which problems deserve attention. * Focus on measurable business outcomes rather than technology for its own sake. **Hands\-On Technical Ability** * Build solutions personally, from initial concept through production deployment. * Combine AI models, code, APIs, data, and automation tools to solve real business problems. **Demonstrated Results** * Have a track record of applying AI to meaningful business challenges. * Can show working systems, real\-world adoption, and measurable outcomes. **Ownership and Urgency** * Operate independently with a strong bias for action. * Move quickly, overcome obstacles, and take responsibility for results. * Remain accountable for your solutions after deployment. **Clear Communication** * Explain complex technical solutions in straightforward business terms. * Demonstrate what you built, why it matters, and how you know it works. **How to Apply** **Applications must include proof of work.** Submit your resume or professional profile along with **one or two examples of significant problems you've solved using AI.** For each example, include: * **The Problem:** What was happening, who was affected, and why it mattered. * **Your Solution:** What you built and how AI contributed. * **Your Contribution:** What you personally designed, implemented, integrated, and operated. * **The Results:** Before\-and\-after measurements, timeframe, scale, and costs. At least one example must demonstrate a solution deployed and used in an actual business environment. Redacted examples and confidential interview walkthroughs are welcome. Please do not share proprietary information without permission. **What to Expect** Be prepared to demonstrate your work and explain the technical decisions, tradeoffs, failures, and improvements behind it. We're looking for **builders who deliver measurable business results**, not people who simply understand AI concepts. **Location** Remote candidates will be considered, with some time required in Dallas, Texas. jobs.description: Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **New York, NY, USA; Chicago, IL, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. * 6 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer\-facing or support role. * Experience with cloud engineering, on\-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms. * Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders. * Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security. * Experience driving the entire business\-cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution). * Experience building long\-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers. * Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms. * Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, penetration testing). **About the job** ----------------- The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. jobs.title: Data Center Technical Program Manager, Infrastructure Delivery
jobs.description: ### **Minimum qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * 1 year of experience in program management. ### **Preferred qualifications:** * Background in network, electrical, industrial, or mechanical engineering, with strong knowledge of data networking architectures and physical components. * Operational experience in large\-scale data centers and co\-location facilities, including third\-party colocation environments. * Experience operating within complex organizational settings, such as PMOs and geographically dispersed teams. * Familiarity with global supply chain and logistics concepts. * Excellent analytical, quantitative, and presentation skills. **About the job** ----------------- A problem isn’t truly solved until it’s solved for all. That’s why Googlers build products that help create opportunities for everyone, whether down the street or across the globe. As a Technical Program Manager at Google, you’ll use your technical expertise to lead complex, multi\-disciplinary projects from start to finish. You’ll work with stakeholders to plan requirements, identify risks, manage project schedules, and communicate clearly with cross\-functional partners across the company. You're equally comfortable explaining your team's analyses and recommendations to executives as you are discussing the technical tradeoffs in product development with engineers. As a Data Center Infrastructure Delivery (DID) Technical Program Manager, you will be responsible for overseeing major deployment programs while working with partner groups to create and achieve strategic business goals. Your objective will be to organize the overall team, establish clear roles and responsibilities, and global management of capacity deliverables, plan of records and schedules across the global network delivery organization to meet Google’s needs. This role requires the individual to successfully bring together all the elements necessary to put a project plan together, manage objectives, and influence without authority, all while maintaining schedule velocity. Both project and technical leadership is woven into every facet of this role. Successful individuals in this role have technical backgrounds with an engineering mindset, while being expert communicators and leaders. They are comfortable with ambiguity, yet strive to increase maturity in process and technology. They are evangelical about improving program efficiency and finding ways to scale the team of Program Managers (PMs) they work with. Behind everything our users see online is the architecture built by the Technical Infrastructure team to keep it running. From developing and maintaining our data centers to building the next generation of Google platforms, we make Google's product portfolio possible. We're proud to be our engineers' engineers and love voiding warranties by taking things apart so we can rebuild them. We keep our networks up and running, ensuring our users have the best and fastest experience possible. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $116000 \- $165000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Manage global capacity deliverables, schedules, and plans of record for data center turnups, ensuring all dependent projects are initiated on time to support critical downstream dependencies. * Collaborate closely with vital partners, including GSO, GGI, and PIE, to align project priorities, secure necessary resources, and flawlessly manage logistics such as material storage and delivery. * Engage with partner teams early and often to understand design constraints and forecasting mechanisms, effectively managing dependencies and communicating continuously to drive ongoing business process improvements. * Contribute to business reviews by providing comprehensive global deployment updates and health reports that highlight key wins, potential risks, upcoming capacity demands, patterns, and documented lessons learned. * Create and implement robust escalation processes while driving rigorous root cause corrective actions to prevent recurring issues, alleviate capacity constraints, and proactively improve our overall global deployment times. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day. In this role, you will work cross\-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development. One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world\-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users. As the Product Manager (PM) for GVP and Walled Gardens, you will shape and execute the strategy for two of Display Network’s most strategically vital and high\-growth investment areas: Google Video Partners (GVP) and Walled Garden publisher partnerships. In this role, you will lead the evolution of GVP Brand by bridging core YouTube brand demand (video reach campaigns, video view campaigns, and YouTube shorts) with third\-party publisher inventory. Simultaneously, you will drive technical and product integrations with major Walled Garden publishers, unlocking novel first\-party signal pipelines, bespoke ad formats, and state\-of\-the\-art bidding optimizations. This is a high visibility role with direct line of sight to net\-incremental business impact. You will collaborate closely with engineering, UX, legal, privacy, and sales teams across both Buyside and Sellside as well as YouTube. Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting\-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi\-billion dollar global business. Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return\-on\-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state\-of\-the\-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology. Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. US: $138000 \- $197000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities** -------------------- * Define and execute the short\-, medium\-, and long\-term product goals for Google Video Partners (GVP) and Walled Garden publisher integrations. * Architect the signal integration and bidding optimization roadmap for Walled Gardens, collaborating with sell\-side and external publisher engineering teams. * Partner with Global Business Organization (GBO), Sales, and Go\-to\-Market (GTM) teams to design global commercialization pilots to accelerate GVP Brand adoption. * Deliver privacy\-centric measurement capabilities for third\-party video to provide advertisers with proof of incremental reach and business impact. * Establish brand safety guardrails, third\-party verification integrations, and inventory filtering models to ensure premium brand\-safe placements. We're more interested in finding a talented engineer who understands complex network environments, takes pride in their work, and enjoys being part of a collaborative team. **What You'll Be Doing** ------------------------ As a Network Engineer III, you'll serve as a senior technical resource responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, securing, and improving complex network environments. You'll work closely with other JMARK engineers, technical teams, and client stakeholders to ensure network infrastructure is performing at its best. **Your responsibilities will include:** * **Network Infrastructure Management:** Configure, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize enterprise network environments, including switches, routers, firewalls, VPNs, and other critical networking technologies. Switching:** Configure and troubleshoot advanced networking technologies, including VLANs, spanning tree, routing protocols, and network segmentation. * **Proactive Network Management:** Monitor network health, identify potential issues before they become major problems, and recommend improvements to strengthen performance, security, and availability. * **Project Implementation:** Participate in network infrastructure projects, including upgrades, deployments, migrations, and technology improvements from planning through implementation. * **Documentation and Collaboration:** Maintain technical challenges into practical solutions that support business operations. * **Critical Systems Support:** Assist with resolving high\-priority incidents and participate in an assigned on\-call rotation to support business\-critical systems. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- We're looking for someone who brings strong technical expertise, excellent troubleshooting abilities, and a proactive approach to managing network infrastructure. **Technical Skills and Experience:** * Approximately 3–5 years or more of relevant network engineering experience, or demonstrated equivalent technical expertise. * Advanced knowledge of enterprise networking technologies, including LAN, WAN, routing, switching, and network security. * Strong experience configuring and troubleshooting Cisco networking equipment or comparable enterprise networking technologies. * Experience with routing protocols such as OSPF, BGP, and EIGRP. * Advanced understanding of VLANs, STP, network segmentation, TCP/IP, subnetting, and IPv4/IPv6\. * Experience implementing, administering, and troubleshooting firewalls, VPNs, and secure network connectivity. * Familiarity with Cisco ASA, Fortinet, or similar enterprise firewall platforms. * Experience utilizing network monitoring and troubleshooting tools such as Wireshark, SSH, and other network management platforms. * Understanding of network security principles, access controls, intrusion prevention, and vulnerability mitigation. * Experience troubleshooting complex network issues in environments where uptime and reliability are critical. * Ability to document network configurations, technical solutions, and troubleshooting activities clearly and accurately. **Experience That Would Be a Plus:** * Previous experience supporting banking, financial services, or other highly regulated industries. * Experience supporting large, multisite enterprise networks. * Familiarity with Cisco Firepower, FMC/FTD, or other next\-generation firewall technologies. * Experience working within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) environment. * Knowledge of network redundancy, disaster recovery, and business continuity planning. * Cisco certifications such as CCNA or CCNP, or equivalent industry certifications. * Experience working with network monitoring, security logging, or intrusion prevention technologies. **Beyond the Technical Skills** ------------------------------- At JMARK, technical ability is important, but how you approach your work and interact with others matters just as much. **The ideal candidate will:** * Be a natural problem solver who enjoys digging into challenging technical issues. * Take ownership of problems and follow through until they're resolved. * Communicate effectively with both technical and nontechnical audiences. * Understand the importance of security, reliability, and attention to detail. * Work independently while recognizing the value of teamwork and collaboration. * Be proactive in identifying opportunities to improve systems and processes. * Enjoy learning new technologies and continually expanding their technical expertise. * Take pride in delivering an exceptional client experience. **The pay range for this role is:** 80,000 \- 115,000 USD per year(Tulsa Office)

jobs.title: Experienced Mozaik Cabinet Drafter
jobs.description: **KERFSIDE CUSTOM CABINETS** **Experienced Mozaik Cabinet Drafter** *Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| Richland Hills, TX* At Kerfside Custom Cabinets, we build dream kitchens and beyond for our homeowner, interior designer, and luxury GC clientele. Our team does it all — DESIGN \> BUILD \> FINISH \> INSTALL — and we are looking for a passionate and experienced Mozaik drafter to join us! Kerfside is a local family owned and operated luxury custom cabinet shop in Richland Hills, Texas, specializing in bespoke kitchens, home offices, entertainment centers, closets, and whole\-home cabinetry and millwork throughout DFW. If you are ready to take on a new challenge and you love bringing a client’s dream design to life, we want to talk to you! **What You’ll Do** * Partner with clients and our sales team to translate creative vision and functional needs into bespoke cabinetry — balancing beauty, function, and buildability from first sketch to final install. * Perform final site measurements and comprehensive field documentation — capturing existing conditions, obstructions, and installation details that drive design accuracy and a successful install. * Draft custom cabinetry designs in Mozaik from architectural plans, field measurements, and design intent. * Prepare final client approval drawings and secure written sign\-off before releasing projects to production. * Prepare accurate shop drawings, cut lists, hardware schedules, and material optimization for each project. * Specify and coordinate the purchasing of project\-specific materials and specialty hardware — partnering with vendors to ensure the right components arrive on schedule for each build. * Generate production\-ready CNC files and coordinate with the production team on tooling, cut sequences, and setup. * Reverse\-engineer complex challenges before they become problems. * Review measurements and specifications before production to catch issues early and reduce rework. * Serve as the technical interface between design intent, production reality, and on\-site installation. * Help build and lead the drafting department — mentoring new drafters, establishing standards, and shaping the team as the company grows. **What We’re Looking For** ***Required:*** * 3\+ years of hands\-on Mozaik drafting experience in a production cabinet shop environment. * Strong CNC knowledge and hands\-on experience with tooling, cut sequences, and nesting optimization. * Strong IT and computer skills — comfortable with Windows, file management, backups, and troubleshooting routine software and hardware issues on your own. * Comfortable conducting client, designer, and vendor meetings over Zoom and other video conferencing platforms (Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, etc.). * Strong understanding of luxury residential custom cabinetry — from shop fabrication through on\-site installation — with the ability to reverse\-engineer designs for installation success. * Detail\-oriented, organized, and able to self\-manage a project queue shop (not production tract work). * Experience with hardwood millwork, complex hardware (pocket doors, sliding systems, specialty hinges), and finished\-face details. * Familiarity with industry\-standard CAD tools in addition to Mozaik. * V\-carve experience. * SketchUp experience. **Compensation \& Benefits** * **Annual salary: $72,800** (W\-2, salaried exempt), paid on a regular bi\-weekly cycle. * **Schedule:** Full\-time, 40 hours per week minimum, Monday–Friday 7:00 AM – 3:30 PM. * **Paid holidays (8\):** New Year’s Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day, Black Friday, Christmas Eve, and Christmas Day. * **Paid year\-end closure:** The office is closed from Christmas Eve through New Year’s Day — a full paid week. * **Paid Time Off:** One (1\) week of PTO per year, in addition to the paid holidays and year\-end closure. * **Workers’ Compensation:** Coverage provided under company policy. **Location** This is an on\-site role at our Richland Hills, Texas shop.
