jobs.title: Product Manager, Agentic AI
jobs.description: Product Manager, Agentic AI Remote Product Remote Full\-time At Kinetic, a single, powerful mission unites us: Creating the best Workers’ Comp experience. Our culture is the engine that drives this mission forward—a culture built on togetherness, excellence, accountability, and a deep commitment to our customers. **About Kinetic** We’re transforming workers’ comp with technology\-driven solutions for injury prediction, prevention, and management—helping employers create safer, healthier workplaces. Our platform is built for labor intensive industries including parcel delivery, manufacturing, and wholesale/warehousing operations. Our tech\-driven program speeds up return\-to\-work and offers generative AI for claims management. Through these and other products and services, we're redefining what workers' comp can do. We’re a remote\-first team headquartered in New York City, growing fast—10x in the past two years—and driven by accountability, continuous improvement, and collaboration. If you're excited to build a career with impact, we’d love to meet you. Kinetic has been named to: Business Insurance's Best Place to Work in Insurance 2025 \& 2026\. #### **About the role** Kinetic Insurance is building AI agents across the insurance lifecycle. We are seeking a Product Manager to lead our Agentic AI efforts. This role makes sure every agent Kinetic ships is a component of one coherent platform rather than a one\-off automation. You'll decide what gets built as an agent, how it's evaluated, how much autonomy it earns, and how we prove it moved a real business metric. The role has two tracks. You'll own the agent platform outright: orchestration, tooling, observability, and guardrails. You'll co\-own agent solutions with our experience team PMs, who bring the customer problem while you bring the judgment on whether and how an agent should solve it. This role leans more technical than business, though it is not an engineering role. You'll write and test prompts, build evaluation sets, read traces, and prototype ideas. You won't ship production code, but you won't need an engineer to test whether an idea works. You'll report to the VP of Product and sit on the product management team, working alongside the PMs who lead our Broker, Policyholder, Underwriter, Claims, Data, and Business Systems teams. #### **What you'll do** **Agent platform and orchestration (owned outright)** * Own the roadmap for Kinetic's agent orchestration layer: models and routing, tools and memory, observability, and permissions and guardrails. * Run the agent registry. Every agent has exactly one owner, one documented purpose, one autonomy tier, and one place its behavior is logged. * Define how agents are deployed, versioned, and rolled back, with prompts, tool definitions, and model versions managed like code. * Track usage, cost, and latency per agent. Cost per orchestration matters more than cost per token, and you'll know both. * Lead the cleanup of the agents we already have: inventory every script and workflow touching AI, then retire, replatform, or sunset each one. * Keep business logic, specs, and evaluation data portable so a future framework or model change is an engineering project, not a rewrite. **Agent solutions with experience teams (co\-owned)** * Partner with PMs to define the problem or opportunity, and make the call on whether an agent is the right tool or simpler automation will do. * Translate use cases into agent specs: inputs, tools, autonomy boundary, human escalation path, success metric, and baseline. * Write, test, and iterate on system prompts, tool descriptions, and structured outputs side by side with agent and data engineers. * Tie every agent to one business metric before it scales, such as time\-to\-quote, bind rate, override rate, or hours saved. **Evaluation, governance, and quality** * Build golden datasets with our data team for every agent, and run them as a regression suite whenever a prompt, tool, or model changes. * Own the rollout gates from shadow mode to staged rollout to full production, with each go/no\-go decided by evaluation thresholds rather than a calendar date. * Write and maintain Kinetic's autonomy\-tier policy, including which decisions always keep a human checkpoint, such as a decline, a denial, a bind, or a price. * Produce the artifacts a regulator or acquirer will ask for as a byproduct of good practice: architecture map, evaluation history, audit trail, and before\-and\-after metrics. #### **What you've done** * 5\+ years in Product Management, Technical Product Management, or a similar role, including 1\+ years shipping LLM\-powered or agentic products into production, not just demos. * Hands\-on prompt engineering: system prompts, tool definitions, multi\-step chains, and structured outputs. * Built or ran evaluation for LLM systems, such as golden datasets, LLM\-as\-judge graders, and regression testing. * Working knowledge of agent frameworks and platforms such as CrewAI, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, or AWS Bedrock AgentCore, along with RAG, tool calling, and MCP. * Demonstrated ability to convert messy business needs into requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. * Experience in startups or high\-growth environments. You're comfortable building from scratch. * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain probabilistic systems to business leaders. **Big plus if** * Prior experience at an insurtech, MGA, or carrier, or in another regulated industry such as financial services or healthcare. * Familiarity with workers' compensation, commercial lines underwriting, or claims workflows. * Experience with AI governance frameworks. * Experience with multi\-model routing, cost optimization, or human\-in\-the\-loop design for agents. **What we offer** * Fully distributed, remote team across all continental US time zones * Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 20 vacation days per year * 9 federal holidays off * Parental Leave * Pre\-tax 401k contribution * HSA with compatible health plans * FREE: Health Advocate * FREE: Telehealth Membership * FREE: OneMedical Account **Note** Candidates must reside within the US with existing authorization to work in the United States. This role requires domestic travel for company offsites and team alignment. Verification of government\-issued identity and employment eligibility will be conducted in person prior to employment. *Security Notice: Kinetic is committed to a secure hiring process. All offers of employment are contingent upon successful completion of a comprehensive identity and background verification process. We will never ask for financial information or payment during the application process.*

jobs.description: About Leading Edge Skills Leading Edge Skills LLC (LES) is an established California\-based organization and federal contractor delivering **leadership development, cybersecurity, artificial intelligence, data analytics, technology training, and consulting** to defense agencies, civilian government organizations, and commercial clients. The objective is not simply to teach technologies, but to prepare students to demonstrate their skills to potential employers. Required Technical Expertise **1\. jobs.description: About Lucid At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in\-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility. The GeoAI team is seeking a Senior SLAM Engineer to build fleet\-scale mapping and localization technologies that power next\-generation navigation, ADAS, and autonomous driving systems. This role focuses on robust SLAM, multi\-route mapping, localization, sensor fusion, and map maintenance using fleet\-collected camera, LiDAR, GNSS, IMU, and vehicle telemetry data. You will play a key role in transforming large\-scale fleet data into continuously improving localization maps, road graphs, and high\-definition map assets used across GeoAI, Navigation, and ADAS products. **Role:** **SLAM and Localization:** * Design and develop visual SLAM, LiDAR SLAM, visual\-inertial odometry (VIO), multi\-sensor localization, multi\-session SLAM, and multi\-route SLAM systems. * Develop robust localization solutions using cameras, LiDAR, GNSS/RTK, IMU, vehicle odometry, and HD maps. * Build loop\-closure, relocalization, place\-recognition, and drift\-correction capabilities for long\-term localization performance. * Improve localization accuracy and availability in urban canyons, tunnels, parking structures, construction zones, and GNSS\-denied environments. **Fleet\-Scale Multi\-Route SLAM** * Develop algorithms that jointly optimize trajectories and observations collected across repeated routes, multiple vehicles, and large geographic areas. * Build scalable pose graph and bundle adjustment systems for globally consistent maps. * Design place\-recognition and loop\-closure systems that match observations across different vehicles, lighting, seasons, weather, and roadway changes. * Develop multi\-session map fusion and collaborative mapping solutions that combine repeated drives into a unified spatial representation. * Improve localization repeatability through long\-term landmark management, route alignment, and historical fleet observations. **Map Generation \& Continuous Maintenance** * Build scalable pipelines for localization map generation, HD map generation, lane\-level mapping, road graph creation, and map quality validation. * Develop map change detection, incremental update, versioning, and rollback capabilities for continuously evolving road environments. * Create automated processes for landmark lifecycle management, fleet data aggregation, map freshness monitoring, and conflicting\-observation resolution. * Build systems that safely incorporate qualified fleet observations into production map layers while preserving traceability and map consistency. * Define validation gates and quality metrics for map accuracy, coverage, freshness, reliability, and localization performance. **Sensor Fusion \& Calibration** * Develop camera\-LiDAR\-GNSS\-IMU fusion frameworks for localization, trajectory estimation, and map building. * Improve temporal synchronization, coordinate\-frame management, calibration robustness, and calibration monitoring at fleet scale. * Develop localization confidence, integrity, and uncertainty metrics suitable for production ADAS applications. * Support sensor integration and localization performance across multiple vehicle platforms and hardware configurations. **Production Deployment** * Optimize SLAM, localization, and map optimization algorithms for large\-scale cloud processing and vehicle deployment. * Build reliable distributed pipelines for processing large camera, LiDAR, GNSS, IMU, and vehicle\-motion datasets. * Develop benchmarking, regression testing, visualization, debugging, and map QA tools. * Collaborate with Navigation, Perception, Vehicle Integration, Data Platform, and GeoAI teams to deliver production\-ready mapping and localization systems. **Qualifications:** * MS or PhD in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Vision, or a related field. * 5\+ years of experience in SLAM, localization, mapping, robotics, or autonomous systems. * Strong software engineering skills in C\+\+ and Python. * Deep understanding of visual SLAM, LiDAR SLAM, VIO, state estimation, sensor fusion, factor graphs, bundle ng, and long\-term landmark management. * Experience processing large\-scale camera, LiDAR, GNSS, IMU, and vehicle telemetry datasets using distributed infrastructure. * Experience with production localization integrity, map quality evaluation, calibration monitoring, and system\-level performance analysis. * Publications, patents, or significant technical contributions in SLAM, localization, robotics, computer vision, or mapping systems are a plus. **What You'll Help Build** **Capability** **Impact** **Fleet\-Scale Multi\-Route SLAM** Joint trajectory and map optimization across repeated drives and vehicles. **Production Localization Stack** Camera\-LiDAR\-GNSS\-IMU localization for challenging road environments. **Collaborative Map Fusion** Unified maps built from multi\-session, multi\-vehicle observations. **Map Generation Pipelines** Localization maps, HD maps, lane geometry, road graphs, and landmarks. **Continuous Map Maintenance** Change detection, incremental updates, versioning, freshness, and validation. **Mapping Quality Platform** Accuracy, coverage, integrity, reliability, and regression monitoring. **Ideal Candidate** A hands\-on SLAM engineer with deep expertise in localization, mapping, estimation, optimization, and sensor fusion. jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description: Lunon is an AI\-native consulting firm in New York City, backed by General Catalyst. Most companies don't need another deck about AI. They need an engineer who can walk in, understand the operation, and ship. That's what we do: we embed engineers inside the business and stay until the software runs without us. Our open\-source research system ranks first on DeepResearch Bench. The team is young and moves fast. Everyone here has a wide skill set, works with the newest tools as they land, and owns what they ship end to end. Nobody hands you a ticket. You own the model side of an engagement: choose the right model, adapt it to the client's data, prove it works, and make it fast and cheap enough to run every day. You work beside a Forward Deployed Data Engineer who owns the data. First up: helping an ERP company make its product AI\-native. * Fully remote, US\-based. Lunon is headquartered in New York City. **What you'll do** * Pick the right model for each job, from frontier APIs to open\-weight models, and know when fine\-tuning beats a better prompt. * Fine\-tune when it pays off: supervised fine\-tuning, preference optimization, and parameter\-efficient methods like LoRA. * Build the evaluation harnesses and benchmarks that tell us whether a change made things better. * Take models from training to serving, and tune inference cost, latency, and quality. * Sit with the client's team, find where AI moves their numbers, and say no to work that won't pay back. **What you'll need** Experience matters here. We judge it by what you've shipped and kept running, not by a number of years. * You've fine\-tuned or post\-trained a model and can explain what worked and what didn't. * You've built evals that changed a decision. * You've shipped LLM features that real users depend on. * You've served a model in production and cared about its cost and latency. * You use AI coding tools every day and judge the result by the system and its output, not the language. **Nice to have** Apply even if none of these are true. * You've built on or integrated with an ERP, CRM, or accounting system. * You've shipped extraction or search over messy business documents. * You've done consulting, agency, or forward\-deployed work and know how to be useful in someone else's building on day two. **How we hire** * A 30\-minute conversation with the team about what you've shipped and what we're building. * A technical deep\-dive on one system you owned, from the business problem to production. * A working session on a real client problem with the team. * References, then an offer. We aim to finish in two weeks. **Beware of recruitment fraud.** All official correspondence comes from a lunon.ai email address. jobs.description: Lunon is an AI\-native consulting firm in New York City, backed by General Catalyst. Most companies don't need another deck about AI. They need an engineer who can walk in, understand the operation, and ship. That's what we do: we embed engineers inside the business and stay until the software runs without us. Our open\-source research system ranks first on DeepResearch Bench. The team is young and moves fast. Everyone here has a wide skill set, works with the newest tools as they land, and owns what they ship end to end. Nobody hands you a ticket. You own the data side of an engagement: get the client's data out of the systems it lives in, make it trustworthy, and turn it into the pipelines and datasets the AI runs on. You work beside a Forward Deployed AI Engineer who owns the models. First up: helping an ERP company make its product AI\-native. * Fully remote, US\-based. Lunon is headquartered in New York City. **What you'll do** * Build the pipelines that pull data out of ERP, CRM, and accounting systems and keep it moving: ingestion, processing, and storage. * Put data quality and lineage controls in place, so anyone can trace a number back to where it came from. * Build and manage the training and evaluation datasets the models learn from and are judged on. * Run it in production at enterprise scale. Reliability is yours. * Document it and hand it off so the client's team can run it on their own. **What you'll need** Experience matters here. We judge it by what you've shipped and kept running, not by a number of years. * You've built and run data pipelines in production, including when they broke. * You write Python and SQL well and have worked with a warehouse or lakehouse such as Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, or Postgres. * You've made sense of messy data from systems you didn't design. * You've built data for an ML or LLM system: training sets, eval sets, or retrieval. * You use AI coding tools every day and judge the result by the system and its output, not the language. **Nice to have** Apply even if none of these are true. * You've built on or integrated with an ERP, CRM, or accounting system. * You've built data quality or lineage tooling other people relied on. * You've done consulting, agency, or forward\-deployed work and know how to be useful in someone else's building on day two. **How we hire** * A 30\-minute conversation with the team about what you've shipped and what we're building. * A technical deep\-dive on one system you owned, from the business problem to production. * A working session on a real client problem with the team. * References, then an offer. jobs.title: AI Engineer
jobs.description: Momentic is building the definitive verification layer for software: an AI\-native testing platform that helps engineering teams catch bugs before they ship. As AI accelerates software development, teams need a reliable way to verify that their products work. Engineering teams at Notion, Webflow, Xero, and Whatnot use Momentic to ship with confidence. You’ll join our engineering team and work closely with our CTO to improve the models and agents behind Momentic. We’re looking for a hands\-on AI engineer who can fine\-tune models, build evaluations, and turn production data into more reliable, efficient agents. Momentic executes more than 1 million tests daily and processes more than 1 billion tokens per hour at peak, giving your improvements a direct impact on the product. **What you’ll do** ------------------ * Fine\-tune models for long\-running agents, including agents that investigate whether test failures come from infrastructure, recent code changes, or test authorship. * Build and curate training and evaluation datasets from production workflows, using failure patterns to identify opportunities for improvement. * Develop LLM evaluations and observability that connect offline results with production behavior and help the team verify improvements. * Tune prompts, context, and model behavior to improve task success, reliability, latency, token usage, and cost. * Design repeatable experiments and help publish benchmarks that demonstrate our core agents’ performance on testing and browser workflows. * Own technical projects from problem definition through delivery, working with the engineering team to make practical tradeoffs and ship improvements. **You’re perfect for this role if…** ------------------------------------ * You have relevant software engineering experience, typically 3\+ years, including hands\-on contributions to AI\-powered capabilities used in production. * You have hands\-on experience with supervised fine\-tuning, including preparing training data and evaluating model behavior. * You’ve worked with prompt and context tuning, evaluation datasets, and LLM observability to diagnose failures and measure improvements. * You have strong engineering fundamentals, code efficiently, and know what you’re great at and where you have room to grow. * You use AI agents to build software, breaking down work, tracking progress, checking results, and redirecting agents when they get stuck. * You’re comfortable with autonomy and ambiguity. You can turn an unclear problem into a plan, manage your own work, and follow through to delivery. We’re interested in the depth of your contributions and what you’ve shipped. Your experience may come from owning an AI capability within a larger product. **Nice to haves** ----------------- * Experience with reinforcement learning fine\-tuning, RL environments, or LLM\-as\-judge evaluators. * Experience with long\-running agents, recovery from failed steps, or coordinating multiple agents. * Experience publishing benchmarks or running rigorous experiments on AI systems. **About us** ------------ * Raised a $15M Series A led by Standard Capital, with backing from Y Combinator, FCVC, Transpose Platform, and Dropbox Ventures. * Our customer base has grown 4× year to date. * A team of 17 and growing. * Based in person in San Francisco at 650 5th Street. **Benefits** ------------ * Medical, dental, and vision insurance. * 401(k). * Unlimited PTO and sick days, plus company\-observed US holidays. * Daily lunch and a fully stocked kitchen. * Commuter benefits. * Team offsites and events. Compensation Range: $175K \- $250K

jobs.title: Security Engineer, Device/Hardware
jobs.description: **Who we are:** Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks. Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector. Visit gomotive.com to learn more. ### **About the Role:** As a Security Engineer, Hardware Security you will be a key member of the Product Security Team. You will be the primary Security partner for Engineering and Hardware teams, focusing on design reviews, threat modeling, and building scalable "secure\-by\-default" components (libraries, services, frameworks, components) that empower hardware engineers to ship the product securely. You will work across teams, influencing security and driving the hardware security initiative. This is a highly strategic and technical role for architects who want to scale security through programs, influence, and engineering excellence, focusing on design, automation, and enablement. ### **What You’ll Do:** * Build the hardware and embedded security baseline and process across Motive devices, including boot chain, firmware, FOTA, and manufacturing * Drive relationships with hardware engineering team to ensure findings are prioritized, validated and remediated * Identify and assess hardware security risks across the product lifecycle including designing, manufacturing, deployment, updating, and decommissioning * Lead hardware security architecture reviews, threat modeling, and security testing for product systems * Define and review security requirements for hardware platforms, embedded systems, firmware interfaces, boot processes, debug capabilities, and device lifecycle controls in cloud\-connected environments. * Drive end to end security for device hardware across IoT and cloud security infrastructure ### **What We’re Looking For:** * 5\+ years years of experience in Hardware Security, including creating security by design patterns into new devices and platforms * 5\+ years of experience in working with product teams creating security designs and providing security requirements * 5\+ years of hands on development experience in the programming languages like python and C/C\+\+ * Strong understanding of hardware root of trust, secure boot, attestation, key protection, device identity, and secure provisioning concepts. * Demonstrated hands\-on experience designing, reviewing, and validating security controls for hardware and low\-level system architectures. * Experience in cloud security, runtime security, supply chain security, and application security best practices ***Pay Transparency*** *Your compensation may be based on several factors, including education, work experience, and certifications. For certain roles, total compensation may include restricted stock units. Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). Learn more about our benefits by visiting**Motive Perks \& Benefits* The base compensation range for this role is: $160,000 \- $205,000 USD *Creating a diverse and inclusive workplace is one of Motive's core values. (“Employer”) discloses candidates may be required to execute a non\-compete covenant with the Employer. This requirement does not apply to lawyers, interns, or employees working in CA, MN, MT, ND, OK, or where otherwise prohibited by law.* *Non\-compete covenant terms in all other jurisdictions will be subject to the applicable statutory requirements, including but not limited to, procedures, industry related prohibitions, or salary and compensation thresholds.* *All job postings are for existing vacancies. Please note; some interviews or new\-hire training sessions may be held in person at one of our global offices.*

jobs.title: Backend Platform Engineer
jobs.description: **Senior Backend Platform Engineer, MyLawAdmin (Node, TypeScript, Postgres)** Over the past year we built a multi\-tenant practice\-management platform that runs law firms day to day operations. It includes a staff dashboard, a client portal, an admin console and the backend behind all of them. We are hiring a Senior Backend Platform Engineer to own how that platform runs and help ship and maintain the core and feature service offerings. You will work directly with the law firm principal who designed and built the system, who leads the platform and its architecture, and with a senior developer who works firm\-side and ships feature lanes end to end. Product ideas come from the two of them; your job is to understand how everything works and runs, say where it should run differently, and ship the code. The codebase is a year old, test\-heavy, and documented with numbered architecture decision records. What you will do: * Learn how the whole platform runs, service by service, and become the person who can answer where anything happens and why. * Own the unattended layer: the services, workers, scheduled jobs, queues and integrations that run without anyone clicking. * Own the data layer in production: schema changes, migrations and backfills with rollbacks, and tenant isolation that holds up under review. * Own reliability and security: observability, incident response, secrets and access, and getting us ready for an outside review. * Answer feature briefs from the principal and the senior developer with a contract they can build against, then build your half. * Ship every week in small reviewed pull requests, and write the short design note before the code when a change deserves one. Tech stack: * Backend: Fastify 5, TypeScript, Node 22, Zod, pino, Sentry. * Data: Postgres with hand\-written SQL migrations and row\-level security; Redis for leases and queues; SpiceDB for authorization * Frontends you will wire into: Next.js 15 and 16, React 19, our own design system. * Tooling: GitHub Actions on self\-hosted runners, Vitest against a real Postgres, an OSV supply\-chain gate. What we are looking for: * Experience building and running backend services in Node and TypeScript, including at least one multi\-tenant SaaS you kept in production * You read an unfamiliar codebase quickly and find the running path: where a request enters, which worker picks it up, where it is logged * Strong Postgres: you write SQL and migrations by hand, you have run a backfill on a live table with a rollback ready, you have used row\-level security or another tenant\-isolation model, and you can read a query plan * You have built or operated a queue or outbox: idempotency, retries with backoff, dead letters, at\-least\-once delivery * You instrument what you ship, and you have been the person paged for it * Security habits: secrets, sessions and tokens, rate limiting, audit logs; you can write a threat model for a change * You write integration tests against a real database as part of every change, and short design notes and PR descriptions a colleague can act on Nice to have: * Transactional email or SMS at volume: webhooks, bounces, suppression lists * Authorization systems such as SpiceDB or OpenFGA * Legal\-tech, compliance or regulated\-data experience * Enough React to connect a backend door to an existing screen; no design work is expected Why join us: * You own how the platform runs, not tickets, and ship to real users every week * A test\-heavy, documented codebase with real multi\-tenant and security problems to solve * Direct collaboration with the principal and one senior developer * Flexible hybrid schedule in Brooklyn Job Type: Full\-time Benefits: 401(k), 401(k) matching, Dental insurance, Health insurance, Paid time off, Professional development assistance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brooklyn, NY 11217 How to apply: apply here with a résumé and a short note on one system you ran in production: what it did, what broke, and what you changed. Pay: $85,000\.00 \- $115,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule * Health insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brooklyn, NY 11217

jobs.title: BESS Renewable Energy Automation Engineer
jobs.description: We begin with dreams. Dreams drive our motivation. Dreams are our future. The world's dreams, people's dreams, our dreams. Our passion creates ideas that make dreams come alive. Technology and products that were only dreams become reality. All for dreams. Dreams challenge and the Nidec\-Group will continue to meet the challenge. For the world's and people's tomorrows; the world's first, the world's best technologies and products; we will continue our part in creating a better society. **Job Summary** Nidec is the world’s leading manufacturer of electric motors, drives, and controls, powering nearly everything that spins and moves, from smartphones and household appliances to electric vehicles, factories, data centers, aircraft, and critical infrastructure. Founded in 1973 and headquartered in Kyoto, Japan, Nidec operates more than 300 group companies across 40\+ countries, with over 100,000 employees worldwide. Rooted in Japanese craftsmanship and continuous improvement, we combine global capability with local expertise to solve complex challenges and keep the world moving.**Job Description** **Role Summary** The BESSRenewable Energy Automation Engineeris an advanced engineering professional responsible for leading the design, integration, validation, and lifecycle support of Energy Management Systems (EMS), Power Plant Controllers (PPC), SCADA platforms, industrial communications networks, and automation solutions for utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. Operating with limited supervision, this role applies extensive expertise in controls engineering, power system integration, industrial communications, and cybersecurity to develop complex technical solutions that support safe, reliable, and compliant operation of energy storage assets. The position provides technical leadership across projects, influences system architecture and engineering standards, mentors other engineers, and leads commissioning, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement efforts to optimize system performance and customer outcomes. **Responsibilities and Duties** Engineering Design \& Technical Leadership * Lead the design, development, integration, and optimization of Energy Management Systems (EMS), Power Plant Controllers (PPC), SCADA platforms, and automation solutions for utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) projects. * Establish system architecture, control philosophies, communication strategies, and technical approaches that support project performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability. * Evaluate engineering tradeoffs and make technical recommendations related to controls, networking, cybersecurity, monitoring, and power system integration. * Interpret and apply applicable utility, regulatory, cybersecurity, and industry standards throughout project execution. * Serve as a technical lead for complex renewable energy and energy storage projects. System Integration, Validation \& Problem Resolution * Define and oversee system testing, validation, simulation, and commissioning activities to ensure compliance with design requirements and customer expectations. * Lead troubleshooting and resolution of complex control, communication, networking, and operational issues across multiple system components. * Analyze performance data and implement corrective actions to optimize system reliability, availability, and operational efficiency. * Support factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), commissioning, startup, and field performance activities. * Develop and validate advanced control strategies supporting grid\-connected energy storage applications. Documentation \& Engineering Governance * Lead the preparation, review, and approval of engineering documentation, including technical specifications, control narratives, network architectures, operating procedures, and test plans. * Ensure adherence to engineering standards, quality processes, configuration management requirements, and change control procedures. * Support development and continuous improvement of engineering standards, best practices, and design methodologies. * Maintain compliance with applicable codes, standards, and cybersecurity requirements. Cross\-Functional Collaboration * Collaborate with product management, project engineering, field service, software development, compliance, and customer stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. * Provide technical leadership during project execution, implementation, commissioning, and operational support activities. * Communicate technical risks, design considerations, system limitations, and recommended solutions to internal and external stakeholders. * Support customer meetings, technical reviews, and project planning activities. Technical Leadership \& Continuous Improvement * Serve as a subject matter expert for BESS automation, EMS functionality, industrial communications, and control system integration. * Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior and mid\-level engineers. * Share technical knowledge, lessons learned, and engineering best practices across the organization. * Identify opportunities for product enhancement, process improvement, standardization, and innovation within renewable energy solutions. **Travel and Working Conditions** * Ability to travel domestically and internationally up to approximately 25% to support project execution, commissioning, customer engagement, training, and technical support activities. **Required Qualifications** Education \& Experience * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Controls Engineering, Computer Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline required. * Minimum of 7 years of progressive engineering experience in automation, controls, energy management systems, renewable energy, utility, power generation, or industrial power system environments. * Demonstrated experience leading complex engineering projects with limited supervision. * Experience designing and implementing EMS, SCADA, control system, or automation solutions. * Experience supporting system integration, testing, commissioning, and troubleshooting in operational environments. * Experience with industrial communication protocols including Modbus, DNP3, OPC\-UA, IEC 61850, MQTT, or similar technologies. * Experience developing technical specifications, test plans, engineering documentation, and customer\-facing deliverables. **Preferred Qualifications** Education \& Experience * Master's degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline preferred. * Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred. * Direct utility\-scale Battery Energy Storage System (BESS) design and integration experience. * Experience supporting Battery Management Systems (BMS) and Power Conversion Systems (PCS). * Experience with utility interconnection, grid services, or power market participation strategies. * Knowledge of NERC CIP, IEC 62443, or similar critical infrastructure cybersecurity standards. * Professional certifications related to automation, networking, cybersecurity, power systems. **Core Competencies** * Applies advanced engineering expertise and sound judgment to solve complex technical challenges. * Leads technical execution and influences system design, project outcomes, and engineering decisions. * Effectively analyzes issues, identifies root causes, and develops practical, reliable solutions. * Collaborates across functions and communicates complex technical concepts to diverse audiences. * Provides technical leadership, mentorship, and knowledge sharing to support team development. * Drives continuous improvement while maintaining a strong commitment to quality, safety, cybersecurity, and operational excellence. **Additional Job Details** **Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action at Nidec** Nidec is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) and Affirmative Action Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants receive consideration for employment without regard to their age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, genetic information, religious creed, national origin, physical or mental disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. For more information regarding your (EEO) rights as an applicant, please visit the following website: http://www1\.eeoc.gov/employers/upload/eeoc\_self\_print\_poster.pdf **Work Shift Schedule** **No Soliciting** Nidec will not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third party recruiting agencies in response to Nidec job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers. Pre\-approval from the Nidec Talent Acquisition team is required before any external candidate can be submitted and such candidate must be submitted to the Nidec Talent Acquisition team.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer - (IT STWD SR ENGINEER, ASP 50691427)
jobs.description: **About this Job** ------------------ The Division of Administration/Office of Technology Services has a vacancy. This job title has an assigned pay grade of TS\-317\. This position is located in Architecture, Standards and Platform. Req 227398 Interested in advancing your career in DevOps and Platform Engineering while helping modernize technology across Louisiana state government? The Office of Technology Services (OTS), Architecture, Standards \& Platform (ASP) section is seeking an experienced, hands\-on engineer to join its Platform Engineering team. This position focuses on designing, developing, and supporting automated infrastructure and software delivery solutions using modern cloud technologies, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD pipelines, and container platforms. The team works with state agencies and development teams to build reusable deployment patterns, improve developer productivity, and establish secure, standardized, and reliable application delivery practices. This position designs, develops, and maintains Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions using technologies such as Terraform, OpenTofu, Bicep, or equivalent tools to automate cloud infrastructure provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management. The Office of Technology Services aims to be a responsible partner in delivering innovative, effective, and reliable solutions that support and enhance the IT functions within Executive Branch Departments. The Office of Technology Services will work to increase the return on the State’s investment in technology by promoting smart decision\-making, solving problems intelligently, increasing the rate of project success, and fostering a skilled and professional staff. This position is within the Office of Technology Services (OTS), Architecture, Standards \& Platform and supports DevOps and Platform Engineering. The incumbent bridges application development and operations by enabling standardized delivery through platform integrations, automation, and consulting, ensuring teams can adopt repeatable delivery patterns aligned with OTS standards. The Division of Administration is the state government’s management arm and the hub of its financial operations. Division offices perform a wide variety of activities including the following: * Overseeing the state’s capital construction program * Working to provide state and federal grants for community development * Development of the state budget * Providing technology services * Giving agencies guidance in the state purchasing and contracting process as they seek goods and services * Administering a program that provides federal funds to help Louisiana residents recover from a series of devastating hurricanes **Minimum Qualifications** -------------------------- Seven years of experience in information technology or administrative services; OR Six years of full\-time work experience in any field plus five years of experience in information technology or administrative services; OR An associate's degree in information technology plus five years of experience in information technology or administrative services; OR A bachelor’s degree plus five years of experience in information technology or administrative services; OR A bachelor’s degree with twenty\-four semester hours in an information technology, computer science, engineering, mathematics, or business analytics field plus four years of experience in information technology or administrative services; OR A master’s degree plus four years of experience in information technology or administrative services. EXPERIENCE SUBSTITUTION: Every 30 semester hours earned from an accredited college or university will be credited as one year of experience towards the six years of full\-time work experience in any field. The maximum substitution allowed is 120 semester hours which substitutes for a maximum of four years of experience in any field. NOTE: A certification in an approved area may be substituted for the education and/or experience requirements at the time of hire or promotion, provided the appointment is made from a Certificate of Eligibles. **Job Specification** --------------------- The official job specifications for this role, as defined by the State Civil Service, can be found here. **Job Duties and Other Information** ------------------------------------ Job Duties: Builds and supports DevOps platform integrations and automation to enable consistent delivery: * Serves as the head technical consultant for assigned DevOps infrastructure technologies, designing, developing, testing, debugging, and documenting automation and integrations across the DevOps toolchain (for example: source control, CI, artifact management, deployments, observability, and work management). * Develops and maintains “golden paths” and reusable building blocks (templates, reference repos, reusable workflows, standard configurations, runbooks) that teams can adopt with minimal customization. * Implements and maintains sec ove reliability and delivery outcomes (for example: branch protections, automated checks, release strategies, environment promotion, monitoring baselines). * Produces clear enablement documentation and onboarding guides for teams adopting DevOps platforms and standard delivery practices and works with teams to transition solutions from bespoke implementations to supported, repeatable platform patterns where appropriate. Establishes and enables DevOps standards and remains current on tools and practices * Contributes to and maintains DevOps platform standards, procedures, and guidelines within the assigned technology scope, including standard configurations and recommended delivery patterns that enable consistent adoption across teams. Provides recommendations for improvements to platform services and integrations to increase performance, resiliency, reliability, and cost effectiveness for the delivery ecosystem and supporting infrastructure. * Researches new developments in tools, platforms, and software relevant to DevOps infrastructure technologies; evaluates options and documents recommendations based on security, maintainability, usability, and total cost of ownership. Helps define and refine practical measures of adoption and maturity (for example: use of standard pipelines/configurations, onboarding completion, baseline monitoring coverage) and supports continuous improvement initiatives. Provides technical leadership, mentorship, and knowledge sharing in DevOps practices * Coaches developers and platform team members on effective CI/CD practices, automation patterns, and platform usage through pairing, reviews, and informal training sessions. * Reviews pipeline and automation changes for quality, consistency, and maintainability; provides actionable feedback to improve outcomes. * Leads or contributes to at least one knowledge\-sharing activity per year (examples: demo sessions, brown bags, written guidance, internal documentation improvements). * Performs all other tasks, special projects, analysis, studies, and plans as directed. Position\-Specific Details: **Appointment Type:** This vacancy will be filled by promotion of a current permanent status Office of State Technology employee. A permanent status employee may be required to serve a new probationary period in lieu of promotion. *Louisiana is a “State as a Model Employer” for People with Disabilities.* How To Apply: **No Civil Service test score** is required in order to be considered for this vacancy. Resumes **WILL NOT** be accepted in lieu of completed education and experience sections on your application. Applications may be rejected if incomplete. To apply for this vacancy, click on the “Apply” link above and complete an electronic application, which can be used for this vacancy as well as future job opportunities. Applicants are responsible for checking the status of their application to determine where they are in the recruitment process. Further status message information is located under the Information section of the Current Job Opportunities page. Prior to a new hire, a background check including criminal record history will be conducted. Information from the background check will not necessarily preclude employment but will be considered in determining the applicant’s suitability and competence to perform in the position. A criminal history check may be conducted on employees changing positions including promotions, demotions, details, reassignments and transfers. Also, prospective employees may be subject to pre\-employment drug testing. New hires will be subject to employment eligibility verification via the federal government's E\-verify system. * Information to support your eligibility for this job title must be included in the application (i.e., relevant, detailed experience/education). For further information about this vacancy, contact: Danielle Martin HR Analyst Division of Administration/Office of Human Resources email: Danielle.Martin@la.gov

jobs.title: Facility Maintenance Supervisor | Full-Time | Palm Beach County Convention Center
jobs.description: Oak View Group: Oak View Group (OVG) is the global leader in premium live entertainment infrastructure and services, with a platform spanning venue development and end\-to\-end capabilities across venue management, hospitality, and sponsorship sales. Founded in 2015, the company serves a collection of seven world\-class owned venues and a client roster of the most iconic arenas, stadiums, convention centers, music festivals, performing arts centers, and cultural institutions, spanning four continents. Position Summary: The **Facility Maintenance Supervisor** for our HVAC and Building Systems will assist in supervising and coordinating the activities and operations of the Engineering Department, including safety, security, and event staffing functions. This position provides highly responsible maintenance support to the Engineering Manager. The role requires availability for late afternoon start times and weekend coverage, based on operational and event needs. This role pays an hourly rate of $30\.00 \- $31\.00\. **Benefits for Full\-Time roles: Health, Dental and Vision Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, 401(k) matching, and Paid Time Off (vacation days, sick days, and 11 holidays).** **This position will remain open until December 31, 2026\.** About the Venue: The **Palm Beach County Convention Center** is a multi\-purpose facility in West Palm Beach, Florida, managed by the Oak View Group. The Center features a 100,000\-square\-foot exhibit hall, a 22,000\-square\-foot ballroom, and 21,000 square feet of flexible meeting space, as well as connecting to the 400\-room Hilton West Palm Beach. Responsibilities: * Supervise the overall operations and maintenance of HVAC, electrical, mechanical, and plumbing systems. * Ensure optimal performance of water\-cooled chillers, cooling towers, VAV boxes, AHUs, and fan coil units. * Plan, assign, and supervise daily maintenance activities. * Integrate Metasys BMS controls into workflow for monitoring and diagnostics. * Evaluate work methods, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely resolution. * Ensure compliance with standards set by Palm Beach County. * Maintain accurate CM and PM records in MicroMain. * Generate reports on system performance using Metasys. * Supervise and oversee HVAC and utility service setup for events. * Coordinate with concessionaires and monitor external contractors and engineers. * Train HVAC and maintenance staff as needed. Provide training on HVAC systems, Metasys, and facility operations. * Assist in department budget planning and monitoring. * Maintain inventory of HVAC components, supplies, and refrigerants. * Maintain compliance with safety regulations and MSDS documentation. * Ensure adherence to HVAC\-related federal, state, and local regulations. * Monitor and optimize HVAC performance using Johnson Controls Metasys. * Run diagnostics and repair the commercial HVAC systems. * Handle repairs across multiple facility systems (plumbing, electrical, structure). * Use the building management systems, CMMS software, and MS Office Suite. Qualifications: * 2\-3 years of supervisory or lead\-level experience dealing hands\-on with commercial HVAC systems, including: Water\- and air\-cooled chillers, cooling towers, VAVs, AHUs, and fan coil units. * Extensive experience with Johnson Controls Metasys BMS is strongly preferred. * Proficiency in building maintenance software such as MicroMain or similar CMMS. * Experience in high\-demand facilities (e.g., convention centers, hotels, hospitals, or sports venues). * Strong working knowledge of OSHA regulations, HVAC safety standards, and hazardous materials communication protocols. * Specialized training or certifications in HVAC or building maintenance systems preferred. Strengthened by our Differences. United to Make a Difference: At OVG, we understand that to continue positively disrupting the sports and live entertainment industry, we need a diverse team to help us do it. We also believe that inclusivity drives innovation, strengthens our **people**, improves our **service**, and raises our **excellence**. Our success is rooted in creating environments that reflect and celebrate the diverse communities in which we operate and serve, and this is the reason we are committed to amplifying voices from all different backgrounds. Equal Opportunity Employer: Oak View Group is committed to equal employment opportunity. We will not discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on any legally recognized basis (“protected class”) including, but not limited to veteran status, uniform service member status, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other protected class under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer
jobs.description: **Electrical Engineer** Obayashi Corporation is seeking qualified candidates for an Electrical Engineer position. We are a global professional construction company and bring the best quality and technical expertise in areas of Heavy Civil works and Building Construction work, including Site Development, Wet and Dry Utility Installation, Wharf improvement, and Industrial \& Commercial Building works. Obayashi Corporation has an excellent career opportunity for an Electrical Engineer to work for our Guam projects sites all over the island. The successful candidate should be a highly motivated individual and have enough experience of supervising construction works such as electrical and telecommunication works, dry utility Installation, and site coordination of MEPF trades. **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:** * Supervises Electrical Engineering Works (Electrical Distribution, Power Systems, Lighting, and Control Systems, and Testing \& Commissioning) including installation of electrical systems for Mechanical, Civil, and Plumbing works. Coordinates with the site installation team on the appropriate materials needed for field installation. * Reviews approved/conformed plans, specifications, and other technical documents related to electrical systems and components. * Provides quantity take\-offs for materials required for electrical installations, based on approved designs, specifications, and conformed drawings. * Communicates and follows up with vendors and subcontractors to ensure timely and accurate electrical system installations. Makes a good coordination with all trades at site to prevent any scope gap, especially on MEPF works and Architectural works. * Tracks and monitors project progress, especially that related to electrical works, analyzing deviations, and recommending corrective actions to meet project timelines. * Learns and practices basics of other disciplines, especially highly related to electrical, such as mechanical, plumbing and fire suppression works. Also, learns and practice basics of project management, including quality control, environmental control and safety control. * Prepares and submits Requests for Information (RFI) to the Owner to clarify electrical and other related system requirements and specifications. **REQUIREMENTS** **Education/Experience** * Graduate from a 4\-year accredited college or university program in Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Communication Engineering, or a related discipline. * Minimum of 5 years of experience as an Electrical Engineer or Project Electrical Engineer on construction contracts. * Proven experience supervising subcontractors and managing multi\-disciplined construction activities. · Strong Proficiency in major Microsoft applications such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook · A valid US driver's license and satisfactory driving record is required. For foreign candidates, they must have at least 5 years of satisfactory driving record. · Must be able to pass a background check for access to US military facilities. * Excellent organizational, communication, and problem\-solving skills. · No criminal record or history of drug use. **PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS/SKILLS** * Local candidates from Guam and the CNMI. * Previous experience working on projects for Department of Defense agencies (NAVFAC, USACE, etc.). * Must be organized with excellent problem\-solving skills and a strong work ethic. * Competency in the use of AutoCAD, Revit, or similar electrical design software. **Why Obayashi** Obayashi Corporation offers a comprehensive benefits package and an excellent opportunity to grow as part of one of the most respected names in the construction industry. Established in 1892, Obayashi is a global leader in construction and has contributed to iconic projects such as the MRT Dubai Metro (UAE), the Hoover Dam Bypass Bridge (USA), and the Tokyo Skytree (Japan). We are committed to delivering the highest standards of quality and safety to our clients, partners, and employees. Obayashi is consistently ranked among ENR's Top 250 International Contractors. We offer competitive market salaries and a benefits package that includes a Medical PPO Plan, Dental DPO Plan, Vision, EAP, Life \& Disability Insurance, and 401(k) matching. **Who We Are** Obayashi Corporation is the only Japanese general contractor with a long\-standing presence in the United States and Canada, beginning with our first tunneling project in San Francisco in 1982\. We have completed numerous projects across North America, including the Hoover Dam Bypass Bridge. Our group includes strong heavy civil contractors such as Kraemer North America, MWH, and Kenaidan. Since launching our Guam office in 2010, we have focused on federal and military construction. Completed projects include the Guam Naval Hospital, Uniform/Tango Wharf Improvement, X\-Ray Wharf Improvements (Berth 1\), Finegayan Utilities \& Site Improvements, P\-83003 Hayman Munitions Storage Igloos, and Repair Lima Wharf project. We continue to deliver and secure a broad range of military and federal projects in Guam, including facility construction, waterfront improvements, utility and energy\-resiliency upgrades, logistics support facilities, and defense\-related infrastructure developments. **Equal Opportunity Employer** Obayashi Corporation is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions based on merit. We prohibit unlawful discrimination based on race, color, creed, gender, religion, marital status, domestic partner status, age, national origin, disability, medical condition, sexual orientation, or any other status protected by law. This policy also applies to perceived characteristics or associations with individuals in protected groups. We are committed to full compliance with all applicable equal employment opportunity laws. Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $80,000\.00 \- $100,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Paid time off * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
jobs.description: Olive Systems partners with fast\-growing AI and technology companies across the United States to help them build and scale their engineering teams. We’re looking for experienced **Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs)** who can bridge the gap between complex customer challenges and real\-world technical solutions. Rather than hiring for a single position, we’re building a network of strong engineers interested in working with innovative startups and technology companies. Based on your technical background, experience, and career preferences, we’ll connect you with relevant opportunities across our partner companies. **This is not an internal engineering position at Olive Systems.** **What You’ll Do** As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you’ll work closely with customers and engineering teams to solve complex technical challenges, often without predefined requirements. Your responsibilities may include: * Working directly with customers to understand business challenges and translate them into technical solutions. * Designing, developing, and deploying production\-ready applications and systems. * Building prototypes and turning successful concepts into scalable products. * Working across backend, frontend, APIs, cloud infrastructure, data, and AI technologies. * Making architectural and technical decisions independently. * Collaborating with founders, product managers, and engineering teams. * Identifying opportunities to turn custom solutions into reusable product capabilities. * Taking full ownership of technical solutions, from initial discovery through production deployment. **Who We’re Looking For** We’re interested in engineers who combine strong technical expertise with product thinking, problem\-solving skills, and the ability to work independently. You might currently be a: * Forward Deployed Engineer * Senior / Staff Full\-Stack Engineer * Founding Engineer or Technical Founder * AI / Applied AI Engineer * Solutions Architect with hands\-on development experience * Senior Software Engineer with end\-to\-end product ownership **What matters most:** * Strong hands\-on software engineering experience. * Proven track record of building and shipping production systems. * Ability to take ownership of complex technical challenges from start to finish. * Experience designing software architecture and making technical trade\-offs. * Confidence working with ambiguous or evolving requirements. * Strong communication skills and experience collaborating with technical and non\-technical stakeholders. * Ability to move quickly from problem discovery to implementation. **Nice to Have:** * Experience building AI\-powered applications using LLMs, RAG, or AI agents. * Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure. * Background in early\-stage startups or fast\-paced product environments. * Previous experience working directly with enterprise customers. * Experience developing MVPs, prototypes, or custom integrations. **Our Hiring Process** **1\. Initial Technical Evaluation** We’ll invite you to a short AI\-powered interview focused on your real engineering experience. We’ll explore systems you’ve built, architectural decisions, technical challenges, and how you approach solving complex problems. No algorithm puzzles or generic coding questions. **2\. Conversation with Olive Systems** We’ll discuss your professional background, career goals, compensation expectations, preferred working environment, and availability. **3\. Introduction to Relevant Opportunities** When we identify a suitable opportunity, we’ll introduce you to the company and coordinate the next steps. Depending on the company, additional technical interviews or assessments may be required. **Location \& Work Setup** We work with technology companies hiring across the **United States**. Opportunities may be fully remote, hybrid, or onsite, depending on the company. Specific location, compensation, employment arrangements, and work authorization or sponsorship requirements vary by opportunity. **Why Join Our Network?** Instead of applying to multiple companies individually, you can complete our initial evaluation once and be considered for relevant opportunities as they become available. Our goal is to connect experienced engineers with companies where their technical expertise, problem\-solving abilities, and career ambitions are a strong match. **Interested?** Apply with your CV or LinkedIn profile. If your experience aligns with what our partner companies are looking for, we’ll contact you with the next steps. Pay: $160,000\.00 \- $220,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Flexible schedule * Paid time off Work Location: Hybrid remote in New York, NY 10013

jobs.title: Android Software Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Build and improve Android mobile applications as an Android Software Engineer. jobs.title: Research Engineer/Senior Research Engineer, 3D Auto-Labeling and Data Flywheel
jobs.description: PlusAI is a Physical AI company pioneering AI\-based virtual driver software for factory\-built autonomous trucks. Headquartered in Silicon Valley with operations in the United States and Europe, Plus was named by Fast Company as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies. Partners including TRATON GROUP’s Scania, MAN, and International brands, Hyundai Motor Company, Iveco Group, Bosch, and DSV are working with Plus to accelerate the deployment of next\-generation autonomous trucks. If you’re ready to make a huge impact and drive the future of autonomy, Plus is looking for talented individuals to join its fast\-growing teams. Improving the models that drive our trucks depends on a data flywheel: among petabytes of fleet recordings, we curate the moments that matter, label them, train and evaluate onboard models, deploy, and collect again. Labeling is where this loop usually stalls, because human labeling does not scale with the fleet. Auto\-labeling closes that gap: offline models and compute, free of the vehicle's real\-time limits, draft the labels, and people verify and correct only where it matters. This role focuses on 3D obstacle auto\-labeling: producing accurate 3D object labels from curated multi\-sensor recordings, at a quality that lets reviewers verify rather than draw and at a cost that scales. The underlying problems are general: fusing cameras and lidar into consistent 3D estimates, keeping objects consistent through time and occlusion, and knowing when a machine label is good enough. The role starts with 3D obstacles and can expand into other parts of the data flywheel over time. We are open to candidates at either the Research Engineer or Senior Research Engineer level. Level will be determined by experience, technical depth, scope of responsibility and demonstrated impact. You do not need experience with every technology in our stack; we value strong fundamentals, a sense of responsibility and the ability to learn. ### **Responsibilities** * Develop and evaluate methods that turn multi\-sensor recordings into accurate 3D object labels offline, using models and compute the vehicle cannot afford in real time, and measure them against reviewed ground truth * Raise label quality and reduce the human review it needs: find where machine labels fail and fix the causes in models, sensor fusion or data; bring state\-of\-the\-art perception and foundation models into offline use and adapt them to our vehicles and sensors * Build and operate the labeling pipelines at fleet scale: batch GPU inference, data extraction and alignment, selection of what goes to human review, annotation\-tool integration, monitoring, throughput and cost, and regression tests that catch quality drops before data reaches training * Close the loop with the modeling teams: deliver training\-ready labels, feed model failures and long\-tail scenarios back into what gets curated and labeled next; at the senior level, lead designs and mentor * Ensure that your work is performed in accordance with the company's Quality Management System (QMS) requirements and contribute to continuous improvement efforts ### **Required Skills** * BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience * Hands\-on experience developing and evaluating 3D perception methods (detection, tracking, sensor fusion or related) with a framework such as PyTorch, including experimentation, error analysis, principled metrics, built on solid fundamentals in 3D geometry, coordinate frames, and camera and lidar calibration * Strong Python (NumPy, Pandas, SQL) and working C\+\+ where performance matters; experience running large offline workloads with GPU batch inference * Foundations for data\-centric machine learning: how training\-data composition shapes model behavior, how to evaluate against ground truth, and how to measure and reduce annotation cost * Self\-driven with a strong sense of responsibility: a quick learner who takes problems from ambiguous to shipped; for the senior level, a system you were responsible for end to end, design documents others built on, and mentoring ### **Preferred Skills** * Auto\-labeling, offline perception, or ground\-truth generation for autonomous driving or robotics, including integrations with annotation tools and vendors * Experience improving models through data: active learning and data flywheels, hard\-example mining, uncertainty or disagreement signals, dataset curation * Lidar SLAM, structure\-from\-motion, factor\-graph optimization (GTSAM, Ceres), or stereo and monocular depth estimation * Foundation and multimodal models: open\-vocabulary detectors, promptable segmentation, vision\-language models, embeddings and vector search * Heavy\-truck specifics (articulated vehicles, trailer state estimation, multi\-platform calibration) or lane and road\-geometry labeling pipelines **Your opportunities joining PlusAI** Work, learn and grow in a highly future\-oriented, innovative and dynamic field. Wide range of opportunities for personal and professional development. Catered free lunch, unlimited snacks and beverages. Highly competitive salary and benefits package, including 401(k) plan. We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.
