This position begins as a temporary, part\-time role on an as\-needed basis, starting with immediate hands\-on milestones. All components, professional tools, and software licenses are provided. For a candidate who demonstrates exceptional reliability, meticulous execution, and true engineering breadth, there is strong potential to transition this into a structured, longer\-duration role with an ongoing pipeline of advanced app development and systems engineering work. **Scope of Work \& Project Details** * **Hardware \& Infrastructure:** Complete hardware assembly of a custom PC from scratch (requiring immaculate cable management), followed by configuring a home server network and network\-attached storage (NAS) / home lab environments. * **App \& Software Development:** Build new software applications from scratch and actively modify, optimize, or debug existing app codebases to add new features. * **Web Engineering:** Create, deploy, and maintain functional websites, handling both backend logic and frontend layouts. * **Systems Deployment:** Manage secure operating system installations, driver configurations, local network mapping, and automated infrastructure scripts. **Required Technical Skills \& Traits** * **Application \& Web Development:** Proven experience developing functional apps, modifying software code, and creating websites. * **Hardware Craftsmanship:** Hands\-on experience building custom computers with elite attention to detail, component safety, and clean aesthetics. * **Server \& Network Administration:** Prior experience setting up home labs, managing network routing, and establishing secure local storage. * **Work Style:** Exceptionally reliable, organized, highly careful with expensive hardware components, and able to transition seamlessly between physical tech tasks and deep software engineering. **How to Apply** If you are an all\-in\-one technician, developer, and engineer looking for immediate task\-based pay, please reach out with: * **A link to your GitHub profile** (or portfolio) showcasing your past repositories, app codebases, or website projects. * A brief summary highlighting your hands\-on experience with custom PC builds, server setups, or physical hardware troubleshooting. * Your current academic or professional availability over the coming weeks near the University of Houston campus. Pay: From $20\.00 per hour Work Location: Hybrid remote in Houston, TX 77204

jobs.title: Technical Product Owner - AI & Agents
jobs.description: **Who is Rainforest?** Rainforest is an early stage payments\-as\-a\-service startup that has developed a solution that makes monetizing payments for vertically focused software platforms fair and simple. We focus on small\-to\-mid sized platforms that want to add value to their small business customers through embedded payments — and want to do so without adding operational or regulatory burdens or costs. Led by a successful repeat fintech founder with deep knowledge of the industry, and with venture backing from a Top 10 VC firm, Rainforest is well positioned to make an impact in the payments\-as\-a\-service space, and we're looking for new team members who want to be a part of this journey! **Who are we looking for?** Rainforest is looking for a deeply technical Product Manager for our AI \& Agents team. You'll own the agentic products that help vertical SaaS platforms run and grow their payments programs. This isn't a traditional PM role. We need someone who understands how agentic products are built from the inside: the harness around the model, the tools it calls, the memory it keeps, and the evaluations that prove it's getting better. You'll know you're the right candidate when you'd rather open a merge request with your AI coding tools than write a ticket about it, and when you have strong opinions about which model belongs on which task. You'll also help shape how AI and agents are used across Rainforest, partnering with teams company\-wide to bring agentic workflows into how we operate. **What are some of the high\-impact opportunities you’ll tackle?** * Owning the product direction for our agent harness, including the knowledge, skills, and tools that make it valuable beyond a thin wrapper on an LLM * Defining and building the evaluation, regression testing, and telemetry that keep our agents accurate as models and prompts change * Tuning agent behavior hands\-on, from prompts to knowledge base to skills, in close partnership with engineering * Driving model selection and routing decisions across multiple LLMs, balancing capability, latency, and cost * Designing how our clients' own agents interoperate with Rainforest through MCP and agent\-to\-agent communication * Making product changes directly using AI coding tools and partnering with engineers to review and ship them * Serving as an internal thought leader on AI and agents, helping teams across Rainforest adopt agentic workflows * Representing our agentic products externally with clients and the broader market **This opportunity is for you if you have / are:** * Hands\-on experience building agentic products or agent harnesses, including tool use, memory, prompt assembly, and evaluation * Deep, current knowledge of the LLM landscape, including frontier and open\-weight models and where each performs well * Daily fluency with AI coding tools and comfort making real code changes * Experience building evals or regression suites for LLM\-based systems * Familiarity with MCP, agent\-to\-agent protocols, embeddings, and multi\-model architectures * A strong technical background, whether from product, engineering, or an adjacent role * Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex systems to technical and non\-technical audiences * Comfort with ambiguity and a high degree of autonomy in a fast\-moving startup * Experience in payments or fintech is a plus We offer a comprehensive health benefits package, unlimited paid time off, paid parental leave, a fun and flexible working environment, and continuously invest in our people and our culture. If you require any accommodations throughout the pre\-employment process, please contact our HR team at hr@rainforestpay.com

jobs.title: Sr. Security Engineer
jobs.description: Make it rain. Make Snow. Make Earth Habitable. Rainmaker builds and deploys audacious technologies that work with nature to create an abundant, habitable planet. We are modernizing proven cloud\-seeding science with weather\-resistant UAS, radar and satellite observations, numerical weather prediction, novel sensing and validation systems, and sustainable seeding technologies. We are building an integrated system to make more freshwater available to farms, ecosystems, and communities. Our ambition is bold, but we pursue it with humility. We take on difficult problems in the real world with technical rigor, grit, integrity, and an openness to learning and course\-correcting. We are hiring individuals with evidence of exceptional ability. If you want to build systems that endure, restore, and deliver the future we were promised, we want to hear from you. Engineering builds the software, infrastructure, and aircraft systems that power Rainmaker’s cloud\-seeding operations. We work with scientists and field operators to turn weather data into reliable systems that help make more freshwater available. ### **About the Role** Rainmaker is hiring a Sr. Security Engineer to build security into how we develop software and hardware, and how we run field operations. You’ll write production code and design secure defaults across AWS, our applications, and company systems, protecting scientific data and the systems our aircraft and field teams depend on. You’ll automate routine controls and checks, reducing recurring manual work as the company grows. You’ll work closely with engineers to test, operate, and improve the systems you build while keeping secure workflows straightforward to use.### **What You’ll Do** * Map critical systems, data flows, and access paths, then turn the highest\-priority risks into a practical plan. * Build reusable, secure\-by\-default AWS infrastructure with platform engineers, including least\-privilege access, network boundaries, and logging for scientific and operational systems. * Review application designs and code, build reusable authentication and authorization patterns, and fix vulnerabilities at their source. * Automate access provisioning and revocation, secrets management, and credential rotation across production and company systems, with clear audit trails and recovery paths. * Build security checks into development and deployment workflows to catch exposed secrets, vulnerable dependencies, and unsafe configuration changes before release. * Build useful detections and automate evidence gathering for investigations. Work with system owners to test incident response and recovery. * Make Google Workspace and device configurations secure by default, working with People and Operations to make onboarding and offboarding reliable and easy to use. * Partner with aircraft and field teams on secure remote access and communications for systems that operate with intermittent connectivity. * Test, monitor, and document security automation so other engineers can maintain it. Simplify controls that create unnecessary alerts, exceptions, or recurring manual work. ### **What We’re Looking For** * Experience building and maintaining security automation in production. You can show what risk it reduced, how you tested it, how failures are handled, and what manual work it eliminated. * Strong software engineering skills in Python, TypeScript, or a similar language, including testing, code review, deployment, and operating what you build. * Hands\-on cloud security experience, with the ability to turn access policies, network boundaries, and logging requirements into reusable infrastructure as code. * Practical understanding of application security, authentication, authorization, secrets management, and common web and API vulnerabilities. * Experience investigating security findings and carrying fixes through to deployment and verification. * Sound judgment about risk, reliability, and maintenance costs. You can choose a simple, effective control and explain what should happen now versus later. * Ability to work independently, communicate clearly with engineers and non\-engineers, and follow through on work that spans teams. ### **What Will Set You Apart** * Experience with AWS, Pulumi or Terraform, and GitHub or Buildkite deployment workflows. * Experience with Tailscale or WireGuard * Security work involving robotics, aerospace, scientific computing, or remote field systems. * Experience building self\-service security tools or reusable controls that other engineering teams adopted. ### **What Success Looks Like In the First 90 Days** You’ve mapped our critical systems and access paths and agreed on the highest\-priority risks with the team. A secure configuration or access control is deployed on a critical system, with tests that catch unsafe changes. One recurring security workflow now runs automatically, with monitoring, a tested recovery path, and documentation so it can operate without your daily intervention. You’ve tested a detection and response path with the engineers who will use it and agreed on the next improvements. **Supporting the people behind the mission** Making Earth more habitable is ambitious work. We want the people doing it to feel supported—in the work we share and the lives they’re building. * **A stake in what we build.** Meaningful stock options and the opportunity to help shape Rainmaker as an early member of the team. * **Support for your health.** Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance. * **An investment in your future.** A 401(k) with employer matching to help you build long\-term savings. * **Time to recharge.** Unlimited PTO for rest, exploration, and the people and pursuits that matter to you. * **Time for a growing family.** Paid parental leave for both parents to welcome a child and spend time together. * **Lunch together.** Daily lunch provided at our El Segundo headquarters—a chance to share a meal and connect with teammates. * **Help making the move.** Relocation assistance for eligible roles to support your transition to Rainmaker.

jobs.title: Software Engineer Team Leader
jobs.description: Thank you for your interest in a career at Regions. At Regions, we believe associates deserve more than just a job. We believe in offering performance\-driven individuals a place where they can build a career \-\-\- a place to expect more opportunities. If you are focused on results, dedicated to quality, strength and integrity, and possess the drive to succeed, then we are your employer of choice. Regions is dedicated to taking appropriate steps to safeguard and protect private and personally identifiable information you submit. The information that you submit will be collected and reviewed by associates, consultants, and vendors of Regions in order to evaluate your qualifications and experience for job opportunities and will not be used for marketing purposes, sold, or shared outside of Regions unless required by law. Such information will be stored in accordance with regulatory requirements and in conjunction with Regions’ Retention Schedule for a minimum of three years. You may review, modify, or update your information by visiting and logging into the careers section of the system. **Job Description:** At Regions, the Software Engineer Team Leader devises or modifies procedures to solve complex problems considering computer limitations, operating time, and forms of desired results. This role is responsible for application development, modification, and maintenance of applications. This role monitors system applications and ensures systems run smoothly; as well as creates reports and other documentation outlining findings/solutions and support users. This role sits within Regions' Technology department. Primary Responsibilities Assigns and directs the work of team members Estimates team level timelines and technical efforts for planning purposes Assists with the review and evaluation of personnel performance Plans, conducts, and supervises assignments for the team Evaluates progress and results and recommends major changes in procedures Handles compliance remediation Designs, develops, tests, and deploys software using a combination of custom and off\-the\-shelf tools Collaborates cross\-functionally with architects, business users, project managers/Scrum Masters and other engineers to achieve sustainable solutions in a complex environment Monitors, maintains and continuously improves existing software applications Identifies, troubleshoots, and resolves technical and functional software issues Completes documentation and procedures for installation and maintenance Applies design patterns in all development activities Identifies, documents, and implements non\-functional requirements Builds, maintains, and executes test automation suite Takes independent actions, makes decisions, and takes ownership of applications Plans and estimates work effort Identifies and implements software performance improvements Conducts/Participates in code reviews, code quality checks and developer integration testing Ensures compliance with risk management programs, rules and regulations, and cybersecurity practices; identifies opportunities for and supports process improvements; applies disciplined change management practices This position is exempt from timekeeping requirements under the Fair Labor Standards Act and is not eligible for overtime pay. Requirements Bachelor’s degree Seven (7\) years of related experience Experience with test\-driven development Experience with agile development processes Preferences In depth understanding of design patterns and their application Skills and Competencies Ability to coach, teach, and mentor teams Ability to estimate work efforts for project sub\-plans or small projects Ability to interpret and ensure compliance with applicable rules, regulations, and industry guidance Ability to work in an environment with aggressive timelines Demonstrates leadership Excellent analytical, decision\-making, problem\-solving and time management skills Excellent verbal and written communication skills to technical and non\-technical audiences of various levels in the organization (e.g. executive, management, individual contributors) Fluency in developing and understanding sequence diagrams and class models, where applicable In\-depth understanding of DevOps and formal Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) processes Willingness to work within a distributed team Additional job detail for this specific opportunity This is a team lead position that deals with mainframe and distributed systems surrounding document composition with print and pdf generation. **Desired experience in the following:** Mainframe modernization and experience Managing project execution and prioritization Architectural design, guidance, and documentation Agile methodologies and continuous improvement Problem solving and accountability Effective Communication Banking industry experience **Nice To Have:** Document composition tool experience (like with CSF Designer) Github and Harness deployment understanding and experience Voltage software experience Print (afp file) composition tool experience (like with Precisely/Streamweaver or BCC products) Regions will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position. Applicants for this position must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full\-time basis. This position is intended to be onsite, now or in the near future. Associates will have regular work hours, including full days in the office three or more days a week. The manager will set the work schedule for this position, including in\-office expectations. Regions will not provide relocation assistance for this position, and relocation would be at your expense. This position must be within a reasonable driving distance to Birmingham, AL, Atlanta, GA or Charlotte, NC. Position Type Full time Compensation Details Pay ranges are job specific and are provided as a point\-of\-market reference for compensation decisions. Other factors which directly impact pay for individual associates include: experience, skills, knowledge, contribution, job location and, most importantly, performance in the job role. As these factors vary by individuals, pay will also vary among individual associates within the same job. The target information listed below is based on the Metropolitan Statistical Area Market Range for where the position is located and level of the position. **Job Range Target:** **Minimum:** $127,767\.75 USD **Median:** $168,210\.00 USD **Incentive Pay Plans:** Opportunity to participate in the Long Term Incentive Plan. Benefits Information Regions offers a benefits package that is flexible, comprehensive and recognizes that "one size does not fit all" for benefits\-eligible associates. Listed below is a synopsis of the benefits offered by Regions for informational purposes, which is not intended to be a complete summary of plan terms and conditions. Paid Vacation/Sick Time 401K with Company Match Medical, Dental and Vision Benefits Disability Benefits Health Savings Account Flexible Spending Account Life Insurance Parental Leave Employee Assistance Program Associate Volunteer Program Please note, benefits and plans may be changed, amended, or terminated with respect to all or any class of associate at any time. To learn more about Regions’ benefits, please click or copy the link below to your browser. https://www.regions.com/about\-regions/welcome\-portal/benefits Location Details Riverchase Operations Center **Location:** Hoover, Alabama Equal Opportunity Employer/including Disabled/Veterans Job applications at Regions are accepted electronically through our career site for a minimum of five business days from the date of posting. Job postings for higher\-volume positions may remain active for longer than the minimum period due to business need and may be closed at any time thereafter at the discretion of the company.

jobs.title: Senior Staff CAD Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Description** We are seeking an experienced Principal EDA/CAD Engineer to provide technical leadership for Renesas’ global engineering compute and CAD infrastructure. The role combines hands\-on engineering with architecture and operational responsibility across **Linux compute environments, engineering workspaces, project provisioning, LSF integration, EDA license infrastructure, Perforce infrastructure, monitoring and automation.** The successful candidate will work closely with engineering, CAD and IT/IS teams to develop scalable, reliable and globally consistent environments supporting semiconductor development. **Compute \& Engineering Infrastructure** * Provide technical leadership for global EDA compute infrastructure. * Develop and support Linux\-based engineering environments. * Work with IT/IS on compute, storage, networking and server requirements. * Support interactive and batch compute environments. * Contribute to infrastructure capacity planning and technical roadmaps. * Troubleshoot complex compute and engineering\-environment problems. * Develop automation to improve reliability and reduce manual administration. **Project \& Workspace Infrastructure** * Own and evolve the engineering project and workspace architecture. * Develop and maintain project/workspace creation and initialization mechanisms. * Support project configuration infrastructure. * Ensure consistent environment setup globally across projects and sites. * Develop interfaces between project configuration, PDKs, EDA tools and engineering workflows. * Provide extensible mechanisms allowing project teams to customize their environments while maintaining a supported platform standard. * Reduce manual intervention in project setup and project lifecycle management. **EDA License Infrastructure** * Provide technical leadership for global EDA license\-server infrastructure. * Develop standardized approaches for license deployment and administration. * Develop and maintain automation for license updates, validation and auditing. **Automation \& Tool Development** * Develop robust Python, shell and other automation for CAD infrastructure. * Maintain engineering utilities and infrastructure scripts. * Develop automation for configuration generation, provisioning, monitoring and administration. * Integrate CAD infrastructure with Jenkins/CI and service\-management workflows where appropriate. * Improve observability, auditability and maintainability of infrastructure services. **Monitoring, Metrics \& Capacity Planning** * Develop dashboards and metrics for engineering infrastructure. * Monitor compute and license utilization. * Identify capacity, performance and reliability risks. * Work with infrastructure teams on forward capacity planning. * Develop mechanisms to identify inefficient use of shared engineering resources. **OS \& Platform Strategy** * Contribute to supported Linux OS strategy for EDA environments. * Coordinate EDA\-tool compatibility requirements with IT/IS. * Support migration between Linux platform generations. * Define clear engineering requirements for infrastructure standards. * Help separate engineering application requirements from infrastructure operational ownership. **Documentation, Training \& Support** * Maintain architecture and operational documentation for critical CAD infrastructure. * Document scripts, configuration, dependencies and recovery procedures. * Provide expert escalation for complex infrastructure problems. * Train other CAD engineers and IT/IS teams to reduce dependency on individual experts. * Establish sustainable primary/backup ownership for critical services. * Develop appropriate resilience and failover strategies. * Work with regional CAD teams and IT/IS to standardize license infrastructure globally. * Support license\-capacity monitoring and planning. * Develop monitoring and reporting for license availability and utilization. **LSF \& Batch Compute** * Provide EDA expertise for LSF\-based compute environments. * Work with IT/IS on LSF architecture, provisioning and resource sharing. * Develop methods for monitoring compute utilization and efficiency. * Support integration between project environments and batch compute. * Identify and automate detection of inefficient or problematic workloads. * Contribute to compute capacity planning. **Perforce Infrastructure** * Provide engineering\-side technical expertise for Perforce server infrastructure and operations. * Support Perforce architecture used by semiconductor engineering environments. * Work with IT/IS on server lifecycle, availability, storage, backup and operational ownership. * Support administration and troubleshooting of engineering Perforce environments. * Develop automation and monitoring around Perforce infrastructure. * Maintain appropriate operational documentation and procedures. **Qualifications** **Required Skills \& Experience** * Significant experience in EDA/CAD infrastructure engineering within semiconductor development. * Strong Linux/Unix expertise. * Strong scripting and automation skills, preferably Python and shell. * Experience with LSF or comparable distributed compute environments. * Experience with enterprise version\-control/data\-management infrastructure such as Perforce Helix and IPLM * Experience with engineering project/workspace management. * Understanding of compute, storage and network requirements for EDA environments. * Experience with EDA licensing and FlexNet\-based licensing environments. * Strong troubleshooting and root\-cause\-analysis skills. * Experience developing production\-quality engineering automation. * Ability to work across global engineering, CAD and IT/IS organizations. * Strong technical documentation and knowledge\-transfer skills. **Highly Desirable** * Perforce server administration and architecture. * LSF administration/integration experience. * FlexNet license\-server architecture. * Grafana or similar infrastructure monitoring. * Jenkins/CI automation. * ServiceNow integration. * Cadence and other major semiconductor EDA\-tool experience. * Linux infrastructure and RHEL migration experience. * Experience supporting geographically distributed engineering environments. **Additional Information** Renesas is an embedded semiconductor solution provider driven by its Purpose, **To Make Our Lives Easier**. With a global team of over 21,000 engineers and problem solvers in more than 30 countries, we offer the opportunity to work on world‑leading technology for Automotive, Industrial, Infrastructure, and IoT, shaping a safer, healthier, greener, and smarter future. At Renesas, TAGIE is our culture, grounded in being Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. It shapes how we work, grow and deliver on our purpose together. This collaborative spirit and mindset drive our semiconductor technology to transform industries and impact millions of lives. We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process. Are you ready to join our team and **shape the future** with us? Renesas Electronics is an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, committed to supporting diversity and fostering a work environment free of discrimination on the basis of sex, race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, military status, veteran status, or any other basis protected by law. For more information, please read our Diversity \& Inclusion Statement.

jobs.title: Senior IT Support Analyst
jobs.description: We are a healthcare technology company that provides platforms and solutions to improve the management and access of cost\-effective pharmacy benefits. Our technology helps enterprise and partnership clients simplify their businesses and helps consumers save on prescriptions. As a leader in SaaS technology for healthcare, we offer innovative solutions with integrated intelligence on a single enterprise platform that connects the pharmacy ecosystem. With our expertise and modern, modular platform, our partners use real\-time data to transform their business performance and optimize their innovative models in the marketplace. **Position Summary** ==================== We are seeking an experienced and motivated Senior IT Support Analyst to join our Boston office. This role is built for a technically well\-rounded professional who can own complex, multi\-system problems independently, serve as the escalation point for challenging support issues, and apply AI and automation to improve how the team operates and supports end users. You will be the primary IT presence in the Boston office—resolving advanced end\-user issues, contributing to infrastructure and cloud initiatives, and actively driving tool improvements and AI integrations alongside the global IT team. Must be aware of and comply with all aspects of the RxSense Information Security Program and the policies contained therein. Must always understand the importance of maintaining Information Security. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **End\-User \& Office Support** ------------------------------- * Serve as the primary on\-site IT resource for Boston office staff, delivering prompt, high\-quality technical assistance in person and remotely. * Provide dedicated on\-site and remote technical support to executives and office staff, ensuring responsive, and high\-quality assistance for time\-sensitive needs. * Manage and own the IT support ticket queue, ensuring timely resolution in accordance with SLA targets; serve as the escalation point for complex and non\-standard issues, engaging senior engineers or specialized teams only where scope requires it. * Provision, configure, and support Windows and macOS endpoints, including laptops, desktops, printers, scanners, and mobile devices. * Support A/V and conferencing equipment, including video conferencing systems, microphones, and display technology for meetings and presentations. * Assist with user account management, including password resets, MFA configuration, and access provisioning. * Manage hardware and software inventory, ensuring accurate and up\-to\-date asset records. * Recover and validate assets upon employee separations. * Assist with physical office equipment moves and workspace setup as needed. * Administer physical access control systems, including badge provisioning, door reader troubleshooting, and coordination with facilities for access changes. **Cloud \& Systems Support** ---------------------------- * Support day\-to\-day administration tasks across AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, partnering with the systems engineering team on complex changes. * Perform day\-to\-day administration of Windows 365 and Google Workspace. * Support identity and access management tasks across Okta, Entra ID, and Active Directory, including account lifecycle, group membership, and SSO troubleshooting. * Write, own, and maintain automation scripts in PowerShell and Python; manage and version all scripts and tools via GitHub. * Maintain clear and accurate documentation for all systems, configurations, and procedures. * Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, Microsoft Copilot) to accelerate automation scripting, documentation generation, and workflow improvements across IT operations. * Conduct deep\-dive evaluations of current and prospective IT tools; document findings and present integration and improvement recommendations to the team. * Develop and deliver internal training sessions and reference materials to improve team proficiency with key platforms and AI\-powered capabilities. **Networking \& Connectivity** ------------------------------ * Support and perform basic configuration of office network hardware including switches, firewalls, and wireless access points; escalate complex network engineering tasks to senior network staff. * Troubleshoot common connectivity issues across wired LAN, Wi\-Fi, and VPN; identify root cause and escalate infrastructure\-level problems appropriately. * Perform cabling, patching, and physical network infrastructure tasks as required. **Compliance \& Security** -------------------------- * Ensure compliance with SOC1, SOC2, HIPAA, HITRUST, and ISO 27001 standards in all IT activities. * Enforce Information Security policies and IT procedures; jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer, Application Platform
jobs.description: **Senior Backend Engineer, Application Platform** ================================================= **Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) · $185k–$215K base \+ meaningful early\-stage equity \+ full benefits** **About Sodalis** ----------------- Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in\-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1\.5B\+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). **The Opportunity** ------------------- Every pharmacy works from the same building blocks: prescriptions, directions, insurance claims, rejects. But each one handles them a little differently, so today every implementation means custom code. We want implementation to be configuration, done by a technical solutions team using internal tools, with no engineer in the loop. That's the engine you'd build. It's a classic backend problem with real stakes. You'll model the shared primitives so one system can absorb each pharmacy's nuances, build the configuration layer and the backend behind the tools, and define the contract between the engine and the people tuning it. That includes how new versions roll out only to the customers who want them, on a system that's already live and can't break. You'd own the application platform: the domain model, configuration layer, and tooling. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture and where the platform goes. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Model the shared primitives (prescriptions, directions, insurance outcomes) and build the backend that turns each pharmacy's differences into configuration, so one system serves many pharmacies. * Decide where the line between configuration and code sits: what a solutions team can safely configure, and what stays in the engine. * Build the backend services and APIs behind the internal tools a solutions team uses to implement a new customer without an engineer. * Define and version the contract between our engines and whoever configures them, so upgrades ship safely and selectively. * Ship changes to a system that's live, where every prescription is a patient and a bad migration isn't an outage, it's a delayed therapy. Zero\-downtime rollouts and safe versioning are table stakes here. * Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture and roadmap. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years building backend systems in production. * Strong system design: you can take an open prompt, design a coherent system, and explain the trade\-offs clearly. * Solid data modeling and API design: you build systems that generalize, not one\-offs. * You've built something config\-driven that other people operated: a rules engine, a multi\-tenant platform, a feature\-flag or rollout system, a workflow DSL. You know where those designs go wrong. * You've shipped 0 1 in startups and are comfortable with ambiguity. * You'll spend time with the solutions team and with pharmacies to understand how their workflows actually differ. No healthcare background required. **How we work** --------------- We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. Compensation Range: $185K \- $215K

jobs.title: Software Engineer, Infrastructure
jobs.description: **Software Engineer, Infrastructure** ===================================== **Hybrid in Palo Alto (Mon / Wed / Thurs) · $185K–$215K base \+ meaningful early\-stage equity \+ full benefits** **About Sodalis** ----------------- Specialty pharmacy is where the most complex and expensive drugs reach the most in\-need patients, and it still runs on faxes, phone tag, and manual data entry. Patients wait weeks for therapies that can't wait. Sodalis is building AI agents that run those operations end to end: reading and validating prescriptions, handling phone calls, and moving prescriptions through eligibility and fulfillment. The ambition goes beyond that. We want to be the rails every specialty prescription runs on, and the first system to perform clinical review at the standard of a pharmacist. We're already in production, processing tens of thousands of prescriptions a week. Backed by Gradient Ventures (Google's AI fund), and founded by veterans of Apple's Applied ML, Included Health, and Avella Specialty Pharmacy (scaled to $1\.5B\+ before its acquisition by OptumRx). **The Opportunity** ------------------- Everything we run today is cloud\-based, and so are the pharmacy management systems we integrate with. But most of the specialty pharmacy market runs on\-prem. To reach it, our system has to run on the pharmacy's systems instead of ours. Whether that's the full stack on\-site or a hybrid split with our cloud is one of the first decisions you'd make. That's the problem you'd own. We've never shipped an on\-prem deployment, so there's no pattern to follow. You'll decide how our architecture gets packaged and deployed into environments we don't control, what has to change in our current infrastructure to make that possible, and how we maintain and see into those deployments once they're live. We don't yet know what these environments look like in detail. Some pharmacies may have restricted outbound access, legacy hardware, or IT teams that can't give us a login; others may be more open. Part of the job is going in with our customer, finding out what's actually there, and designing something that works across the range. You'll start with our AI pharmacy tech product, rolling out with a committed customer, so you build against a real deployment instead of a hypothetical one. You'd work directly with the founders and the early engineering team on the architecture. **What you'll do** ------------------ * Decide how our architecture runs in a pharmacy's environment, starting with the AI pharmacy tech product: full stack on\-site, a hybrid split with our cloud, or something in between. * Adapt our current infrastructure and build the packaging and deployment path that installs and updates Sodalis at each pharmacy. * Own those deployments over time: upgrades, rollbacks, and observability into health and failures without being on site. * Go in with our customer and pharmacy IT teams to learn what their environments actually allow, and design for the range. * Partner with the founders and early engineering team on architecture. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 5\+ years in infrastructure or platform engineering. * You've taken an AWS\-native stack and made it run on Kubernetes or similar in environments you don't operate, including stateful services. * You've shipped and maintained software running in environments you don't control: on\-prem, customer\-hosted, edge, or embedded. * You've kept a fleet of remote installs updated, observable, and recoverable without being able to log into them. * You've set the first pattern for something in a startup and are comfortable with ambiguity. * You'll spend time with pharmacy IT teams and need to understand their constraints firsthand. No healthcare background required. **How we work** --------------- We're a handful of people going all in on a problem we think is worth it, holding a high bar and shipping work that reaches real patients. It's intense, and it isn't for everyone. We want people who want to build something that matters, alongside others who care as much as they do. If that's you, we should talk. Compensation Range: $185K \- $215K

jobs.description: **Impact** ========== As a Senior Engineer on the Core Services team at Shipt, you will play a key technical role in building, scaling, and maintaining the mission\-critical backend systems that power our retailer management ecosystem. You will take ownership of complex technical tasks and features, ensuring our core applications are production\-ready, highly scalable, resilient, and performant across multi\-region environments. Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, and Principal/Staff Engineers, you will contribute directly to our technical roadmap, lead feature execution within our microservices framework, and mentor junior and mid\-level engineers to elevate the overall quality and engineering standards of the team.**What You’ll Need to Be Successful** ===================================== **Technical Execution \& Architecture*** **Hands\-On Development**: Drive hands\-on development on complex features, multi\-region services, and core microservices built solidly in **Go (Golang)**, leveraging **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, **Apache Kafka**, **Postgres**, **Redis**, and **Kubernetes**. * **Scalable System Design**: Design high\-performance, low\-latency microservices and event pipelines adhering to **SOLID design principles** and **RESTful API standards**, anticipating future scale while ensuring solutions support automation, security, resiliency, and maintainability. * **Database \& Caching Optimization**: Design robust relational data models in **Postgres**, write clean SQL migrations, optimize complex queries, and implement effective caching strategies using **Redis** to minimize database load. * **Pragmatic Problem Solving \& Tooling**: Approach engineering challenges as an outcome\-driven problem solver first, treating modern development tools—including AI coding assistants and agentic workflows—as force multipliers in your technical toolbox while taking complete ownership of system design, correctness, security, and long\-term code quality. * **Code Quality \& Best Practices**: Consistently write and teach others to write idiomatic Go code with testability, readability, edge\-case handling, and robust error management in mind. Conduct thorough code reviews to maintain team engineering standards. * **Technical Documentation**: Document key architecture and design decisions, creating high\-level and low\-level system diagrams to articulate complex workflows clearly. * **Security Ownership \& Code Scanning**: Approach code and infrastructure with a security\-first mindset, utilizing automated code scanning tools to identify vulnerabilities and advocate for swift remediation. * **Frameworks \& Refactoring**: Identify when internal libraries or service patterns need updating or refactoring, actively contributing to internal Shipt shared tooling and microservice templates. **Operational Health \& Observability*** **Production Readiness**: Ensure all team solutions are deployable, production\-ready, multi\-region resilient, and equipped with sufficient product observability for high reliability and rapid incident recovery. * **Observability \& SLIs/SLOs**: Proactively identify and resolve gaps in observability metrics, logging, and distributed tracing dashboards. Use operational data and observability metrics to drive stability improvements, define business\-level SLIs/SLOs, and tune alerting for rapid incident response. * **Troubleshooting \& Incident Response**: Take strong ownership of incident recovery and root\-cause resolution across team services, implementing long\-lasting fixes to prevent recurring failures. **Leadership \& Collaboration*** **Technical Roadmap**: Contribute meaningfully to the team’s technical roadmap and assist in planning, estimating, and managing multi\-sprint feature deliveries. * **Mentorship \& Coaching**: Serve as a mentor and coach to Engineers, Associate Engineers, and Interns, fostering a growth mindset and elevating technical skills across the team. * **Cross\-Functional Communication**: Act as a primary technical contact point for the team, answering technical questions for cross\-product partners and product managers while keeping stakeholders informed of technical impact. **Technical Skills \& Qualifications** * **Experience**: **4\+ years** of professional software development experience building and maintaining production\-grade distributed systems. * **Core Technical Stack**: Demonstrated expertise writing production backend services in **Go (Golang)**, with strong experience in **Apache Kafka**, **Postgres**, **Redis**, **Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**, and **Kubernetes**. * **Data Persistence \& Caching**: Deep understanding of relational database schema design, SQL query performance optimization in Postgres, and caching strategies in Redis. * **Distributed Systems \& API Design**: Strong proficiency in microservices architecture, **RESTful API design**, **SOLID design principles**, asynchronous event\-driven messaging, and multi\-region service resilience. * **Testing \& Quality Focus**: Strong expertise in automated unit, integration, and regression testing frameworks, leveraging quality metrics to continuously improve test coverage. * **Process \& Execution**: Experience working in fast\-paced **Agile** environments, with the ability to take action and make swift decisions with limited data points. * **Education**: Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. **Skills \& Education** ======================= This list includes key skills used in this job but is not inclusive of all skills needed for the role. Please see any required education below. Hybrid roles in Minneapolis, MN typically work in\-office at least 1 day per week on either Tuesday, Wednesday, or Thursday. Hybrid roles in San Francisco, CA typically work in\-office at least 1 day per week between Monday and Thursday. Certain roles may require in\-office presence on a full\-time basis. At Shipt, we aim to put our team first to boost a sense of belonging, spark opportunities for growth, provide unique benefits and commit to giving back to our communities in ways that make life better, both personally and professionally. operate containerized services using Kubernetes and public cloud platforms such as Azure or AWS. * Apply secure engineering practices, including authentication, authorization, certificate or token management, secrets handling, dependency management, and protection of device\-to\-cloud communications. * Build observability through structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and actionable SQL development. * Familiarity with observability tools such as Datadog, Grafana, Splunk, Prometheus, or Azure Monitor. * Experience supporting retail technology, operational technology, connected appliances, sensors, digital displays, or other distributed hardware environments. * Knowledge of secure device identity, certificate\-based authentication, secrets rotation, vulnerability management, jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.description: Tablet is how you book the world’s most exciting hotels — places where you get a memorable experience, not just a room for the night. For over 20 years we've scoured the earth to find hotels that stand out for their style, service, and personality — regardless of price. In fact, our painstaking curation led to Michelin making us the official hotel selection of their legendary MICHELIN Guide. The MICHELIN Guide has always been a benchmark in gastronomy. Now it’s setting the same standard for hotels. Our mission is to open doors to places people will love that they might not have found on their own, extraordinary places that reflect the beauty and diversity of the world. Our team believes that travel brings people of all backgrounds together. Our hotels provide an unforgettable backdrop for that union. Headquartered in New York City, we operate in eight languages, bringing the top 1% of hotels in over a hundred different countries around the world to our discerning clientele via our website and app. And if you really want to take it to the next level, our Plus membership program provides VIP upgrades and amenities at hundreds of our properties. **DevOps Engineer** Reporting to the Head of Engineer and sitting in a DevOps team of two, you’ll collaborate with our Solutions Architect in developing the next generation of our cloud\-based infrastructure while sunsetting legacy technology and systems. The DevOps team works closely with the Backend team in managing our AWS environment with the goal of efficiently serving our growing international audience across multiple products and platforms (desktop, iOS, and Android). This includes both traditional EC2 hosted platforms as well as our next generation of serverless APIs. This is a highly visible and dynamic role since you’ll be contributing at every level including system design, database and systems administration, OS and application testing, monitoring, automation, and infrastructure and network support. This role is responsible for maintaining our infrastructure as code via CI/CD pipelines across various applications. Our DevOps team is also responsible for tier\-1 support which will be required on an as needed basis to help support our hybrid office. This includes new hire setups, account management, and office networking. This role will be part of an on\-call rotation schedule to support our infrastructure. **Requirements:** * 3\+ years experience in a software development environment * Experience working with an environment hosted in AWS * Experience with Infrastructure\-as\-Code (i.e. Cloudformation, Terraform) * Experience working with Linux based systems (or other \*nix) * Scripting experience (Bash, Python or other programming experience a plus) * Familiarity with cloud\-based monitoring tools * Familiar with configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, Chef, etc.) **Nice to have:** * Familiar with database administration (MySQL, Postgres) * Experience with network/application security (Web application firewall, security groups, OS hardening, anomaly detection) * Advanced network routing (BGP, OSPF, VPN tunneling) * Centralized logging systems * Experience with creating/maintaining application CI/CD pipelines This is a hybrid role requiring **two days per week** in our New York City office. **$110 \- 120k Annual salary based on experience**

jobs.title: Shopify Developer
jobs.description: **Shopify Developer** --------------------- About the Role Build shopping experiences that bring beauty to life at tarte, a global beauty brand with the entrepreneurial spirit of a founder\-led business. We’re looking for a hands\-on Shopify developer who brings fresh ideas and enjoys solving problems, with work spanning product launches, influencer activations, and everyday shopping. You’ll partner across Engineering, Design, Product, Merchandising, Marketing, and Operations to take features from idea to launch and see your work directly shape the customer experience. We value curiosity and knowledge sharing, including helping non\-technical teammates build the skills and confidence to do more in Shopify admin and our backend tools. We move quickly, stay close to our customers, and adapt as new opportunities emerge. You’ll thrive here if you communicate openly, ask thoughtful questions, and enjoy turning business needs into practical solutions. This role is hybrid and based in New York City, with two days per week in office required What You’ll Own Storefront Development \& Custom Experiences Writing code is a core part of this role. You’ll build and maintain custom Shopify themes, templates, sections, and interactive components using Liquid, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS. You’ll support key shopping experiences across PDPs, collection pages, cart, and customer accounts. Feature Development \& Delivery You’ll take ownership of assigned features from technical requirements through development, testing, and release. You’ll solve problems proactively and work with the team to deliver high\-quality solutions. Promotions \& Ecommerce Functionality You’ll develop and enhance custom promotional features, including gift\-with\-purchase (GWP), bundles, discounts, product merchandising, and other conversion\-driving shopping experiences. Search \& Product Discovery You’ll support on\-site Shopify search, filtering, collection merchandising, and product discovery enhancements that improve the customer shopping journey. Performance \& Optimization Site performance, accessibility (WCAG 2\.2\), and the overall customer experience will remain top of mind. You’ll improve site speed, Core Web Vitals, mobile responsiveness, and overall storefront performance. Shopify Integrations You’ll implement and maintain third\-party applications, Shopify APIs, and custom integrations that support our merchandising, marketing, and customer experiences. Testing \& Technical Quality You’ll troubleshoot production issues, participate in code reviews and deployments, and partner with QA to identify regressions and ensure reliable, high\-quality releases. AI\-First Development We’re actively exploring how AI can make the way we build, test, and deploy our ecommerce experiences even smarter. You’ll use AI\-powered development tools to improve productivity, troubleshooting, code quality, and workflow efficiency, and you’ll look for new ways AI can enhance the shopping experience. You bring a practical and curious perspective on where AI can create meaningful value. What You Bring What We’re Looking For: * 5\+ years of Shopify development experience , preferably with Shopify Plus and a direct\-to\-consumer (DTC) ecommerce brand * Strong proficiency in Shopify Liquid, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, and modern JavaScript (ES6\+) * Experience with Shopify Online Store 2\.0, metafields, metaobjects, theme customization, and the Shopify Admin/Storefront APIs (GraphQL) * Ability to build reusable frontend components, implement complex shopping logic, and integrate third\-party services using REST or GraphQL APIs * Experience with Git, pull requests, code reviews, debugging, and release workflows * Strong problem\-solving skills and attention to detail * Ability to work cross\-functionally and communicate clearly with both technical and non\-technical partners What Will Make You Stand Out: * Experience with React or other modern frontend frameworks * Familiarity with Shopify Functions, Checkout Extensibility, or customer account extensions * Experience with AWS/serverless infrastructure, webhooks, or custom backend integrations * Familiarity with AI\-assisted development tools such as Codex or Claude Code * Experience working within founder\-led, DTC, beauty, fashion, or lifestyle brands Our Perks * Salary range: $100,000\-120,000 (Compensation will depend on a variety of factors, including but not limited to skill level, relevant work experience \& education) * Medical, dental, vision, 401K plan \& access to health \& wellness programs * Paid vacation, holidays, summer Fridays, birthdays off, volunteer time \& more * Makeup gratis, employee discount on tarte.com, team give back initiatives * Friendly, fun, creative \& collaborative work environment Tarte is an equal opportunity employer.

jobs.title: Backend Software Engineer - Data Retention - TikTok Privacy and Security
jobs.description: Technology Backend Software Engineer \- Data Retention \- TikTok Privacy and Security **Location :** San Jose **Employment Type :** Regular **Job Code :** A05652 Responsibilities The TikTok Privacy and Security (PnS) R\&D team creates privacy solutions that are intuitive for users, auditable for regulators, and sustainable for the company, making TikTok a platform where people can safely discover, create, and connect. We build user\-facing privacy features, including privacy settings, consent management, data access and export, and age\-appropriate experiences. We protect personal data across its full lifecycle, from collection and transfer through access, storage, retention, and deletion. We develop the platforms, technical controls, and governance tools behind privacy protection and regulatory compliance in global markets, and we bring privacy\-enhancing technologies and research into production at scale. We tackle challenges unique to operating a platform at global scale: translating rapidly evolving laws and policies into reliable technical controls, providing transparency and auditability across highly complex data systems, supporting different regulatory requirements across regions, and making privacy protection work at the quality and speed production systems demand. You will work across product privacy, data lifecycle management, data protection and residency, privacy engineering platforms, AI governance, and privacy\-preserving technologies, using techniques including automated compliance enforcement, data lineage and taxonomy, differential privacy, trusted execution environments, AI fairness, and privacy protection for generative AI. The systems you build will protect hundreds of millions of people, and the privacy decisions you make will reach every one of them. TikTok's Privacy and Security (PNS) Data Retention team makes sure that data across the platform is kept only as long as it is needed, and is then deleted reliably and verifiably. The data covers online services, offline warehouses, logs, backups, and ML training datasets. Global privacy rules keep getting stricter, and the data estate keeps growing to exabyte scale. The team owns the policies, platforms, and technical controls that turn retention commitments into guarantees we can enforce and audit. As a Backend Engineer \- Data Retention, you will design and build scalable, reliable, high\-performance systems that manage the lifecycle of data at TikTok scale. That includes finding and classifying data, applying retention policies, running deletion, and proving that deletion happened. You will turn fast\-changing privacy and regulatory requirements into concrete platform capabilities. You will work closely with storage infrastructure, data platform, ML platform, product, privacy, legal, and security teams to ship solutions across thousands of services and storage systems. Responsibilities: \- Design and build large\-scale data lifecycle management systems that enforce retention policies across heterogeneous storage: RDBMS, KV stores, caches, message queues, data warehouses (Hive/HDFS), object storage, logs, and backups. \- Build and run high\-throughput deletion pipelines, such as TTL enforcement, user account deletion propagation, and partition and snapshot expiry. They must be correct, idempotent, and observable, and must not hurt the stability or performance of production systems. \- Build data discovery and inventory capabilities, including metadata collection, data lineage, and classification of personal and sensitive data. These keep retention policies accurately mapped to real storage assets. \- Build verification, auditing, and reporting systems that prove deletion is complete and on time. Provide evidence for internal audits and regulator inquiries. \- Support exception workflows such as legal holds, retention extensions, and policy approvals, with fine\-grained access control and full audit trails. \- Work with ML platform teams to extend retention and deletion controls to training datasets, feature stores, and derived artifacts such as embeddings and model checkpoints. \- Work with privacy, legal, and compliance teams so that systems meet applicable regulations (GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other global and regional privacy laws) and TikTok's own data commitments. \- Help shape the technical roadmap for the data retention platform, and find and evaluate new techniques and tools that improve coverage, efficiency, and reliability at scale. Qualifications Minimum Qualifications \- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field. \- 3\+ years of backend development experience in Go, Java, C\+\+, or Python. \- Strong background in large\-scale distributed systems, databases, messaging and streaming systems (such as Kafka or Flink), and caching. \- Solid understanding of storage internals and data lifecycle concepts, such as TTL, compaction, partitioning, snapshots and backups, and consistency models. \- Experience buil age systems. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units. ​ Benefits may vary depending on the nature of employment and the country work location. Employees have day one access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) savings plan with company match, paid parental leave, short\-term and long\-term disability coverage, life insurance, wellbeing benefits, among others. Employees also receive 10 paid holidays per year, 10 paid sick days per year and 17 days of Paid Personal Time (prorated upon hire with increasing accruals by tenure). ​ The Company reserves the right to modify or change these benefits programs at any time, with or without notice. ​ **For Los Angeles County (unincorporated) Candidates:** ​ Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Our company believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship on the following job duties, potentially resulting in the withdrawal of the conditional offer of employment: ​ 1\. Interacting and occasionally having unsupervised contact with internal/external clients and/or colleagues; ​ 2\. Appropriately handling and managing confidential information including proprietary and trade secret information and access to information technology systems; and ​ 3\. Exercising sound judgment. ​ About TikTok TikTok is the leading destination for short\-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo. ​ Why Join Us Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy \- a mission we work towards every day. ​ We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us. ​ ​ Diversity \& Inclusion ​ TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. We are passionate about this and hope you are too. ​ TikTok Accommodation TikTok is committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our recruitment processes for candidates with disabilities, pregnancy, sincerely held religious beliefs or other reasons protected by applicable laws. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Lead DOH9003
jobs.description: **Description** --------------- **Senior Software Engineer, Lead** This home\-based (remote) position is open to Washington residents and those living in Oregon and Idaho only. **The Opportunity** As the Senior Software Engineer, Lead, you will design, code, test, deploy, and maintain complex applications that support Washington’s public health programs and operations. This hands\-on technical lead role combines advanced software engineering with application architecture, database development, troubleshooting, and technical guidance for other developers. You will build and improve secure, reliable systems using modern development technologies, cloud services, and data platforms. Your work will help keep critical applications available to public health programs and partner organizations across Washington, supporting essential reporting, public health services, and the secure handling of sensitive information. **Key Responsibilities Include:** * Design and develop complex enterprise applications, writing, testing, debugging, and maintaining secure, high\-quality production code. * Lead technical architecture and implementation of application solutions, cloud\-hosted services, and system integrations that meet business and security requirements. * Develop and maintain database solutions, data integrations, and reporting tools using SQL Server, Azure Synapse Analytics, and business intelligence platforms. * Troubleshoot and resolve complex application, database, performance, and security issues through technical analysis and root\-cause investigation. * Lead technical quality practices through code reviews, automated testing, performance analysis, version control, and continuous integration and deployment. * Guide and mentor developers by assigning work, communicating technical standards, reviewing deliverables, and providing hands\-on coaching. * Plan and implement system upgrades, technology transitions, and application improvements to maintain reliability and address changing business needs. * Develop and maintain technical documentation, implementation plans, and development standards that promote consistent, secure, and maintainable systems. **Why You’ll Love This Role** You’ll combine hands\-on software development with technical leadership, solving complex challenges and helping other developers grow. You’ll also see how your work makes a difference by maintaining secure, reliable systems that support essential public health services and protect information that communities across Washington depend on. **The Ideal Candidate** You bring strong software engineering skills, experience designing and maintaining complex applications, and the ability to guide other developers. You value secure, reliable systems and understand how technology supports essential public health services. **Required Qualifications** *There are multiple pathways to qualify for this position. You must meet one of the options provided and any additional criteria listed.* *Please ensure any relevant experience defined below is outlined in your cover letter, resume, and/or applicant profile.**Additional relevant experience may substitute for education on a year\-for\-year basis.* **Option 1:** Eleven (11\) years of professional experience in one or more of the following IT disciplines: consulting, analyzing, designing, programming, installing and/or maintaining computer software applications. **Option 2:** An associate’s degree or higher in an Information Technology program or a closely related field AND Nine (9\) years of professional experience in one or more of the following IT disciplines: consulting, analyzing, designing, programming, installing and/or maintaining computer software applications. **Option 3:** A bachelor’s degree or higher in Information Technology program or a closely related field AND Seven (7\) years of professional experience in one or more of the following IT disciplines: consulting, analyzing, designing, programming, installing and/or maintaining computer software applications. **Additional Required Knowledge, Skills, and Experience** * Professional experience in software development, including designing, developing, testing, implementing, and maintaining applications. * Recent experience in coding and developing applications and solutions using current vendor supported version of tools such as SQL and .NET * Experience developing and maintaining complex web\-based applications using .NET/C\#. * Experience developing and working with relational databases using SQL and T\-SQL. * Experience developing or integrating RESTful APIs and web services. * Experience using modern JavaScript frameworks such as React, Angular, Vue, or similar technologies. * Experience using Agile methodologies and practices throughout the software development lifecycle. * Knowledge of software development practices related to application architecture, testing, source control, security, and deployment. * Experience providing technical lead s the flexibility to choose between multiple investment options. **Social Security** All state employees are covered by the federal Social Security and Medicare systems. The state and the employee pay an equal amount into the system. **Public Service Loan Forgiveness** If you are employed by a government or not\-for\-profit organization, and meet the qualifying criteria, you may be eligible to receive student loan forgiveness under the Public Service Loan Forgiveness Program. **Holidays** Full\-time and part\-time employees are entitled to paid holidays and one paid personal holiday per calendar year. **Note:** Employees who are members of certain Unions may be entitled to additional personal leave day(s), please refer to position specific Collective Bargaining Agreements for more information*.* Full\-time employees who work full monthly schedules qualify for holiday compensation if they are employed before the holiday and are in pay status for at least 80 nonovertime hours during the month of the holiday; or for the entire work shift preceding the holiday. Part\-time employees who are in pay status during the month of the holiday qualify for the holiday on a pro\-rata basis. Compensation for holidays (including personal holiday) will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status in the month to that required for full\-time employment, excluding all holiday hours. Pay status includes hours worked and time on paid leave. **Sick Leave** Full\-time employees earn eight hours of sick leave per month. Overtime eligible employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month, earn a monthly proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Overtime exempt employees who are in pay status for less than 80 hours per month do not earn a monthly accrual of sick leave. Sick leave accruals for part\-time employees will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. **Vacation (Annual Leave)** Full\-time employees accrue vacation leave at the rates specified in WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA). Full\-time employees who are in pay status for less than 80 nonovertime hours in a month do not earn a monthly accrual of vacation leave. Part\-time employees accrue vacation leave hours in accordance with WAC 357\-31\-165(1\) or the applicable collective bargaining agreement (CBA) on a pro rata basis. Vacation leave accrual will be proportionate to the number of hours in pay status, in the month to that required for full\-time employment. Pay status includes hours worked, time on paid leave and paid holiday. As provided in WAC 357\-58\-175, an employer may authorize a lump\-sum accrual of vacation leave or accelerate the vacation leave accrual rate to support the recruitment and/or retention of a candidate or employee for a Washington Management Service position. Vacation leave accrual rates may only be accelerated using the rates established WAC 357\-31\-165\. **Note:** Most agencies follow the civil service rules covering leave and holidays for **exempt** employees even though there is no requirement for them to do so. However, agencies are required to adhere to the applicable RCWs pertaining holidays and leave. **Military Leave** Washington State supports members of the armed forces with 21 days paid military leave per year. **Bereavement Leave** Most employees whose family member or household member dies, or for loss of pregnancy, are entitled to five (5\) days of paid bereavement leave. In addition, the employer may approve other available leave types for the purpose of bereavement leave. **Additional Leave** Leave Sharing Parental Leave Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Leave Without Pay Please visit the State HR Website for more detailed information regarding benefits.
