jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description: Weave (YC W25\) is building the definitive platform for understanding and improving how engineering teams work. We believe the way engineering output is measured today is fundamentally broken and that modern AI can give teams a far more accurate and actionable view of productivity, impact and collaboration. Trusted by 200\+ customers such as Robinhood, Rho, PostHog and Browserbase, we've delivered consistent double\-digit month\-over\-month revenue growth since May and are looking to accelerate our growth. As Weave's Customer Success Manager, you'll own everything that happens after a customer signs. You'll get customers live fast, turn Weave into a weekly habit for their engineering managers, and make sure every account renews and grows. We've raised a $13\.5 million Series A and are backed by Standard Capital, Y Combinator, Moonfire, Burst Capital, IrregEx and the Agent Fund. This is a rare opportunity to join at the ground floor and shape how millions of engineers and leaders understand engineering work. **WHAT WE'RE BUILDING** ----------------------- Weave is rethinking engineering output from first principles. We use AI to: * Understand how engineers actually work (not just what they ship) * Surface meaningful insights about productivity, quality, collaboration and impact * Help teams improve outcomes without vanity metrics or surveillance Today that means two products: the Weave platform, which shows engineering leaders how AI is changing their team's output, quality and token spend, and the open\-source Weave Router, which routes each coding\-agent prompt to the right model based on cost, speed and quality. **THE TEAM YOU'LL WORK WITH** ----------------------------- You'll work directly with: * Adam (CEO): leads sales and customer discovery. Adam is a former sales executive at multiple high\-growth startups who has scaled multiple sales teams from $0 to $30M in ARR, and he stays deeply embedded with customers. * Andrew (CTO): previously a founding engineer at Causal, MIT alum. Andrew is deeply committed to mentorship and ownership for everyone on the team, and will be your closest partner on getting more technical fast. You'll also work side by side with our sales team and engineers every day. This is a small, intense, highly collaborative team. You will have real ownership from day one. **THE ROLE** ------------ This isn't a traditional customer success role. You'll be as comfortable debugging an integration as you are running a renewal call. The closest thing we can describe it as is a mashup of account manager, solutions engineer and data analyst. Every customer buys Weave to answer some version of the same question: "is AI actually making our engineering team better, and is it worth what we're spending?" Your job is to make sure they get an answer they trust, and then act on it. You'll own a book of our largest accounts from kickoff to renewal, from fast\-growing startups to public companies like Robinhood. You'll also build the onboarding and automation that covers every other customer. You'll be measured on whether customers stay, whether usage spreads from the leader who bought Weave to the managers who run their teams with it every week, and whether accounts grow. **RESPONSIBILITIES** -------------------- * **Get customers live fast.** Run onboarding end to end, from connecting GitHub and AI tools like Claude Code and Cursor to their first executive report. * **Drive adoption past the buyer.** Train engineering managers and tech leads until Weave is part of their 1:1s, sprint reviews and planning. * **Be the expert on the data.** Help customers read their metrics, run business reviews on what changed, and dig in when a number looks wrong. * **Own renewals and expansion.** Track account health, find the next champion when one leaves, and partner with sales to grow accounts. * **Close the loop with engineering.** Triage and reproduce issues, write bug reports engineers can act on, and bring customer patterns back to the roadmap. * **Build the playbook.** Onboarding checklists, health scores and help docs, automated wherever possible. **QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------ ### **MUST\-HAVE** * 2\+ years in a post\-sale, customer\-facing role at a B2B SaaS company: customer success, account management, implementation, solutions or support. * You've owned a book of business. You were measured on renewals, retention or expansion, and you can walk us through your numbers and the accounts you saved. * You're technical enough to unblock customers. You don't need to have been an engineer, but you know how software teams ship (PRs, code review, CI/CD, incidents), you're at home in GitHub, and when an integration breaks, you dig in before you escalate. * You use AI tools every day. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or similar are part of how you work, and you have real opinions about what they're good at. * You write and speak clearly. You can walk a CTO through a messy dataset in a few minutes, and write the follow\-up that gets everyone aligned. * Self\-starter who's comfortable in ambiguity and wired for speed. * This role is 5 days in office in SF ### **NICE\-TO\-HAVE** * Hands\-on technical experience. You've worked as a software engineer, support engineer, solutions engineer or forward deployed engineer, or you've shipped code as part of your job. * You can write SQL or a quick Python script to answer your own questions. * Customer success experience at a developer tools, data or AI company where your users were engineers * Real opinions on DORA, SPACE and DevEx, and on what changes when agents write half the code * You've built customer success from zero: onboarding programs, health scores, QBR templates, help docs * Experience at an early\-stage startup (Seed to Series B) **WHY JOIN** ------------ * $120K\-$150K base salary \+ early equity * Health/vision/dental insurance covered * Free lunch/dinners/snacks * Yearly team offsite with regular team events * Yearly $500 learning/development stipend * Get to work in SF with one of the fastest moving teams (99th percentile code output) **ABOUT THE INTERVIEW** ----------------------- * 15\-minute intro call * 30\-minute culture interview with our CEO, Adam * 30\-minute conversation with our CTO, Andrew, on how engineering teams work * Run a business review: we'll share a sample customer's Weave data, and you'll walk us through it in 20 minutes as you would with their VP of Engineering * 2\-3 day paid work trial in our SF office Compensation Range: $120K \- $150K

jobs.description: **Your work days are brighter here.** We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too. **About the Team** Data Platform and Observability Engineering builds the platforms Workday teams use to turn data into reliable, governed products. This team is building a highly scalable data\-product platform: compute, storage, catalog, orchestration, access control, and the workflows teams use to develop, test, and operate data products and marts. The platform spans the full data\-product lifecycle, including **dbt Core, Airflow, Trino, Apache Iceberg, Amazon S3 Tables, AWS Glue Catalog, access control, security, infrastructure as code, and CI/CD** . * Contribute to the **semantic and visualization layer** for data\-product consumption. * Troubleshoot and operate the full stack, with a focus on **reliability, scalability, and safe production operations** . * Build reusable platform patterns that make it easier for teams to develop and operate data products. * Support and mentor team members on data platform and data\-product development **About You** **Basic Qualification** * Basic Qualifications * 8\+ years of software engineering or data engineering experience. * 5\+ years of experience building or operating production **data platforms, lakehouse platforms, or distributed data systems** . * Hands\-on experience building and maintaining **production dbt Core projects** . * Strong production SQL and data\-modeling experience. * Experience with **Airflow or another production workflow orchestration platform** . * Experience with **Trino or another distributed SQL/query engine** . * Experience with a lakehouse technology such as **Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Hudi** . * Experience with cloud n** for high\-volume workloads. ### **Visualization** * Experience with **Apache Superset, Metabase** , or similar BI platforms. ### **Security, Infrastructure \& Operations** * Experience with **Terraform, IAM, least privilege, encryption, CI/CD, monitoring, and production operations** . * Experience operating jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description: Wunderlich\-Malec Engineering's IT group has a Project Manager opportunity in our Eden Prairie, MN office. This person is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing client\-facing IT/OT infrastructure and technical services projects from initiation through completion. This role independently manages multiple projects, ensuring schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, and client expectations are effectively coordinated and maintained. The IT Project Manager works closely with engineers, technical leads, clients, vendors, and stakeholders to drive project execution, resolve issues, manage competing priorities, and maintain accountability for project commitments. Responsibilities include developing and maintaining project schedules, monitoring project financials and resource utilization, managing risks and dependencies, supporting proposals and change orders, and providing clear, proactive project status reporting. The ideal candidate has 3–5 years of project management experience, preferably in IT infrastructure, networking, systems integration, or technical services environments. This individual must be capable of independently driving project activities, anticipating delivery challenges, communicating schedule and scope impacts, and escalating issues appropriately while partnering with technical teams to achieve successful project outcomes. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** * Independently manage multiple concurrent IT/OT infrastructure and technical services projects from initiation through planning, execution, monitoring, and closure. * Develop, maintain, and manage project schedules, milestones, deliverables, resource plans, and project documentation using Microsoft Project and other project tracking tools. * Coordinate engineers, technical leads, project teams, clients, vendors, and internal stakeholders to ensure project activities and deliverables remain aligned with established commitments. * Lead project meetings, establish agendas, document decisions, assign action items, and drive follow\-through on outstanding tasks, dependencies, and commitments. * Proactively monitor project progress against scope, schedule, budget, and deliverables; identify potential delays, resource constraints, and risks, and develop mitigation plans. * Maintain project RAID logs, action registers, decision logs, change documentation, and other project controls to support visibility, accountability, and timely resolution of issues. * Communicate project status, milestones, risks, issues, resource constraints, and schedule impacts to clients, technical teams, and leadership in a timely and professional manner. * Manage client expectations regarding scope, schedule, deliverables, resource availability, and project changes. Facilitate discussions to resolve conflicts and align stakeholders on priorities and next steps. * Coordinate resource planning and capacity management with technical leads and management, identifying scheduling conflicts, competing priorities, and resource needs across active projects. * Monitor project financial performance, including labor hours, budgets, estimates, forecasts, and resource utilization. Identify potential overruns or variances and communicate impacts to appropriate stakeholders. * Support and coordinate proposal development, project estimates, scope definition, change orders, and related commercial documentation. Evaluate the potential schedule, resource, and financial impacts of proposed changes. * Coordinate procurement activities, vendor follow\-up, equipment readiness, and other project dependencies as required to support execution. * Identify gaps in project information, technical inputs, approvals, and deliverables; establish owners and due dates and drive resolution to prevent downstream schedule status updates. * Demonstrated ability to identify project risks and issues, drive action\-item resolution, manage escalations, and communicate schedule or scope impacts before they affect delivery. * Office applications, including Excel, Word, Outlook, and Teams. **Preferred** * Experience managing IT infrastructure, enterprise networking, hardware deployment, data center, systems implementation, jobs.title: Senior ASIC Design Engineer – AI Accelerator / SoC
jobs.description: **About the Role** Xscend is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Senior ASIC Design Engineer to contribute to the architecture, microarchitecture, and RTL development of next\-generation AI accelerators and high\-performance SoC subsystems. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience in digital ASIC design, with a solid understanding of GPU, NPU, or complex SoC subsystem architectures. The candidate should be proficient in translating functional specifications into detailed microarchitecture and synthesizable RTL, optimizing designs for performance, power, and area (PPA), and supporting the complete ASIC development lifecycle. This position focuses on hands\-on digital design, RTL implementation, functional debugging, and collaboration with architecture, verification, and physical design engineers to deliver production\-quality silicon. **Key Responsibilities** 1\. ASIC Microarchitecture and RTL Design * Develop detailed microarchitecture specifications based on system\-level and functional requirements. * Design and implement complex digital logic using Verilog/SystemVerilog. * Develop high\-performance datapaths, control logic, finite state machines, arbitration mechanisms, and communication interfaces. * Implement efficient pipelining, buffering, flow control, and resource\-sharing mechanisms. * Optimize RTL designs for timing, power consumption, silicon area, and implementation feasibility. * Perform RTL code reviews, design analysis, and functional debugging. * Collaborate with architecture engineers to evaluate design trade\-offs and improve subsystem performance. **2\. AI Accelerator and SoC Subsystem Design** * Design and implement functional blocks and subsystems for AI accelerators, GPU, NPU, or complex SoC architectures. * Develop compute pipelines, memory interfaces, DMA engines, on\-chip interconnects, and data movement logic. * Understand and implement hardware mechanisms supporting parallel computation, high\-throughput processing, and efficient memory access. * Optimize data movement, memory bandwidth utilization, latency, and overall subsystem performance. * Collaborate with system architects and algorithm engineers to translate computational requirements into efficient hardware implementations. **3\. Memory and High\-Speed Interface Integration** * Design and integrate memory controllers, on\-chip interconnects, and high\-speed interface subsystems. * Work with memory subsystem architectures, including memory arbitration, buffering, transaction ordering, and data flow control. * Support integration of standard interfaces such as AMBA AXI and other SoC interconnect protocols. * Collaborate with IP and system integration teams to ensure functional correctness and interface compatibility. * Analyze interface performance, bandwidth utilization, and latency bottlenecks. **4\. ASIC Development and Design Implementation** * Participate in the ASIC development lifecycle from specification and microarchitecture through RTL design, verification, synthesis, physical implementation, and tape\-out. * Develop synthesizable, maintainable, and production\-quality RTL that meets design requirements. * Perform lint checks, clock\-domain crossing (CDC) analysis, and reset\-domain crossing (RDC) analysis. * Support logic synthesis, static timing analysis, and timing closure. * Work with physical design engineers to address timing, congestion, power, and area challenges. * Analyze and resolve functional and implementation issues identified during simulation, synthesis, and physical design. * Support silicon bring\-up, post\-silicon debugging, and validation activities as needed. **5\. Functional Verification and Hardware/Software Integration** * Collaborate with verification engineers to develop functional verification plans and test scenarios. * Support IP\-level and SoC\-level verification, including simulation, debugging, and regression analysis. * Analyze simulation failures and debug RTL functional issues using waveforms, logs, and assertions. * Participate in hardware/software interface definition, including control/status registers, interrupts, and programming models. * Support FPGA prototyping, emulation, and hardware/software integration testing. * Work with firmware and software engineers to resolve system\-level functional issues. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field. * **5\+ years of hands\-on experience** in digital ASIC/SoC design, microarchitecture, and RTL implementation. * Strong architecture and microarchitecture knowledge, with hands\-on design experience in at least one of the following: * GPU or parallel computing architectures * NPU, AI accelerator, or machine learning processor architectures * Complex SoC subsystems, such as memory controllers, interconnect fabrics, DMA engines, or high\-performance processing subsystems * Strong proficiency in Verilog/SystemVerilog RTL design. * Experience translating functional specifications into microarchitecture specifications and synthesizable RTL. * Solid understanding of digital logic design, pipelining, finite state machines, datapaths, memory systems, and on\-chip interconnect architectures. * Experience with RTL simulation, debugging, synthesis, lint, and static timing analysis. * Familiarity with clock\-domain crossing (CDC), reset design, and timing constraints. * Experience working with verification engineers to debug functional issues and achieve design correctness. * Understanding of ASIC design flow from specification through synthesis, physical implementation, and tape\-out. * Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills. * Ability to independently design, implement, and debug complex ASIC functional blocks. **Preferred Qualifications** * Direct design experience with GPU, NPU, AI accelerator, or heterogeneous computing SoCs. * Knowledge of chip\-to\-chip and die\-to\-die interconnect technologies, including UCIe (Universal Chiplet Interconnect Express) or other high\-speed interconnect protocols. * Knowledge of LPDDR memory technologies, particularly LPDDR5/LPDDR5X and LPDDR6, including memory controller architecture and interface integration. * Knowledge of PCIe, particularly PCIe Gen5/Gen6, including controller architecture, transaction processing, and subsystem integration. * Familiarity with NoC architectures, cache coherency, memory consistency, and high\-bandwidth data movement. * Experience with AMBA AXI/ACE/CHI or other industry\-standard SoC interconnect protocols. * Understanding of AI/ML workloads, including matrix multiplication, tensor operations, and inference acceleration. * Experience with hardware/software co\-design, firmware interfaces, or system\-level integration. * Familiarity with UVM\-based functional verification, SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA), or formal verification. * Experience with FPGA prototyping, hardware emulation, or post\-silicon validation. * Familiarity with low\-power design techniques, including clock gating, power domains, and power optimization. * Experience with advanced semiconductor process technologies, including 7nm, 5nm, 3nm, or below. * Experience with ASIC designs that have successfully completed tape\-out and silicon bring\-up. **What Success Looks Like** * Deliver high\-quality microarchitecture specifications and production\-ready RTL for AI accelerator and SoC functional blocks. * Meet functional, performance, power, and area requirements. * Successfully integrate designed blocks into larger ASIC/SoC subsystems. * Identify and resolve complex RTL, timing, and functional issues. * Collaborate effectively with architecture, verification, and physical design teams. * Contribute to successful ASIC tape\-out and silicon validation. **Why Join Xscend?** At Xscend, you will have the opportunity to work on next\-generation AI computing and semiconductor technologies. You will contribute directly to advanced AI accelerator and high\-performance SoC designs, collaborate with experienced ASIC engineers, and solve challenging digital design and implementation problems. We value engineering excellence, hands\-on technical expertise, creativity, and the ability to transform advanced concepts into production\-ready silicon. Pay: $140,000\.00 \- $200,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Flexible schedule Work Location: Hybrid remote in Austin, TX 78759

jobs.title: Enterprise AI - Account Director - Consumer Packaged Goods
jobs.description: **About Turing** ================ Turing's mission is to accelerate superintelligence to drive real economic progress. Headquartered in San Francisco, Turing works with frontier AI labs to generate high\-quality datasets, reinforcement learning environments, and frontier research benchmarks that improve model capabilities in software engineering, enterprise knowledge work, and advanced STEM reasoning. In software engineering, Turing is the largest and longest\-running data provider in the category. Turing also works with Fortune 500 enterprises across financial services, life sciences, healthcare, retail, automotive, and CPG to build and deploy end\-to\-end agentic AI systems inside mission\-critical workflows. By operating on both sides, Turing closes the loop between frontier research and enterprise deployment, turning real\-world deployment signals into better data, evaluations, and more capable models. Learn more at www.turing.com. **Role:** Enterprise AI \- Account Director \- Consumer Packaged Goods **Location:** Dallas, TX, with client\-site presence as required in the Plano, TX Area **Experience Level:** 8\+ years; consumer packaged goods experience highly desirable **Work Model:** Hybrid, with regular client\-site presence as required **Why Join Enterprise AI?** --------------------------- Enterprise AI is a distinct business unit within Turing focused on deploying AI systems that create measurable value for enterprise customers. As the Enterprise AI Account Director for a consumer packaged goods company, you will own an established custom engineering relationship both commercially and operationally. You will expand the account by identifying operations, supply chain, and commercial workflows where AI can create measurable value, selling those deployments, and overseeing delivery through a senior Forward\-Deployed Engineer or delivery lead. This is a high\-ownership role for someone who combines commercial instinct, enterprise credibility, and delivery leadership. **As the Enterprise AI Account Director, You Will** --------------------------------------------------- ### **Expand the Client Relationship** Build relationships across multiple buying centers and identify new sponsors and decision\-makers beyond the current buyer. ### **Identify AI Deployment Opportunities** Assess the client's operations, supply chain, and commercial workflows to identify two or three quantified opportunities where AI deployment can create measurable value. ### **Sell Follow\-On Work** Translate identified opportunities into clear scopes of work and lead the expansion from discovery through client alignment and signed SOWs. ### **Own Delivery Quality** Maintain single\-point accountability for the client relationship and business outcome. Oversee the embedded delivery team through a senior FDE lead or delivery lead. ### **Manage Commercial Performance** Own SOWs, pricing, margin, and delivery quality.
